items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - United States Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base. Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas. Responsibilities: Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives. Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines. Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability. Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment. Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc. Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data. Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering. Experience in data analysis and dashboard design. Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases. Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. Agentic AI-assisted development experience. Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen. Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team. Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/ Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave #LI-Remote Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $164,200 — $229,990 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-analytics-engineer

items.description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Why This Role Matters Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools. This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster. You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast. What You'll Do GTM Analysis & Decision Support Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers. Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff. Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach. Data Modeling & Quality Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system. Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking. Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software. Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it. Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests. Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself. How You'll Work Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager. Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked. What We're Looking For Experience 5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it. Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data. Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work. Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data. Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome). BI & AI Fluency Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches. Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale. We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty. Mindset Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning. Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle. Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often. Compensation Additional Information Join us in shaping the future of real estate The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages. We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition. Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date. More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner. Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform. Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

items.description: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale. At MGID , we empower brands and publishers to collaborate transparently through our privacy-first targeting technology. This enables advertisers to drive performance and awareness while allowing publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we’re creating innovative technologies, and with your help, we aim to reach even greater heights. We are looking for a Senior Finance Business Partner to join our newly established FP&A function and help transform financial planning and business decision-making across MGID . Working closely with business leaders, you will drive commercial insights, improve profitability and cash flow, and play a key role in implementing strategic financial initiatives, including a new prepayments policy. What you will do: Strategic Business Partnering & Commercial Governance Executive Co-Pilot: Serve as the primary commercial advisor to department heads (Publishing, Partnerships, Sales, Operations), translating complex financial realities into actionable strategic choices. Constructive Challenge: Actively evaluate business cases, hiring plans, and commercial assumptions. Ensure commercial decisions are backed by rigorous ROI data. Investment & ROI Evaluation: Support the financial appraisal, scenario planning, and business case framework for major new strategic initiatives, product launches, and capital deployment. Architecture, Financial Modelling & Budgeting P&L & Forecast: Support business leaders and the FP&A team in preparing rolling forecasts and annual budgets, ensuring alignment with business priorities. Driver-Based Forecasting: Build and optimize dynamic financial models that clearly link non-financial operational drivers (e.g., traffic, CPM, CPC, etc) directly to financial outcomes (revenue, margin, cash). Unit Economics Mastery: Lead deep-dive analyses into company profitability, pricing strategies. Data Infrastructure & BI Collaboration Metric Standardisation: Partner with the Business Intelligence (BI) and Data Engineering teams to build automated, scalable single-source-of-truth data models. Dashboard Evolution: Help transition the business away from individual dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, PowerBI) to integrated ones. Requirements Who you are: 7+ years of experience in finance, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering - ideally in a digital, adtech, marketplace, SaaS, or platform business. Experience building or significantly transforming processes, not just maintaining them. Strong in financial analysis, large datasets, Excel, and financial modelling. Able to explain complex financial topics clearly to non-financial stakeholders and work across functions. Combines strategic thinking with a hands-on, practical approach - comfortable working in an environment where processes are still being built. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field. Will be a plus: Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar. Professional certification: ACCA, CFA, CIMA, or similar. Big Four background. Experience working with two-sided business models or marketplace economics. Languages proficiency: Fluent English, Ukrainian At MGID , we thrive on innovation , collaboration , and a passion for AdTech . Our culture is built on openness , transparency , and a s hared drive for excellence . We empower our teams to take bold steps, embrace challenges, and grow together in a dynamic, people-first environment. Here, your ideas matter, your contributions are valued, and your potential has no limits. Join us and shape the future of digital advertising ! By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understand the MGID Careers Privacy Notice and understand that your personal data will be processed for recruitment purposes as part of this application. You have the right to access, rectify, or erase your data, as well as to object to its processing. We want you to be in control of your personal data. You can request data correction or request to be deleted from our database. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: SUMMARY The Senior Data Analytics Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining analytical models, dashboards, and data products that surface meaningful intelligence across the organization. Additionally, this role partners closely with application development, data engineering, and business teams to deliver scalable, well-governed analytics solutions aligned with regulatory and client requirements in the financial services industry. TECHNOLOGY STACK Snowflake Data Cloud. Microsoft SQL Server and advanced SQL. Power BI (report development, data modeling, and deployment). ETL/ELT frameworks and data pipelines. Microsoft Azure. Data governance, security, and access control tooling. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Designs, develops, and maintains Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic data models that support operational and executive decision-making. Builds and maintains statistical models, trend analyses, and forecasting tools to support fund administration workflows and client reporting. Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting outputs by partnering with governance and quality initiatives. Documents analytical methodologies, data definitions, report logic, and model assumptions to support transparency and auditability. Monitors and optimizes Power BI and Snowflake query performance to ensure efficient, reliable report delivery. Stays current with emerging trends and capabilities in data science, analytics engineering, and business intelligence tooling. WORKING RELATIONSHIPS Provides analytical guidance and mentorship to internal teams consuming data products. Partners with business stakeholders to gather requirements, defines KPIs, and translates analytical needs into scalable data products. Collaborates with technology team members to influence the design of data pipelines and structures that support analytics and reporting use cases. Mentors associates through instruction, coaching, providing real-time on-the-job experiences, modeling effective practices, and advising on methods used. May perform other duties as required and assigned. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 3+ years of experience in data science, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, with strong hands on development and deployment of Power BI reports and data models in production environments. Experience querying and working with data in Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms, along with Power BI Service administration, low level security, and enterprise scale deployment. Financial services experience, ideally supporting fund administration or asset management platforms. KNOWLEDGE ETL/ELT tools and modern data engineering frameworks. Regulatory and compliance considerations related to financial data. Statistical analysis, data wrangling, and exploratory data analysis techniques. Machine learning or predictive modeling techniques applied to business use cases. Microsoft Office Suite. Adobe Acrobat. SKILLS AND ABILITIES Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to data accuracy, with experience implementing data validation and quality checks. contributing to or defining enterprise analytics standards and data strategy. Aligns associates with company values and goals. Plans and delegates the work of others. Motivates and inspires others. Assesses the performance of self and associates to make improvements or take corrective action. Plans and develops systems and procedures to improve operating quality and efficiency of department in accordance with company policies and procedures. Troubleshoots issues utilizing creative and critical thinking skills. Multitasking, analytical, and organizational skills. Initiative-taking, strategic, and meticulous approaches with a strong commitment to quality, efficiency, and effectiveness. Demonstrates personal integrity, responsibility, and accountability. Effectively uses resources such as time and information in conjunction with associates. Participates in solving problems and making decisions. Presents and expresses ideas and information, written and oral, clearly, and concisely. Actively listens to others to achieve understanding and supports an open exchange of ideas and information. Identifies needs, arranges for, and obtains resources to accomplish individual and department goals. Establishes and develops effective working relationships with associates and clientele during both favorable and unfavorable situations. Modifies team and individual priorities and deadlines in response to added information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles and ensures completion. Equivalent education, experience, and KSA’s will be considered. Ultimus is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of the applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship or any other status entitled to protection under federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws. No questions on our employment application are intended to secure information that is to be used for impermissible purposes. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Coordinator - Conversion Rate Optimization
items.summary: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
items.description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that shares a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interaction, experience, and behavior, and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us? What’s the position? Reporting to the Senior Manager, Ad Operations, the Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Coordinator will support the execution and optimization of digital experiences across our web and app platforms. This role will work closely with Product, Data, Marketing, Analytics, Engineering, CRM and Promo teams to identify opportunities that improve customer journeys and drive measurable business impact. As part of the CRO team, you'll help coordinate A/B testing initiatives, analyze customer behavior, monitor experiment performance, and ensure optimization efforts are executed efficiently. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their analytics or optimization career who enjoys combining data with customer experience to solve business problems. Success in this role means using data, experimentation, and customer insights to continuously improve digital experiences and drive measurable business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Coordinate the execution of A/B testing and experimentation initiatives across web and mobile experiences. Monitor experiment timelines, QA test launches, and communicate status updates across cross-functional stakeholders. Manage mobile and web measurement and attribution to support A/B tests, leveraging SKAdNetwork (SKAN), attribution frameworks, and Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer, Branch, Kochava, Adjust, GA4 or similar MMP platforms to ensure accurate performance tracking and measurement. Analyze customer behavior, conversion funnels, experiment results, and campaign performance to identify optimization opportunities. Build recurring reports and dashboards to monitor test performance, conversion metrics, and optimization opportunities. Coordinate ASO activities, including app store listing updates, creative asset management, keyword monitoring, and performance reporting to support conversion rate optimization. Partner with Product, CRM, Engineering, Martech and Analytics teams to ensure successful implementation of optimization initiatives. Validate tracking, tagging, and experiment setup to ensure accurate measurement and reporting. Document experiment hypotheses, learnings, and best practices to build organizational knowledge. Support prioritization of the CRO testing roadmap based on customer insights, business goals, and data. Assist in identifying friction points throughout the customer journey and recommend improvements. Stay current on CRO methodologies, experimentation best practices, analytics tools, and emerging digital trends. Coordinate with Marketing, CRM, and Product teams to ensure landing pages, promotional experiences, and customer journeys are optimized for conversion and aligned with campaign objectives. Monitor key conversion metrics and proactively flag performance trends, anomalies, or testing opportunities to stakeholders. Support the development of test hypotheses by combining customer insights, analytics, business goals, and user behavior data. Conduct competitive research and benchmark digital experiences to identify new optimization ideas and industry best practices. Requirements What are we looking for? 1–2 years of experience in analytics, digital marketing analytics, business intelligence, product analytics, CRO, or a related field. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and communicate actionable insights. Manage mobile and web measurement and attribution to support A/B tests, leveraging SKAdNetwork (SKAN), attribution frameworks, and Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer, Branch, Kochava, Adjust, GA4 or similar MMP platforms to ensure accurate performance tracking and measurement. Understanding of customer journey analysis and user behavior data to identify friction points and conversion opportunities. Understanding of digital KPIs such as conversion rate, funnel performance, CPA, customer lifetime value (LTV), retention, and engagement metrics. Experience creating data visualizations and reporting solutions using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, or similar platforms. Experience with mobile measurement and attribution, including SKAdNetwork (SKAN), attribution principles, and Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer, Branch, Kochava, Adjust or similar Familiarity with A/B testing principles and experimentation methodologies. Familiarity with ASO, App Store Connect, Google Play Console and keyword tracking tools such as MobileAction or AppTweak Basic SQL knowledge or a willingness to learn. Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational and project coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Ability to analyze data, identify trends and optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience collaborating across multiple teams. A passion for continuous learning and improving customer experiences through data-driven decision making. Preferred Qualifications Real money gaming (RMG) experience including sports betting, online casino, daily fantasy sports, or prediction markets. Experience optimizing customer acquisition, onboarding, engagement, or retention for digital products, with a focus on mobile and web conversion funnels. Experience working in performance marketing, digital analytics, product optimization, or growth within a consumer-facing business. Understanding of acquisition marketing, paid media performance, and post-click optimization is a plus. What’s in it for you? We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include: Competitive pay and benefits Flexible vacation allowance A hybrid / remote working environment Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer). Originally posted on Himalayas

If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps: Recruiter Screening (40 minutes) Technical Interview (90 minutes) Final Interview (60 minutes) Life at Ruby Labs At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. items.title: Staff Full-Stack Engineer - Data Intensive Web-Applications - Personalization
items.summary: About usAB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies.
items.description: About us AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa. About AB InBev Growth Group Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world. In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft. We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities. About the Role: As a Staff Full Stack Engineer (Backend Focus), you will build and operate the backend of a Web Analytics and AI portal. That includes the APIs that serve the application, the read data layer over analytical data, authentication and authorization, and the integration points with the services the rest of the team builds. The portal gives commercial intelligence to the people who make business decisions, through daily briefings, customizable KPIs, analytical insights, geographic exploration, and conversational analytics. This is a Staff (L6), hands-on individual contributor role on a lean team where everyone is Staff: a Staff Architect, Staff AI Engineers, Staff Software Engineers, and Data Engineers. Architectural direction sits with the Staff Architect, and the AI Engineers own the agents. You are the builder: you take features from the design doc to production, end to end, and you make them fast, observable, and reliable. Most of your time goes to writing, reviewing, and operating code, including the user interface when the delivery calls for it. What you'll do: Build the backend and ship features end to end Design, implement, test, and operate backend services against explicit latency, availability, and cost targets. Implement typed, versioned API contracts and evolve them without breaking clients. Own authentication, authorization, and multi-tenant access control across the portal. Ship features end to end, from the API to the interface, when the delivery calls for it. Integrate the application with internal services, including the agent services built by the AI Engineers. This covers response streaming, timeouts, cancellation, and partial failures. Own the read path and performance Own the read path over analytical data: data modeling, query plans, pagination, batching, caching, and consistency trade-offs. Set and defend performance budgets. Profile services, reduce tail latency (p95, p99), and optimize cost per request. Run load and capacity tests before launches, and use the results to make design decisions. Make systems observable and reliable Instrument services with metrics, structured logs, and distributed tracing from day one. Define SLIs and SLOs, alerts, and dashboards for the components you own, and take part in on-call. Diagnose and fix reliability issues, and lead incident response and blameless postmortems. Establish safe rollout practices: feature flags, canary releases, and fast rollback. Design and raise the bar Write design docs for the components you deliver, compare alternatives with data and prototypes, and escalate risk to the Staff Architect. Raise the team's technical bar through code review, pairing, and standards for testing, observability, and safe rollout. Use coding agent harnesses such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex as part of your workflow, and review generated code against tests, types, and contracts. What you'll need: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or another quantitative field. A master's degree or PhD is a plus. Relevant experience designing, building, and operating distributed backend services in production, across coding standards, code review, build, automated testing, deployment, and operations. A track record of building features end-to-end and owning them in production. Relevant experience in software design for reliability and scale, on both new and existing systems. Deep command of at least one high-performance language, such as Java/Kotlin, Go, Rust, C++, or C#, including its memory model, concurrency model, and runtime. Ability to work productively in Python, the language of the current services. Hands-on experience with observability in production: metrics, tracing, logging, SLOs, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Proven experience with performance work: profiling, query optimization, caching strategies, and load testing. Production depth in distributed systems: timeouts, retries, idempotency, partial failure, streaming (SSE, WebSockets), and decisions based on tail latency (p95, p99). Relevant experience delivering full stack to production with TypeScript and a modern web framework. Day-to-day fluency with coding agent harnesses such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, including critical review of generated code. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to discuss architecture and trade-offs in depth. Advanced communication in English; Spanish is a plus. Nice to have: Experience with serving layers for analytical data (OLAP, columnar stores, semantic layers) or with data platform integration. Experience integrating applications with LLM or agent services as a consumer. Experience with B2B, multi-country, or multi-tenant products. Experience with cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP), containers, and Kubernetes. More about you: You are a builder: you like taking a feature from a blank page to production and owning it from then on. You spend most of your time writing, reviewing, and operating code. You treat observability and performance as part of the feature, not something added afterward. You influence architecture with evidence: measurements, prototypes, and explicit trade-offs. You go from the API to the interface when the feature needs it. You use tests, types, and contracts as the guardrails for your code and for generated code. You work well on a staff-level team where everyone operates what they ship. What We Offer: Performance based bonus* Attendance Bonus* Private pension plan Meal Allowance Casual office and dress code Days off* Health, dental, and life insurance Medicines discounts WellHub partnership Childcare subsidies Discounts on Ambev products* Clube Ben partnership Scholarship* School materials assurance Language and training platforms Transport allowance *Rules applied Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action: AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. The following fields are optional, but anticipate the information for your registration*. Remember: your data will never be used as elimination criteria in selection processes. With them, AB InBev Growth Group is able to analyze diversity and reduce biases in selection processes. We want to contribute to changing this reality by being an inclusive company. With proprietary data collection technology and advanced analytical tools, Plum helps media clients make smarter content, licensing, and marketing decisions. You’ll work extensively in SQL, with Python for deeper analysis, data processing and automation. A big part of the role is turning ambiguous questions into clear analytical problems, investigating the data, and working out what the results actually mean. You’ll also communicate your findings to clients and internal teams, from answering ad-hoc questions to presenting analysis and explaining the story behind the numbers. Your responsibilities Analyse complex datasets using Python and SQL to uncover key insights about audience behaviour Turn ambiguous or loosely defined questions into clear analytical problems and practical solutions Support ongoing data quality initiatives, ensuring our data outputs are gold standard Prepare and present compelling data summaries and visualisations for internal and client stakeholders Communicate analytical findings clearly, both in writing and in conversation Support client teams by responding to analytical questions and delivering fast, reliable solutions Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine products and improve research accuracy Who we are looking for (must-have) Python programming for data transformation, modelling, and analysis Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate unexpected results and identify the underlying cause SQL for querying, transforming, and integrating large datasets Solid understanding of statistical concepts and data interpretation Strong attention to detail and high standards for data integrity Excellent communication skills – especially in explaining analytical findings 1-2 years of previous experience in a data analyst role Nice to have Familiarity with the TV, streaming, or film industry Experience with BI tools or visualisation platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI) Knowledge of surveys, panel data or audience measurement systems What we offer Salary based on experience and role scope A collaborative, innovation-driven culture Work at the cutting edge of media measurement, shaping how the biggest players in global media understand their audiences Red Sky leads the recruitment process. The cooperation concerns Plum Research. Recruitment process Interview with HR (video meeting, 30 min) Analytical task, async (approx. 1 hour of work, to be returned within 4 working days) Interview with the hiring manager (video call, 60 min), including a short 5-10 min presentation Final meeting with the CEO (video call, if needed) Offer & starting the cooperation Requirements Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world. We are looking for a motivated Product Data Analyst Intern to join our Product DA team. You will work alongside senior analysts on real product analytics projects — including conversion funnel analysis, A/B experiment evaluation, and dashboard building. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to product strategy, experiment-driven decision making, and large-scale data infrastructure. Responsibilities Assist in building and analyzing user conversion funnels, identifying drop-off points and improvement opportunities Support A/B experiment evaluation: pull experiment data, validate cohort allocation (sanity checks), calculate uplift metrics, and summarize results Build and maintain dashboards for key product metrics (CTR, conversion rate, UV/PV) Respond to product team ad-hoc data requests — user segmentation, feature adoption tracking, campaign performance analysis Write and maintain SQL queries for scheduled data pipelines; assist in data quality monitoring Translate data findings into clear summaries and visualizations for product teams Requirements Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or related field) Internship experience in product analytics or related data analysis roles preferred A natural curiosity to identify, investigate and explain trends and patterns in data Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals (hypothesis testing, p-value, confidence intervals) Strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work independently Fast learner with curiosity about product strategy and user behavior Competency in one or more of the following: SQL (able to write complex queries with CTEs, window functions, subqueries) Programming (Python/R for data manipulation) A data visualization tool (e.g. DataWind, Tableau, PowerBI) Preferred Requirements Experience with event tracking / behavioral analytics (Sensors, Mixpanel, GA) Familiarity with Airflow or data scheduling tools Interest in crypto/fintech industry Prior experience with large-scale data (Hive/Spark environment) Why Binance Shape the future of finance Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning Competitive salary and company benefits Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice . These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. items.title: Product Manager - Data & Insights
items.summary: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate.
items.description: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Product Manager, Data & Insights, you will lead the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and analytics, responsible for delivering intuitive, reliable, and scalable reporting experiences for both external users and internal stakeholders. You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities—from customer research and data modeling through to delivery, governance, and continuous improvement. You will partner closely with data engineers, analysts, UX teams, and business stakeholders to build a robust data ecosystem that enables self-service analytics, supports compliance requirements, and delivers meaningful insights for executive decision-making. You will also champion and lead data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products, ensuring that data is managed responsibly, securely, and in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements. Help us shape the future of communication by: Defining and executing the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs. Collaborate with leadership to prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, and business value. Be an advisor for other Product teams in data strategy and design. Collecting business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Developing detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs. Partnering closely with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in the data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica). Understand schema design and how it impacts performance, usability, and extensibility of data reporting systems. Influence architectural decisions around extract-transform-load (ETL/ELT) processes and dimensional modeling. Owning and enforcing data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control. Defining processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Be an advocate for data accuracy and a watchdog for misleading or incomplete insights. Owning the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode). Defining self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams. Create feedback loops to continually improve dashboard usability and relevance for both internal and external users. Acting as the bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Present product updates, reporting insights, and metrics to executives and cross-functional teams. Facilitate decision-making on trade-offs related to data availability, accuracy, and reporting timelines. Requirements What you’ll bring: 5+ years of experience in product management, data, analytics, or reporting platforms, with a strong focus on data-driven products. Proven experience delivering customer-facing reporting products, dashboards, and internal analytics solutions. Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and compliance frameworks, including GDPR and PDPL. Experience working cross-functionally with data engineers, analysts, product teams, UX, and business stakeholders. Hands-on experience with data warehouses such as ClickHouse, Vertica, or Snowflake, and BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Sigma. Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including fact and dimension tables and star schemas. Familiarity with ELT pipelines, dbt, and data orchestration tools is a plus. Understanding of data quality, data integrity, scalability, and performance considerations when building reporting solutions. Ability to define business KPIs and translate business and reporting needs into clear data and product requirements. Experience contributing to data governance, data integrity, and compliance initiatives. Ability to balance performance, usability, scalability, and cost when designing data and reporting solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into clear business requirements and insights. Proven ability to lead cross-functional discussions, align stakeholders around data strategy, and communicate reporting goals and insights effectively. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field AI Proficiency: Minimum Level:L4 (Proficient). Applies AI across product discovery, specification, prototyping, and stakeholder communication. Expected : Uses AI to speed up research, specs, and prototyping, and personally owns the accuracy of every output. Hands-on experience with Claude and Lovable. Writes structured prompts (role, context, constraints, format) and refines the prompt rather than patching outputs by hand. Synthesizes interviews, tickets, and reviews into themes and testable insights, and validates every insight against source data before sharing. Drafts PRDs, user stories, and executive updates with AI as a first-draft partner, then verifies every claim and number before it reaches leadership. Builds clickable prototypes in Lovable to validate ideas with stakeholders, and is clear that a prototype is not production-ready. Understands how AI agents are built (prompts, tools, memory, guardrails) and proactively identifies workflows worth automating. Flags AI risks (hallucination, bias, data privacy, over-reliance) and knows what should and shouldn't be AI-assisted. Craft and Toolkit: Strong SQL and data analysis skills. Experience with data warehouses such as Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Vertica. Knowledge of data modeling, dimensional modeling, data marts, and data pipelines. Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Metabase. Understanding of ETL/ELT, dbt, and data orchestration. Knowledge of data governance, quality, lineage, and compliance. Understanding of GDPR, PDPL, and data privacy principles. Ability to define KPIs, data requirements, data contracts, and reporting specifications. Understanding of scalable, performant, and cost-effective reporting architectures. Character Traits: Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion. Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams. Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals. Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know. Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement. Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas As a Unifone you’ll receive a range of benefits: Competitive salary and bonus Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!) 30 holiday days after the first anniversary Your Birthday off! Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world! Paid leave for new parents Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement Location: Remote — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners . Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events. The Role The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement. Top Responsibilities: Client Measurement & Data Strategy • Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting. • Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools. • Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value. • Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies. • Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation. Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving • Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews. • Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments. • Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations. • Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams. Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap. • Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights. • Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools. • Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities. Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership • Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks. • Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients. • Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums. • Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms. What Success Looks Like: By 6 Months The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams. By 1 Year The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship. Qualities of the Ideal Candidate: • Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity • Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences • Commercially minded • Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels • Naturally curious and innovative • Confident representing AP as an external thought leader Minimum Qualifications & Skills: • 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy • Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams • Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing • Experience leading teams and developing talent • Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing • Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar) • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics • SQL and data querying experience preferred WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing. AP PERKS & BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER 100% remote work for everyone Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 401K with matching Open Paid Time Off Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December Volunteer and Birthday Time Off Focus Fridays Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! Target base salary is £65K - £85K depending on location and experience. Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. #LI-REMOTE *GLSDR #LI-MG1

items.description: Addepto is a leading AI consulting () and data engineering () company that builds scalable, ROI-focused AI solutions for some of the world's largest enterprises and pioneering startups, including Rolls Royce, Continental, Porsche, ABB, and WGU. With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth. The company's work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product - ContextClue - and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide. As part of KMS Technology, a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilities—enabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale. As a Data Engineer , you will have the opportunity to support and further develop an Azure-based data integration solution built primarily around Azure Data Factory (ADF). The current environment includes Azure Functions and ingestion components, but daily delivery is strongly centered on ADF pipeline design, orchestration, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The project focuses on expanding and stabilizing the existing data platform, including the warehouse layer (Azure SQL Database or Synapse), optional dbt-based transformations, and occasional Power BI reporting support. You will work closely with the client-side Product Owner and Architect, proactively aligning business needs with technical implementation decisions and ensuring high-quality, scalable solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and release processes to maintain reliable deployments across environments. 🚀 Your main responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain Azure Data Factory pipelines, including orchestration, parameterization, and trigger management. Configure and manage linked services and datasets within ADF. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize ADF pipelines to ensure performance and reliability. Develop and maintain ETL/ELT processes and support the evolution of the data warehouse layer (Azure SQL Database or Synapse). Translate business requirements into technical solutions in close collaboration with the Product Owner and Architect. Develop and maintain Python-based components (e.g., Azure Functions, API integrations, automation scripts). Contribute to CI/CD processes in Azure DevOps, including pipelines, releases, and environment promotion. Support occasional Power BI reporting and dashboarding needs. Ensure proactive communication, stakeholder alignment, and visibility of risks and impacts. Take ownership of assigned tasks and actively contribute to continuous platform improvement. Requirements 🎯 What you'll need to succeed in this role: Strong hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (must-have), including: pipeline and orchestration design, linked services, datasets, triggers, and parameterization, operational monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning, and deployment-aware ADF development in enterprise environments. Excellent knowledge of Python (Azure Functions, REST APIs, automation). Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of data modeling for ETL/ELT and warehouse workloads. Experience with CI/CD processes in Azure DevOps (pipelines, releases, multi-environment deployments). Solid understanding of Azure services and cloud-based data solutions (e.g., Azure SQL Database, Azure Key Vault). Experience with Power BI for occasional dashboarding and reporting. Experience working with modern development practices and tools. Consulting mindset with proactive communication and strong stakeholder alignment skills. Ability to effectively collaborate with Product Owner and Architect during planning and delivery. Independent and responsible approach to delivering high-quality solutions. Excellent command of English (at least C1 level). ➕ Nice to have: Knowledge of dbt. Experience implementing data warehouses on Azure. 🎁 Discover our perks & benefits: Work in a supportive team of passionate enthusiasts of AI & Big Data. Engage with top-tier global enterprises and cutting-edge startups on international projects. Enjoy flexible work arrangements, allowing you to work remotely or from modern offices and coworking spaces. Accelerate your professional growth through career development paths, knowledge-sharing initiatives, language classes, and sponsored training and conferences . Benefit from partnerships with Databricks and Anthropic , which provide access to industry-leading training materials and certification programs. Participate in team-building events and utilize the integration budget . Celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and milestones. Access medical and sports packages , eye care, and well-being support services, including psychotherapy and coaching. Get full work equipment for optimal productivity, including a laptop and other necessary devices. With our backing, you can boost your personal brand by speaking at conferences, writing for our blog, or participating in meetups. Experience a smooth onboarding with a dedicated buddy, and start your journey in our friendly, supportive, and autonomous culture. Originally posted on Himalayas

This is a high-impact role where youâll help safeguard the business by developing risk frameworks, analyzing emerging threats, strengthening internal controls, and delivering actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. Youâll work closely with Finance, Operations, Compliance, Legal, IT, and Executive Leadership to ensure the organization remains compliant, resilient, and prepared for evolving business risks. If youâre analytical, detail-oriented, and enjoy translating complex risk data into practical business recommendations, this role is built for you. What Youâll OwnEnterprise Risk Assessment Conduct enterprise-wide risk assessments across: Financial risk Operational risk Compliance risk Market risk Cybersecurity risk Maintain and update: Risk registers Control matrices Risk assessments Remediation trackers Identify emerging risks and prioritize mitigation activities. Partner with business leaders to strengthen proactive risk management practices. Risk Modeling & Analytics Build and maintain quantitative risk models using: SQL Excel Python R SAS Perform: Stress testing Scenario analysis Sensitivity analysis Regression analysis Monte Carlo simulations Value at Risk (VaR) modeling Analyze trends, anomalies, and key risk indicators (KRIs). Deliver data-driven recommendations to leadership. Compliance & Regulatory Oversight Support compliance with applicable frameworks such as: SOX Basel III Dodd-Frank GDPR HIPAA PCI-DSS Industry-specific regulations Prepare quarterly and annual compliance reports. Support internal and external audits. Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence. Track remediation activities and regulatory deadlines. Internal Controls & Governance Test and evaluate internal controls. Monitor incidents, exceptions, and risk events through Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms. Support governance committees with reporting and documentation. Partner with IT and Security teams on: Cyber risk Vendor risk Operational resilience Recommend improvements to governance processes and internal controls. Reporting & Executive Communication Build dashboards and reports using: Power BI Tableau Looker Excel Present risk trends and mitigation recommendations to leadership. Translate technical risk findings into clear business insights. Maintain accurate documentation for executive reporting and audit purposes. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with: Finance Operations Compliance Legal IT & Security Executive Leadership Embed risk awareness into business processes. Support continuous improvement of enterprise risk management frameworks. RequirementsMust-Have QualificationsExperience 3+ years of experience in: Risk Management Enterprise Risk Compliance Audit Governance Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments. Core Skills Strong proficiency in: SQL Microsoft Excel Data analysis Experience using Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms such as: Archer ServiceNow LogicManager Or similar solutions Strong understanding of: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Internal controls Regulatory compliance Experience creating executive dashboards and risk reports. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Nice to Have Professional certifications such as: FRM CFA CPA CCEP Experience with: VaR Monte Carlo simulations Stress testing Background in: Financial Services Healthcare SaaS Enterprise Technology Experience supporting board reporting or executive governance committees. Knowledge of: Cyber risk Vendor risk Operational resilience Experience using: Tableau Power BI Looker What Makes You a Strong Fit Strong analytical and quantitative mindset. Exceptional attention to detail. Able to simplify complex risk concepts for business stakeholders. Proactive in identifying issues before they become significant risks. Strong balance of technical expertise and business judgment. Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Tools & Technologies SQL Microsoft Excel Python R SAS Power BI Tableau Looker Archer ServiceNow LogicManager Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) platforms What a Typical Day Looks Like Review dashboards for emerging operational, financial, or compliance risks. Run quantitative risk analyses and stress tests. Update risk registers and remediation trackers. Test internal controls and validate governance processes. Prepare executive reports and compliance documentation. Collaborate with business teams to strengthen risk mitigation strategies. Track remediation progress and regulatory deadlines. In short: You serve as the organizationâs early-warning systemâidentifying, assessing, and mitigating risks before they impact the business. Key Metrics for Success (KPIs) Timely and accurate risk reporting. Internal controls tested and validated on schedule. Early identification and mitigation of business risks. Zero missed regulatory or audit deadlines. High-quality executive reporting and dashboards. Positive audit outcomes and leadership confidence. Why Join Us? Make a direct impact on enterprise risk strategy. Work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams. Influence governance, compliance, and operational resilience. Build scalable risk management frameworks. Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities. Clear career progression into: Senior Risk Manager Enterprise Risk Lead Director of Risk & Compliance Chief Risk Officer (CRO) Interview Process Application Review Spark Hire Intro Video (3â5 minutes) Recruiter Interview Practical Assessment (Risk Analysis & Recommendations) Client Interview Offer & Background Verification What Happens After You Apply Right after you apply, youâll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever itâs convenient for you. Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, youâll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds. Donât overthink itâyou can record your video as many times as youâd like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application. Apply Now If youâre a Risk Analyst or Risk Manager who enjoys identifying business risks, strengthening governance, improving compliance, and helping organizations make informed decisions, weâd love to hear from you. Apply today and play a key role in protecting and strengthening a growing business. Please mention the word **IMPRESSIVENESS** and tag RNC4xNTUuMTMxLjU4 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNC4xNTUuMTMxLjU4). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
