items.title: Data Engineer (Databricks)
items.summary: Addepto is a leading AI consulting () and data engineering () company that builds scalable, ROI-focused AI solutions for some of the world's largest enterprises and pioneering startups, including Rolls Royce, Continental, Porsche, ABB, and WGU.
items.description: Addepto is a leading AI consulting () and data engineering () company that builds scalable, ROI-focused AI solutions for some of the world's largest enterprises and pioneering startups, including Rolls Royce, Continental, Porsche, ABB, and WGU. With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth. The company's work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product - ContextClue - and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide. As part of KMS Technology, a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilities—enabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale. As a Data Engineer , you will have the exciting opportunity to work with a team of technology experts on challenging projects across various industries, leveraging cutting-edge technologies. Here are some of the projects we are seeking talented individuals to join: Design and development of a universal data platform for global aerospace companies. This Azure and Databricks powered initiative combines diverse enterprise and public data sources. The data platform is at the early stages of the development, covering design of architecture and processes as well as giving freedom for technology selection. Data Platform Transformation for energy management association body. This project addressed critical data management challenges, boosting user adoption, performance, and data integrity. The team is implementing a comprehensive data catalog, leveraging Databricks and Apache Spark/PySpark, for simplified data access and governance. Secure integration solutions and enhanced data quality monitoring, utilizing Delta Live Table tests, established trust in the platform. The intermediate result is a user-friendly, secure, and data-driven platform, serving as a basis for further development of ML components. Design of the data transformation and following data ops pipelines for global car manufacturer. This project aims to build a data processing system for both real-time streaming and batch data. We’ll handle data for business uses like process monitoring, analysis, and reporting, while also exploring LLMs for chatbots and data analysis. Key tasks include data cleaning, normalization, and optimizing the data model for performance and accuracy. 🚀 Your main responsibilities: Design scalable data processing pipelines for streaming and batch processing using Big Data technologies like Databricks, Airflow and/or Dagster. Contribute to the development of CI/CD and MLOps processes. Develop applications to aggregate, process, and analyze data from diverse sources. Collaborate with the Data Science team on Machine Learning projects, including text/image analysis and predictive model building. Develop and organize data transformations using Databricks/DBT and Apache Airflow. Translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure optimal performance and quality. Requirements 🎯 What you'll need to succeed in this role: At least 3+ years of commercial experience implementing, developing, or maintaining Big Data systems. Strong programming skills in Python : writing a clean code, OOP design. Experience in designing and implementing data governance and data management processes. Familiarity with Big Data technologies like Airflow or Dagster , Databricks, Spark and DBT . Experience implementing and deploying solutions in cloud environments (with a preference for Azure ). Knowledge of how to build and deploy Power BI reports and dashboards for data visualization. Excellent understanding of dimensional data and data modeling techniques. Excellent communication skills and consulting experience with direct interaction with clients. Ability to work independently and take ownership of project deliverables. Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. 🎁 Discover our perks & benefits: Work in a supportive team of passionate enthusiasts of AI & Big Data. Engage with top-tier global enterprises and cutting-edge startups on international projects. Enjoy flexible work arrangements, allowing you to work remotely or from modern offices and coworking spaces. Accelerate your professional growth through career development paths, knowledge-sharing initiatives, language classes, and sponsored training and conferences . Benefit from partnerships with Databricks and Anthropic , which provide access to industry-leading training materials and certification programs. Participate in team-building events and utilize the integration budget . Celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and milestones. Access medical and sports packages , eye care, and well-being support services, including psychotherapy and coaching. Get full work equipment for optimal productivity, including a laptop and other necessary devices. With our backing, you can boost your personal brand by speaking at conferences, writing for our blog, or participating in meetups. Experience a smooth onboarding with a dedicated buddy, and start your journey in our friendly, supportive, and autonomous culture. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Technical Product Owner, Data
items.summary: ** This is an opportunity to join our top-notch product delivery team working closely together on interesting projects for our clients.
items.description: ** This is an opportunity to join our top-notch product delivery team working closely together on interesting projects for our clients. This position is fully remote (indefinitely).** Emergent Software is looking for a Technical Product Owner (Data) with 5+ years of experience leading requirements gathering and delivery efforts for data engineering, analytics, and business intelligence projects. You will work closely with clients, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to define priorities, manage backlogs, and deliver modern data solutions that drive measurable business value. This 100% remote role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, experience working on cloud-based data platforms, and a solid understanding of data warehousing, reporting, governance, and agile delivery practices. Highlights & Benefits of working at Emergent Software Work closely with other talented software engineers and analysts . Our vetting process means you can count on your team members to know what they are talking about. Work from home or work remotely from anywhere you want Flexible work schedule meaning you can work regular hours or whenever you work best Work-life balance is essential and highly valued at Emergent Software . If you choose to work more than 40 hours, you’ll be compensated for the extra work! Work on interesting projects solving complex business problems with custom software. 100 hours per year to focus on your professional development . We invest in your growth! Profit sharing bonus means as we’re successful, you’re successful Excellent benefits package including medical insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, FSA, disability, life insurance, and paid parental leave Primary Duties Partner with clients to establish product vision and backlog Partner with clients to assist them in performing the Product Owner role In depth requirements gathering and analysis. Document requirements as Features and User Stories to share with team. Work with your team and client to create a plan for delivering on project objectives and achieving business value. Partner with technology teams to establish client technology roadmap Collaborate heavily with technology experts (architects and engineers) to vet requirements for technical feasibility. Speak with intelligence on technology topics to clients to establish trust and confidence. Partner with delivery teams to execute on established plans Communicate technical and business requirements to delivery team. Collaborate with senior delivery team members to solve complex challenges. Demonstrate strong understanding of custom software development concepts and best practices in all interactions. Ensure projects stay on target by regularly communicating status, risks, and change as they occur. Be a champion of the agile software development process Work directly with clients to manage project delivery while encouraging and fostering an agile delivery method. Apply agile concepts in real world settings, adapting principles to client’s level of agile sophistication and working to improve maturity over time. Own backlog health and communicate deviation to expected value delivery proactively. Act as a servant leader to your delivery team. Required Qualifications Product Ownership experience 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst on complex data engineering projects. Experience in delivering data engineering projects on modern cloud data platforms and familiarity with concepts around data warehousing, medallion architecture, Power BI, master data management, data governance, etc. Experience in crafting cost estimates to deliver components or entire projects. Strong technical writing, verbal communication, and presentation skills are a must. Experience operating as the liaison between agile development teams and users in defining requirements, performing business analysis, and driving delivery in the right direction. Technology knowledge Experience utilizing AI tools in product development, product delivery, or project management. A solid understanding of how websites, web applications, APIs, databases, and the cloud function at a high level. Strong technical background enabling you to provide credible leadership to development teams and accurately evaluate complex project risks and issues. Experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach Solid understanding of software development life cycle models including expert knowledge of Agile principles. Experience with agile work organization tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello, Basecamp, Rally). A proven track record of successfully implementing custom web application projects using Agile methodologies. Experience with Traditional Project Management concepts Experience with scope, schedule, budget, and risk management Must be viewed as a trusted source of truth by stakeholders through consistent, transparent, and confident communication. Owns the narrative around project delivery, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and reassured throughout the lifecycle. Occasional travel to client sites may be requested for activities such as annual planning meetings. Although travel is not expected to be frequent, the ability to accommodate occasional travel is required. Nice to Have Experience Strong preference towards candidates with experience delivering projects to client expectations, especially in a consulting capacity, software as a service environment, or delivering AI-accelerated (agentic) solutions. Industry recognized Agile process certification (PMI-ACP, Scrum Alliance CSM or CSPO, Scrum.org PAL, SAFe, or equivalent) Industry recognized Project management certification (PMP or equivalent) Microsoft Azure technology certifications (AZ-900, DP-900, AI-900) Experience on projects utilizing Microsoft stack technologies such as .NET, SQL Server, and Azure as well as JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, and Vue.js Some examples of profiles/backgrounds that we feel would do well in this role: Scrum master turned product owner Independent consultant with previous experience on agile delivery teams (any role) Someone who is a product owner with a passion for the technical side of software development Our Vetting Process At Emergent Software , we work hard to find the best analysts capable of delivering high quality software for our clients. If you think you’re one of those, please understand that the effort put into this by people like yourself helps us be successful in surrounding you with other top-notch people. Here are the steps of our vetting process for this position: Application (5 minutes) Online Assessment (40-50 minutes) Initial Phone Interview & Technology Knowledge Assessment (45 minutes) Challenge Interview (75 minutes) Final Interview (90 minutes) Job Offer! Benefits Package Details Medical Insurance: up to 90% of your monthly medical premium (HSA options available) HSA Contribution: up to $200month Dental & Vision Insurance: up to 50% of your monthly dental and vision premium costs 401(k) plan: company match up to 4% of salary Profit sharing bonus: up to 15% of salary paid quarterly Extra compensation: get paid extra for work over 40 hours/week Employee referral & customer referral bonuses Flex Spending Account (FSA) for Dependent Care & Healthcare Costs Dependent Care FSA Contribution: $90/month Short Term Disability: $500/week for 12 weeks Long Term Disability: up to $6,000/month Group term life and AD&D insurance: $50k PTO, standard holidays, 2 floating holidays Paid parental leave: 2 weeks Staff development program: 100 hours/year plus training costs About Emergent Software Emergent Software is a fast-growing software development, cloud consulting, and data engineering company serving clients across the country. We are regularly adding to our team of talented software engineers, cloud architects, data engineers, UX designers, technical product owners and more who can help us deliver high quality services for our clients. We are a remote-first company Since our inception, we've embraced a remote-friendly culture, promoting work flexibility beyond the norm. When the pandemic struck in 2020, our transition to fully remote work was seamless—just a matter of cleaning out the fridge. Recognizing an opportunity, we adopted a remote-first approach and began hiring talent from anywhere. We continue to offer our signature Minnesota-nice, Midwest-friendly attitude, ensuring everyone feels valued, whether or not they're familiar with the skyway system. Your career grows with us Working with talented engineers on interesting projects creates an engaging environment for software development enthusiasts. By working directly with our experienced team, participating in our staff development program, and solving complex problems across a variety of projects, you’ll find numerous opportunities for long-term career growth. At Emergent Software , your ideas will be heard, you will grow exponentially as a master of your craft, and you will enjoy working other dedicated team members to deliver software solutions for our clients. Check out what others say Visit our Glassdoor page to discover how employees enjoy our remote working structure, flexible hours, profit sharing program, and more! #EmergentSoftware #IND5 Highlights In this role, you'll plan and deliver projects by understanding scope, cost, and timeline, while tracking progress and communicating status, risks, and changes. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Functional Consultant - Contact Center
items.summary: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and…
items.description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission This role is a Functional Consultant - Contact Center focused on contact center modernization, responsible for leading discovery workshops with customer stakeholders and translating business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for Amazon Connect implementations. They use call listening and interaction analysis as a core discovery method, mining recorded voice and chat data to surface undocumented processes, score quality, and root-cause self-service containment failures, then convert those findings into AI agent scripts, process maps, and prioritized improvement recommendations. Serving as the primary liaison between customer stakeholders and Caylent's delivery team, they own BRDs, traceability matrices, and UAT facilitation while also mentoring junior BAs and contributing reusable discovery assets to strengthen the CXE practice. Requirements & Discovery Leads structured elicitation workshops with client stakeholders (contact center operations, IT, compliance) to document current-state processes, pain points, and target-state workflows, then breaks business requirements into discrete, ID-tagged functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria before design work is scheduled. Maps legacy contact center processes (e.g. Avaya, Genesys, NICE) to Amazon Connect capabilities, identifying gaps, configuration options, and where custom development is required - favoring configuration over customization. Builds and maintains the live link between every requirement ID, the design decision addressing it, the epic/story implementing it, and the test case validating it. Runs the review gate before design starts and the verification gate before release (i.e. no ticket enters a sprint, and no story closes, without a traced requirement ID) Owns the intake of requirement changes, logs impact to the RTM, and hands schedule/budget impact to the technical PM rather than letting scope drift silently.. Runs requirement walkthroughs with architects and engineers before design starts, and with QA before test design - catching ambiguity before it becomes code. Process & Data Analysis Analyze contact center KPIs (AHT, containment rate, CSAT/NPS, Retention) to baseline current performance and define measurable success criteria for engagements Partner with engineering to define data models for Customer Profiles, Cases, and the Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Athena, QuickSight), ensuring reporting requirements are captured up front Document AI agent and self-service requirements: call/chat intents, escalation paths, containment targets, and guardrail/compliance needs for AI-driven interactions Call Quality & Interaction Analysis Conduct structured call listening and quality assurance reviews across recorded voice and chat interactions, scoring them against defined quality criteria - compliance adherence, process accuracy, soft skills, and resolution quality and packaging findings into QA reports and trend summaries for customer stakeholders Use call listening as a process-discovery method: mine recorded interactions to surface undocumented business processes, decision points, exception paths, and agent workarounds, then codify what agents actually do into current-state process maps that validate or correct stakeholder-described workflows Translate documented business processes into structured AI agent scripts and call guides, greetings, identity verification, decision trees, objection and exception handling, required compliance language, and closing sequences that standardize agent behavior and feed training materials, knowledge bases, and agent-assist tooling (e.g., Amazon Q in Connect) Perform formal evaluations of calls, chats, and cases using evaluation forms and scorecards (e.g., Amazon Connect Evaluations with Contact Lens), and synthesize results into performance-trend reporting for operations leadership Analyze interactions that escaped self-service to root-cause containment failures, misrecognized intents, missing self-service capabilities, authentication friction, confusing prompts, or premature zero-outs and convert findings into prioritized, evidence-backed recommendations for IVR and AI improvements that measurably raise containment rates Stakeholder Collaboration & Documentation Serve as the day-to-day liaison between customer business stakeholders and the Caylent delivery team, managing scope clarifications and change requests Produce clear, well-organized documentation: business requirements documents (BRDs), process flow diagrams, current/future-state maps, and UAT test plans Facilitate UAT sessions, triage defects and enhancement requests with stakeholders, and prioritize backlog items against business value and delivery timelines Support project governance: status reporting, RAID logs, and steering committee materials for contact center modernization programs Practice Contribution Contribute reusable discovery templates, requirement checklists, and process maps back to the CXE practice so future engagements start further ahead Support pre-sales: participate in discovery calls, help scope SOWs, and provide business-analysis input on estimates for contact center engagements Mentor junior Functional Consultants on contact center domain concepts and Caylent's discovery methodology Your Qualifications 5+ years of business analysis experience, including 1+ years supporting contact center, CCaaS, or customer experience technology implementations 5+ years experience in analyzing call center interactions as a process discovery methodology for mining patterns in call center interactions. Working knowledge of using Amazon Connect or a comparable CCaaS platform (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) for finding, evaluating, and mining call center interactions. Demonstrated ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can build directly against Familiarity with contact center KPIs and operations concepts (AHT, containment, CSAT/NPS, SLA, Retention) Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills; comfortable running workshops with both business and technical audiences Proficiency with requirements and diagramming tools (i.e. Jira, Confluence, Lucidchart/Visio, Figma) and basic SQL or reporting-tool literacy Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Powerpoint) Preferred Qualifications Exposure to conversational AI / self-service requirements (Amazon Lex, Amazon Q in Connect, or comparable IVR/chatbot platforms) Experience in regulated verticals: government/public sector, healthcare (HIPAA), or financial services Consulting or client-delivery background Experience with data visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) Experience in Python Experience with AI tools Benefits 100% remote work Generous holidays and flexible PTO Competitive phantom equity Paid for exams and certifications Peer bonus awards State of the art laptop and tools Equipment & Office Stipend Individual professional development plan Annual stipend for Learning and Development Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time. At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements. These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals. If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner. If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com Caylent is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

items.summary: It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!
items.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing! Software Product Manager Location: Remote Position Summary The Software Product Manager is responsible for defining and leading the strategy, roadmap, delivery, adoption, performance, and lifecycle of assigned software products and platform capabilities. This role serves as the voice of the customer and market, translating validated user problems, business objectives, product data, technical constraints, and competitive insights into clear outcomes, prioritized investments, and executable plans. As a key member of the Platform Product Management team, the Software Product Manager owns assigned software products and platform capabilities from problem discovery and business-case development through delivery, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement. This position is accountable for establishing a compelling product vision, defining measurable outcomes, and making evidence-based prioritization decisions that improve customer value, revenue growth, retention, operational efficiency, and strategic differentiation. The Software Product Manager works closely with Product Design, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Quality Assurance, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Regulatory, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Support, and regional teams. Success in this role requires the ability to lead through influence, balance customer and business needs with technical considerations, and enable agile teams to deliver secure, scalable, accessible, and supportable software solutions. Essential Functions Define and communicate product vision, strategy, target customers, value proposition, positioning, and measurable objectives in alignment with portfolio and company goals. Lead continuous product discovery through customer interviews, workflow observation, usage analysis, market research, competitive analysis, and concept or prototype validation. Translate validated customer problems and strategic opportunities into outcome-based roadmaps, product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release goals, and prioritized backlogs. Apply consistent prioritization methods and make clear tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, delivery effort, technical health, risk, and time to learning. Partner closely with Engineering and Product Design throughout discovery and delivery to clarify intent, reduce ambiguity, review progress, and adapt scope based on learning. Define product and feature success measures, instrumentation, and dashboards. Evaluate adoption, activation, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, product quality, cost-to-serve, and revenue impact. Run experiments and post-launch reviews, using customer feedback and product data to determine whether to iterate, scale, reposition, or discontinue investments. Own the full software product lifecycle, including release planning, launch readiness, adoption, maintenance, migrations, deprecation, end-of-life planning, and customer communications. Partner with Engineering, R&D, Portfolio Owners, Quality Assurance, Security, Privacy, and Regulatory teams to incorporate scalability, reliability, interoperability, data governance, compliance, accessibility, supportability, and technical debt into product decisions. Guide platform, API, integration, data, and entitlement decisions to support cohesive customer workflows and sustainable product architecture. Develop business cases and contribute to pricing, packaging, forecasting, investment planning, and build-buy-partner recommendations. Lead go-to-market and release-readiness planning with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Training, and regional teams. Support positioning, enablement, documentation, migration, and adoption planning for new and existing software capabilities. Provide concise, decision-oriented updates regarding outcomes, roadmap changes, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and tradeoffs to customers, delivery teams, stakeholders, and senior leaders. Promote modern product management practices, responsible and ethical use of data and AI where applicable, and a culture of customer empathy, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Product Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Design, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of software product management experience. Experience owning customer-facing software, SaaS products, enterprise applications, digital platforms, or data products from discovery through post-launch optimization. Demonstrated experience delivering software capabilities and improving measurable customer or business outcomes. Experience with product discovery, product strategy, roadmapping, prioritization, requirements definition, agile product delivery, launch management, adoption, optimization, and lifecycle planning. Experience developing product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release goals, and prioritized product backlogs. Experience working with cross-functional Engineering, Design, Quality, Security, Data, Commercial, Customer Success, and Support teams. Ability to define and track product KPIs and use data to evaluate customer behavior and product performance. Technical understanding of modern software concepts including cloud services, APIs, integrations, data models, identity and access management, observability, release pipelines, and architectural tradeoffs. Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to influence without direct authority and create alignment across cross-functional and distributed teams. Ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and product collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, Power BI, or comparable platforms. Schedule flexibility to collaborate with international teams across multiple time zones. Preferred Qualifications Experience with B2B software products, regulated industries, laboratory workflows, food safety, connected instruments, or global products. Experience using SQL, product analytics tools, or business intelligence platforms to evaluate product performance. Experience analyzing funnels, cohorts, experiments, adoption metrics, and customer behavior. Working knowledge of secure software development, privacy by design, accessibility, regulatory or quality requirements, and operational resilience. Experience supporting platform, API, integration, data, or entitlement strategy. Experience with pricing, packaging, forecasting, investment planning, or build-buy-partner analysis. Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of how product decisions affect revenue, retention, margin, customer value, and cost-to-serve. Experience leading go-to-market, release-readiness, customer migration, and product adoption initiatives. Experience with responsible use of artificial intelligence, data, or emerging technologies within software products. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong customer empathy and product judgment. Ability to identify meaningful customer problems and define measurable desired outcomes. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Ability to balance customer desirability, business viability, technical feasibility, usability, reliability, and risk. Strong understanding of software product development and agile delivery practices. Ability to translate complex technical and business concepts into clear product direction. Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities. Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Physical Demands There are no significant physical demands associated with this role. Work Environment This position is remote. The employee is responsible for maintaining an appropriate remote work environment that allows them to perform the essential functions of the position effectively. About Neogen Neogen is a global leader in food safety, animal safety, genomics, and related solutions that help protect the world’s food supply. Our products and services support customers across agriculture, food production, laboratories, animal health, and other industries where safety, quality, and reliability matter. At Neogen, we are committed to creating an environment where employees can contribute, grow, and do meaningful work. We value collaboration, accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and a strong focus on our customers. Neogen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters! From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too. items.title: Palantir Data Engineer
items.summary: Job Summary:We are looking for a Palantir Data Engineer to join our data engineering team!
items.description: Job Summary: We are looking for a Palantir Data Engineer to join our data engineering team! We are seeking someone with experience in Palantir Foundry and PySpark or Python. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain complex data pipelines, optimize data workflows within the Palantir platform, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to unlock data-driven insights. If you're passionate about working with cutting-edge technologies to tackle complex business challenges, this role is for you! Key Responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and pipelines within the Palantir Foundry ecosystem. Integrate, process, and manage large datasets from multiple sources, ensuring seamless data flow across the organization. Optimize data workflows and maintain high performance of data pipelines, leveraging Palantir's capabilities. Collaborate with Data Analysts and other teams to understand and implement technical data requirements. Ensure data quality, security, and compliance in all data operations. Troubleshoot, monitor, and resolve data issues to ensure smooth and efficient operations. Continuously explore and implement best practices in data engineering and keep up-to-date with Palantir's evolving tools and technologies. Requirements Required Skills and Qualifications: Proven experience in data engineering, data integration, and ETL/ELT processes, ideally within the Palantir platform. Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python or equivalent, particularly within a Palantir Foundry environment. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms Excellent problem-solving and business analysis skills, with the ability to navigate complex data structures and systems. Solid understanding of data security principles, compliance, and best practices. Strong communication and collaboration skills to work across multidisciplinary teams. English language is required, German language is an advantage. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Palantir Foundry, including Foundry's ontology, data lineage, and model management features. Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI, or Palantir's built-in visualization capabilities. Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries, and how they integrate within Palantir Foundry. Experience with CI/CD practices is a plus. Experience with agile development methodologies and delivering in agile environments. Previous experience in mentoring or leading a team of data engineers or analysts. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: FlexTrade Systems: FlexTrade Systems is a provider of customized multi-asset execution and order management trading solutions for buy- and sell-side financial institutions. Through deep client partnerships with some of the world's largest, most complex and demanding capital markets firms, we develop the flexible tools, technology and innovation that deliver our clients a competitive edge. Our globally distributed engineering teams focus on adaptable technology and open architecture to develop highly sophisticated trading solutions that can automate and scale with your business strategies. At FlexTrade , we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. We are dedicated to giving our clients a competitive edge, taking ownership of our responsibilities, being flexible to adapt to ever changing environment and technology, bringing integrity to ever interaction and we continue to improve, grow together and collaborate as one team. All of these while having Fun truly makes FlexTrade a wonderful place to work . About You: The Manager - Sales Strategy & Business Operations will report to the Global Lead, Sales Strategy & Business Operations. The individual will be a self-starter, with a hands-on consultative management style with proven structured approach to identify, initiate, manage & control multiple short to medium term business initiatives and projects The individual will be responsible for working across functions and bring operational expertise to enable key global transformation initiatives. This role will be at the forefront in managing the change initiatives to accelerate growth, with a focus on key commercial functions – sales and client services Requirements Business Operations Partner with multiple functional and line of business individuals globally including but not limited to: Sales, Client Services, Marketing, HR and Finance Develop & improve analytics dashboards/report for key stakeholders Reinforce and maintain key operational metrics, market intelligence and improvement programs. Facilitate workshops/sprints for project management and tracking Vendor management Data management – Ensure Salesforce, LinkSquares and other tool data is up to date. Relevant reports and dashboards are readily available for management AI/Copilot Implementation across Functions Partner with multiple functional and line of business leaders globally to enhance / develop customized Copilot Agents in Microsoft Copilot, Claude Cowork, Salesforce (& potentially other solutions in future) Help improve the AI adoption by working closely with key business/functional leads & teams Ability to author / correct JSON for agent configuration using Copilot Studio Work with 3rd parties to understand developing technologies & innovation in AI & contextualize/leverage that knowledge/skill within the organization Sales Operations Work closely with sales team members to monitor the performance metrics and initiatives to ensure sales organization success Ensure new initiatives are being monitored and tracked diligently based on feedback from sales Identify top market/competitor trends in terms of sales and operations best practices to ensure our project/initiatives portfolio is prioritizing the right initiatives Identify opportunities for sales process improvement and foster an environment continuous improvement. Client Service Operations Work closely with Client Services to capture client/broker feedback, analyze, synthesize, and present key pain-points and improvement opportunities resulting in project pipeline and prioritization Analyze the end-to-end client services experience to identify and prioritize key issues and opportunities Prioritize implementation of automated solutions through Salesforce and help to prioritize roadmap initiatives based on business and client impact Identify opportunities for process improvement and foster an environment of continuous improvement. Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Finance, Business Administration or other affiliated specialties like Engineering, MBA, or equivalent preferred 7+ years in progressive functional business and/or operations roles with demonstrated experience in Technology Implementation/ Project Management and/or sales improvement /transformation Management/technology/business transformation experience Previous experience working in a financial service and/or technology company. Familiarity with Trading and Order/Execution Management Systems and/or subscription-based business models a plus High proficiency in project management & analytical / data visualization tools such as advanced Excel & Power BI is a must Strong understanding of Generative AI with hands-on experience in Context Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic Workflows. Experience working with modern AI-assisted productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Claude CoWork. Basic knowledge and experience of structured data using JSON will be a strong advantage. Proven experience working with public LLM APIs, such as OpenAI Response API and OpenAI Agents SDK. Strong knowledge of Model Context Protocol – Practical experience in building MCP servers using frameworks like FastMCP is a plus but not mandatory Proficiency with or similar CRMs - Contract Lifecycle Management, Jira, Service Now etc is preferred Ability to convey confidence, respect and trust, as well as maintain confidentiality of all company information Strong ability to drive and manage global projects to completion, communicating a clear vision, while effectively managing different stakeholders Strong conflict resolution and problem-solving abilities – Ability to develop partnerships with functional teams *** FlexTrade Systems, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by law.*** Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from…
items.description: About Carrot : Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Sr. Manager, Data Engineering to lead our Business Intelligence data engineering function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is a senior player/coach role with a strong emphasis on strategic leadership, technical excellence, and organizational impact. You will lead and grow a high-impact team while remaining deeply hands-on in architecting and building Carrot's data infrastructure. You will set technical vision, drive cross-functional data strategy, and ensure our data systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. You will influence and execute on the long-term roadmap for Data Engineering within the Data Team, defining how we ingest, transform, govern, and expose data across the company, and partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, and Go-To-Market functions. Given the small-but-mighty nature of the team, this role requires someone who is comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: setting multi-year architectural direction, shaping team and org design, and still rolling up their sleeves to build production-grade pipelines when needed. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Own the technical vision and roadmap for BI data engineering, aligning it with company strategy and analytics needs. Design, build, and review scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and workflow orchestration systems, contributing hands-on production code in Python and SQL . Architect and optimize data warehouse models that support advanced analytics, self-service BI, and operational reporting. Establish and enforce standards for reliability, observability, testing, and performance across all data systems. Drive improvements in data quality, lineage, and governance , including documentation and metadata practices. Partner with backend product engineering teams to co-design production database schemas and event models with analytics and reporting in mind. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers , fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration. Own team-level planning and execution , including capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery across concurrent workstreams. Translate ambiguous business and analytics needs into a clear, prioritized engineering roadmap with measurable outcomes. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Security, and Legal to align on priorities, ensure compliance, and remove cross-functional blockers. Evaluate and influence build vs. buy decisions , vendor selection, and tool adoption across data platforms, ingestion, and transformation. What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Elevated the maturity and consistency of data engineering practices across the BI function, with clear standards for reliability, testing, and observability. Built and retained a high-performing data engineering team recognized as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the business. Delivered a prioritized data engineering roadmap aligned with company strategy, with measurable progress on scalability and platform modernization. Strengthened the accuracy, recency, and security of enterprise data, meeting the requirements of regulated healthcare contexts. Enabled advanced analytics, self-service BI, and data products that drive meaningful business outcomes and influence Carrot's long-term data architecture strategy. About You ✨ You likely have: 8-10+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, including 3-5+ years leading and managing data or software engineers. 5+ years of advanced SQL and 5+ years of Python development experience in production environments, including unit and integration testing. Strong, hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines in production. Proficiency with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and modern ingestion, transformation, and orchestration tools (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, Airflow). Strong understanding of relational modeling and warehouse design principles , plus version control (Git preferred) and modern CI/CD practices. Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy and standards while remaining capable of direct technical execution. Excellent written and verbal communication skills , with strong knowledge of data governance, security best practices, and compliance protocols. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Direct experience with Carrot's current tech stack : Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, and AWS. Experience with enterprise BI platforms and enabling self-service analytics. Experience integrating batch and event-streaming or real-time ingestion systems . Prior experience leading data engineering teams in a startup or high-growth environment , ideally including managing other leads or senior-level ICs. Healthcare industry experience , including familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) and privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR). Why This Role Matters The reliability, scalability, and usability of Carrot's data systems directly power decision-making across the organization and for our clients. Data Engineering plays a foundational role in enabling the broader Business Intelligence function, and this role serves as the senior-most manager directly responsible for that capability. The Business Intelligence team at Carrot is highly cross-functional and central to the company's long-term success. Led by our Vice President of Data and Business Intelligence, the team includes data engineers, data scientists, and business intelligence analysts. In this role, you will build and nurture a high-performing team, ensure the accuracy and security of enterprise data in a regulated healthcare context, and influence the long-term data architecture and platform strategy at Carrot. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation: Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $170,000-$210,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

Dabei übersetzt du ihre Unternehmensziele in greifbare Daten- & KI-Strategien. Als erste:r Ansprechpartner:in begleitest du sie auf Augenhöhe von der Vision bis zur Umsetzung. Gemeinsam schärft ihr die Anforderungen, entwickelt Roadmaps und validiert innovative Lösungen. In der dynamischen Data & AI-Landschaft behältst du den Überblick, ordnest neue Technologien sinnvoll ein und integrierst sie effizient in Daten- und KI-Services. Übersetzer:in zwischen Tech & Business: Es fällt dir leicht, komplexe Inhalte zielgruppengerecht zu übersetzen. Die Sprache von Entwickler:innen sprichst du genauso sicher wie die des C-Levels. items.title: Middle/Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
items.summary: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale.
items.description: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale. At MGID , we empower brands and publishers to collaborate transparently through our privacy-first targeting technology. This enables advertisers to drive performance and awareness while allowing publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we’re creating innovative technologies, and with your help, we aim to reach even greater heights. We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst who is passionate about turning complex commercial data into clear business decisions and measurable growth. You will play a key role at the intersection of Business Intelligence and commercial strategy, partnering closely with Sales, Finance, and senior leadership to shape how we measure performance, identify growth opportunities, and drive strategic initiatives. We are looking for a proactive, business-minded professional who enjoys challenging assumptions, uncovering actionable insights, and transforming data into recommendations that influence business outcomes. If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and enjoy building scalable analytics frameworks that support smarter decision-making, we'd love to meet you. Requirements Who You Are: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Analytics, Engineering or a related field Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in business analysis, commercial analytics, or a similar role. Prior experience working with commercial or sales teams in medium to large organizations is highly preferred. Strong hands-on experience with SQL and BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI, including dashboard development and translating business needs into effective visual reporting. Industry experience in fintech, e-commerce, digital marketing, or digital technology is strongly preferred. Demonstrated ability to work with commercial data, generate insights, and support strategic decision-making. What You’ll Do: Support the Commercial team with data-driven decision-making by delivering actionable insights and performance analysis. Review, optimize, and drive client acquisition and rewards programs across both supply and demand sides of the business. Analyze product usage, customer behavior, acquisition funnels, and client lifecycle data to identify opportunities for growth, retention, and monetization. Partner with Product, Data, Sales, and Finance teams to evaluate how product initiatives and new features influence commercial performance. Conduct cohort, segmentation, funnel, and performance analysis to uncover business drivers and support product and commercial decisions. Introduce and standardize methodologies for client referral programs to ensure consistency and measurable impact. Analyze the customer acquisition journey and implement a unified client lifecycle framework and common business definitions across the organization. Support the development, review, and company-wide rollout of key performance indicators. Provide sales projections and commercial performance analysis across global markets. Prepare quarterly sales forecasts as part of the regular business planning cycle. Define and implement the necessary metrics to evaluate commercial performance and monitor strategic initiatives. Forecast, assess, and track the performance of new projects and individual campaigns led by commercial teams. Languages proficiency: Ukrainian - Fluent (nice to have) English - Advanced At MGID , we thrive on innovation, collaboration, and a passion for AdTech. Our culture is built on openness, transparency, and a shared drive for excellence. We empower our teams to take bold steps, embrace challenges, and grow together in a dynamic, people-first environment. Here, your ideas matter, your contributions are valued, and your potential has no limits. Join us and shape the futureof digital advertising! By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understand the MGID Careers Privacy Notice and understand that your personal data will be processed for recruitment purposes as part of this application. You have the right to access, rectify, or erase your data, as well as to object to its processing. We want you to be in control of your personal data. You can request data correction or request to be deleted from our database. Highlights Drive smarter commercial decisions through data-driven insights, forecasting, and performance analytics. items.title: Head of Data
items.summary: Are you a data-driven leader who thrives at the intersection of business and technology?
items.description: Are you a data-driven leader who thrives at the intersection of business and technology? As Head of Data at Digital Forms , you will be responsible for translating business goals into measurable outcomes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their challenges, design actionable KPIs, and implement the data flows and dashboards needed to drive decision-making. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on data expertise, and outstanding communication skills. You’ll be a key player in delivering high-impact digital transformation solutions for our international clients. Requirements Responsibilities Lead the company’s data strategy in alignment with business objectives and client goals. Work closely with clients to understand their business context, define success metrics, and design clear, actionable KPIs. Design and implement efficient data flows, pipelines, and architectures for business intelligence and reporting. Build and manage dashboards that support executive-level decision-making and operational optimization. Translate complex data insights into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including tech, marketing, and sales, to deliver data-driven solutions. Identify opportunities to improve data processes, reporting, and automation internally and for clients. items.description: About Avary.ai Avary.ai is building an AI-native recruiting platform designed to make hiring faster, more efficient, and more consistent. Our platform automates key parts of the recruiting workflow, including resume screening, AI-powered structured interviews, candidate evaluation, interview reporting, and hiring workflow orchestration. As a Data Scientist Intern , you will work with real recruiting and interview data and help us improve the intelligence behind Avary’s candidate evaluation and hiring decision-support systems. What You’ll Work On You will work closely with Avary’s engineering and product teams on practical data science problems across candidate evaluation, recruiting analytics, and AI system quality. Depending on the project, your work may include: Analyze structured and unstructured recruiting data, including resumes, interview responses, candidate evaluation results, and hiring funnel data. Develop metrics and analytical frameworks for measuring candidate quality, interview performance, evaluation consistency, and recruiting efficiency. Analyze AI interviewer and LLM-generated evaluation results to identify patterns, failure cases, bias, and opportunities for improvement. Design experiments to evaluate different prompts, interview strategies, scoring rubrics, and AI evaluation models. Build statistical or machine learning models for problems such as candidate-job matching, candidate ranking, interview outcome analysis, and recruiting funnel prediction. Develop datasets and evaluation pipelines for measuring the quality of LLM-based recruiting systems. Perform exploratory data analysis and communicate findings through dashboards, visualizations, and concise analytical reports. Work with product and engineering teams to turn analytical insights into product improvements. Help establish data quality checks, experiment tracking, and reproducible analytical workflows. Explore new applications of machine learning and generative AI in recruiting and talent intelligence. Example Projects Projects may include: Candidate Evaluation Analysis: Study the relationship between interview answers, AI evaluation scores, recruiter decisions, and hiring outcomes. LLM Evaluation Framework: Build benchmarks and metrics to measure the consistency and quality of AI-generated candidate assessments. Resume–Job Matching: Develop or evaluate models that measure how well a candidate’s experience and skills match a job description. Interview Quality Analytics: Analyze interview questions and candidate responses to determine which signals are most useful for candidate assessment. Recruiting Funnel Analytics: Identify bottlenecks and conversion patterns across application, screening, interview, and hiring stages. Evaluation Calibration: Analyze scoring distributions and help improve the consistency of candidate evaluation across jobs and interview sessions. AI Experimentation: Run controlled experiments comparing prompts, models, evaluation rubrics, or interview strategies. What We’re Looking For Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning , or a related technical field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with Python and common data analysis libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. Working knowledge of SQL and relational data analysis. Understanding of statistics, probability, experimental design, and data visualization. Familiarity with machine learning concepts and common ML workflows. Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical teammates. Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment and independently exploring ambiguous problems. Nice to Have Experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow . Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, or AI agents . Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, benchmarking, or human/AI evaluation workflows. Experience analyzing text or other unstructured data using NLP techniques. Experience with visualization or BI tools. Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, ranking systems, recommendation systems, or information retrieval. Experience working with production datasets, data pipelines, or cloud platforms. What You’ll Learn During the internship, you will gain hands-on experience with: Applying data science to a real AI SaaS product. Evaluating and improving production LLM and AI-agent systems. Designing metrics and experiments for AI product development. Working with real-world recruiting and interview datasets. Translating analytical findings into product and engineering decisions. Building data science workflows in an early-stage AI startup. Collaborating directly with founders and engineers on production-facing projects. Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who enjoys going beyond simply training a model. You should be interested in understanding why a system behaves the way it does, how to measure whether it is actually working, and how data can be used to improve the product . You do not need to know everything before joining. We value strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to learn quickly. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Data and Analytics SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. GATEWAY FLEET SPECIALIST: Starlink is building the world’s largest fleet of satellite ground stations. These gateways are the critical link between our satellites and the global internet backbone, and their reliability directly determines the quality of service for millions of users. We are seeking fleet specialists to own the reliability, growth, and sustainment of our fleet of Gateway antennas and sites across a region of the world. This is a true owner-operator role, managing everything from technical troubleshooting and spare parts strategy to international logistics, contractor performance, and field execution. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building operational excellence in fast-moving and internationally complex environments. You must be equally comfortable managing heavy equipment deployments in remote locations as you are negotiating with customs authorities and coaching contractors toward higher performance standards. RESPONSIBILITIES: Own the maintenance, operations, health, and growth for our fleet of Starlink Gateway Antennas and Sites for a region of the world Manage spare parts strategy, inventory planning, and materials movement across the region, to maintain rapid response readiness for both planned and emergency maintenance Monitor fleet health using dashboards and telemetry data to identify issues, diagnose software and hardware failures, drive timely repairs, and identify emerging degradation trends. Partner with engineering teams to execute fleetwide campaigns and perform root cause analysis on antenna and site failures across electrical, fiber optic, radiofrequency, and mechanical systems Coordinate with logistics providers, customs authorities, and regional partners to ensure timely and compliant international shipping of critical parts and equipment Manage relationships with contracted labor in the region, including training and capability development Analyze operational data and field feedback to identify systemic pain points and drive improvements in processes and tools Share ownership of the team’s growth: work with engineers and specialists to build scalable organizational structures that can support the rapid expansion of the world’s largest fleet of satellite ground stations. Basic Qualifications: High school diploma or equivalency certificate 2+ years of experience operations, logistics, technical support, field service, data analytics, project management, or a similar role involving distributed assets PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 1+ years of experience in a customer support associate, technical support associate, quality specialist, process planner, business analyst, or leadership role Hands on experience with satellite ground stations, antennas; electrical, fiber optic, radiofrequency, or mechanical systems Experience supporting geographically distributed technical equipment or infrastructure Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL and/or other data visualization tools Background in root cause analysis and cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams Experience managing contractors or third-party vendors, particularly in international or remote environments Familiarity with MRP/ERP systems and spare parts/inventory management Proficiency in one or more of the following languages (in addition to English): Portuguese, French, Punjabi, Hindi, Japanese, Bengali, Kazakh, Arabic, Urdu, Vietnamese, Swahili, Sesotho, Swati, Tagalog. Knowledge of local business culture is a plus Experience troubleshooting or working with IT/network infrastructure (UPS, PDUs, servers, or networking equipment) Demonstrated ability to design efficient processes and systems, especially defining requirements for software tools Experience autonomously managing projects with minimal supervision ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Willing to travel 10-15% of the time Willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed Willing to work outside of normal business hours 20-40% if the time COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay Range: Level 1: $27.00 - $40.00 Level 2: $31.00 - $45.00 Level 3: $36.00 - $51.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday. ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

items.description: At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. We're looking for a Staff Analyst, GTM Revenue to help our go-to-market leaders make sharper, faster decisions across revenue-critical motions. In this role, you'll partner across Sales, Customer Success, and adjacent customer-facing teams to turn complex data into practical insight, improve how teams operate, and identify where AI and automation can create real leverage. This is a high-impact opportunity for an analytically rigorous operator who can move comfortably between deep analysis, business partnership, and hands-on execution. You'll help leaders understand what's working, where friction is slowing growth, and how to translate data into better decisions around pipeline, segmentation, productivity, retention, and overall GTM performance. Mission Drive clearer, faster, and more scalable GTM decision-making by turning data into actionable insight, operational improvements, and AI-enabled workflows that improve revenue performance and customer outcomes. The Role Partner with GTM leaders to frame business questions, prioritize high-impact analyses, and translate findings into practical recommendations. Build and maintain dashboards, reporting layers, and analytical workflows that give stakeholders clear visibility into performance across Sales, Customer Success, and related customer-facing motions. Analyze pipeline health, segmentation, conversion, retention, and productivity trends to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and better resource allocation. Develop forecasting, scenario-planning, and decision-support models that help leaders understand performance drivers and act with confidence. Use SQL, Python, and modern analytics tooling to extract, shape, and analyze large datasets from multiple systems. Identify repetitive or manual workflows that can be improved through automation or AI-assisted analysis, and help bring those solutions into day-to-day GTM operations. Collaborate cross-functionally with partners in Finance, Operations, Systems, and customer-facing teams to ensure data definitions, reporting logic, and recommendations are aligned to business needs. Present insights in a concise, executive-ready way, tailoring the level of detail to both technical and non-technical audiences. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in analytics, strategy & operations, revenue operations, business intelligence, or a similar role supporting go-to-market teams. Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with strong judgment around how to use each for analysis, automation, and scalable reporting. Strong experience building dashboards, analytical models, and KPI frameworks that influence business decisions. Demonstrated success supporting Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, or comparable GTM functions in a SaaS or other fast-moving technology environment. Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data trends to customer, commercial, and operational outcomes. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex analysis and influence cross-functional stakeholders. Proven ability to work independently in ambiguous environments, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality work with speed and reliability. Desirable Experience applying AI or machine learning to business problems such as segmentation, prioritization, forecasting support, or workflow automation. Familiarity with modern BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms. Experience working in a high-growth, multi-motion SaaS business where GTM teams need both strategic insight and operational rigor. Comfort partnering with senior leaders on ambiguous questions that require both analytical depth and strong business judgment. Equal Opportunity Employer ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.
