items.description: Who We Are: Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. About the Role: We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to own and execute the vision for our data transformation layer. You will be at the heart of our data platform, which processes hundreds of millions of events daily from a wide array of sources, including transactional databases, API logs, CRMs, payment systems, and marketing platforms. You will join our 100% remote team and work closely with Data Engineers (who manage data ingestion) and Data Scientists and Business Users (who consume your data models). Your primary responsibility will be to use dbt and Trino on our GCP-based, open-source data infrastructure to build robust, scalable data models. These models are critical for stakeholders across the company—from finance and operations to the executive team—and are delivered via BI tools, reports, and reverse ETL systems. What You'll Do: Own the Transformation Layer: Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt and SQL to support diverse business needs, from monthly financial reporting to near-real-time operational metrics. Set Technical Standards: Establish and enforce best practices for data modelling, development, testing, and monitoring to ensure data quality, integrity (up to cent-level precision), and discoverability. Enable Stakeholders: Collaborate directly with finance, operations, customer success, and marketing teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable data products. Integrate and Deliver: Create repeatable patterns for integrating our data models with BI tools and reverse ETL processes, enabling consistent metric reporting across the business. Ensure Quality: Champion high standards for development, including robust change management, source control, code reviews, and data monitoring as our products and data evolve. What You Need (Must-Haves): 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering or data engineering with a strong focus on the "T" (transformation) in ELT. Proven track record of owning data products end-to-end, applying analytics and data engineering best practices to ensure data quality, scalability, and robust data models. Comfortable working with ambiguity and collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements; able to take ownership with minimal oversight in a fast-paced environment. Experience proactively identifying and implementing improvements to data warehouse performance and ETL efficiency. Technical Versatility: Expert-level SQL and DBT skills for complex queries and data transformations. Proficiency in Python for transformations that extend beyond SQL. Hands-on experience with query optimization across OLTP and OLAP systems (e.g., Postgres, Iceberg). Proficiency with Semantic Layer modelling (e.g. Cube, dbt Semantic Layer). Experience owning CI/CD workflows and establishing team-wide standards for version control and code review (e.g., Git). Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP or AWS). Nice to Haves: Experience with data ingestion tools (e.g., Airbyte) and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow). Domain experience for brokerage operations or a passion for financial markets and modelling financial datasets. How We Take Care of You: Competitive Salary & Stock Options Health Benefits New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500 Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. items.title: Customer Manager - Quality & Insights
items.summary: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
items.description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us? What's the position? As Customer Quality & Insights Manager, you will build and lead how Hard Rock Digital understands and acts on customer sentiment. This is a zero-to-one role: the function doesn't exist yet, and you will be the one to organize various efforts into one cohesive strategy — the reporting, the process, and eventually the team. At the center of the role is a closed loop, and running that loop well is the actual job: identify where sentiment is slipping, diagnose what's driving it, get the finding to the team who can fix it, and then track what happens after the fix ships to confirm it actually moved the needle. Anything short of closing the loop is just reporting; closing it is what makes the role valuable. You will organize diagnosis around three pillars that drive customer sentiment: Person (how interactions are handled), Product (how our app and platform perform for customers), and Policy (how our processes and rules affect the experience). Your job is to find the story in the data and hand stakeholders something specific they can act on — not to audit or score individual performance. When a finding touches an individual interaction, your role is to surface the pattern and hand it to the team that owns coaching or process change, not to run that conversation yourself. This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Operations Strategy & Insights. There are no direct reports today, but as the function grows, so will this team. You will work alongside the existing BI Operations function — the two teams are parallel, and you'll partner closely with them on shared data and stakeholder context. Responsibilities Building the function Stand up the customer sentiment/insights function: the reporting, the classification taxonomy, and the closed-loop process end to end. Define and own how the loop works across the org — from issue identification through post-implementation impact tracking — so stakeholders know how to engage with findings and recommendations. Build the case for future headcount and, if approved, onboard and manage a Quality & Insights Analyst. Represent the Insights function in cross-functional forums as the org's point of contact for customer sentiment. Sentiment measurement & reporting Build and maintain CSAT and sentiment reporting that gives stakeholders a clear, ongoing view of customer sentiment trends. Design and evolve a sentiment taxonomy that reliably classifies feedback into the Person, Product, and Policy pillars. Mine reviews, support tickets, surveys, and other qualitative feedback sources for sentiment signal, using AI tools to accelerate classification and pattern detection. Track sentiment trends over time and proactively surface emerging issues before they show up as escalations. Diagnosing what's driving sentiment When sentiment dips or a pattern emerges, dig into the underlying story: is it how an interaction was handled, a product friction point, or a policy/process design issue? Distinguish one-off incidents from systemic patterns, and prioritize investigations toward the issues with the greatest sentiment impact. Turn what you find into a clear, specific narrative stakeholders can act on — the goal is to explain what's driving the pattern, not to audit or score any individual's performance. Closing the loop Route findings to the team best positioned to act on them (people leadership, product, policy/process owners) with a specific, actionable recommendation. Maintain a running view of every open issue's status in the loop: identified, diagnosed, routed, and resolved. Track outcomes after a fix ships to confirm whether it actually moved sentiment, and close the loop back to the original finding. Present findings and loop status clearly to stakeholders, including team leads and cross-functional partners who own the Product and Policy pillars. Build data-backed business cases when a recommendation requires investment, prioritization, or a change to an existing process. Data foundation Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate sentiment and CSAT data across large, complex datasets. Validate data integrity and ensure sentiment classifications and diagnostic findings are grounded in accurate, well-understood sources. Create and maintain clear documentation for sentiment definitions, classification methodology, and recurring reports. Collaborate with the BI Operations team on shared data, metrics, and stakeholder context to ensure consistency across functions. Requirements What are we looking for? 6–9 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, customer experience, or a related field, including experience owning a function, workstream, or reporting capability with significant ambiguity. Proficient SQL skills, including the ability to write and join queries across multiple data sources (CSAT, NPS, support systems) to build reporting independently. Experience building and maintaining dashboards or reporting (Tableau or similar) that stakeholders rely on directly. Demonstrated ability to diagnose the underlying driver behind a pattern in customer feedback and turn it into a specific, actionable recommendation. Experience using AI tools within an analytical workflow, including sentiment classification, text analysis, or LLM-assisted review of qualitative feedback. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn analysis into a recommendation and land it with stakeholders who don't report to you. Comfort working across both quantitative data (CSAT scores, trend lines) and qualitative material (reviews, transcripts, case notes). Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Business, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Nice to have Prior experience building or standing up a new reporting function or capability from the ground up. People management experience. Familiarity with contact center or customer support operations and workflows. Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse. Python experience, particularly for text/sentiment analysis (pandas, NLTK, or similar). Experience in iGaming, online sportsbook, casino, or a regulated industry environment. What’s in it for you? We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include: Competitive pay and benefits Flexible vacation allowance A hybrid / remote working environment Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer). Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Company Description At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es Why join us? Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference. At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on. ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success. Job Description Docplanner's Customer Success organisation serves hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals across 13 markets. Two global business lines sit at the centre of that effort, Individual Doctors and Clinics, each led by a VP who needs sharp, reliable analytics to grow their business and make decisions with confidence. This role sits within Global Customer Success Operations & Analytics, the team that acts as the connective layer between the business and Docplanner's data organisation: BI (dashboard and data standardisation), Data Platform (infrastructure, architecture, DWH), and Product Analytics (product launches and opportunities). This role is dedicated to one business line, partnering closely with that VP and their leadership team on the deep dives, data models, dashboards, and experiments needed to run and grow the business across our 13 markets. You'll report to the Global CS Ops analytics manager, who sets the team's priorities and supports big projects the team takes on. Within that frame, you own how your own time is spent day to day, prioritizing incoming asks, sequencing your backlog, and deciding what needs your manager's input versus what you can resolve directly with your business and data stakeholders. How will you make an impact? Reporting, dashboards & data models Build and maintain the recurring reporting, dashboards (Tableau, superset), and data models your business line runs on Build and maintain automations that scale across markets Keep outputs consistent with BI's dashboard and data standards, escalating gaps rather than working around them Analytical models: statistics & prediction (a growing focus) Today, most of your time goes to reporting and execution. Over the next year, we expect a meaningful shift toward analytical modelling (statistics and prediction) Review, update, and improve the statistical and predictive models your business line already relies on Build MVPs for new predictive or statistical use cases, handing them off to Data Science once validated Bring regression, forecasting, and other statistical techniques into your day-to-day analysis, not just descriptive reporting AI-first execution Work AI-first: use AI to query, code, and analyse faster and more consistently Use and contribute to the team's shared libraries, reusable code, and architecture (e.g. GitHub-based repositories) Bridging business and data teams Act as the translation layer between your business line and Docplanner's data organisation: BI, Data Platform, and Product Analytics Bring the right requirements to each team, and flag when scope or timelines don't match business priority Driving analytics for your business line Partner directly with the VP of your assigned business line and their team to understand the business, identify gaps, and surface opportunities Lead deep dives that go beyond describing what happened to explain why, and what do next Propose, run, and analyse experiments (A/B tests and beyond) that inform business decisions Prioritisation & stakeholder alignment Own the day-to-day sequencing of your own workload: triage incoming requests, judge urgency and impact, and decide what to tackle first without waiting to be told Align directly with assigned business and data stakeholders on what matters and when Escalate cross-team or resourcing trade-offs to your manager, who owns prioritisation of the team's big projects Qualifications What will help you thrive? Degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar) +3-5 years of relevant analytics experience as an individual contributor Very good SQL skills (Amazon Redshift preferred); solid Python, especially for statistical and predictive modelling Working knowledge of statistical modelling (regression analysis, forecasting/prediction, A/B testing) Hands-on experience with Superset and/or Tableau, building dashboards for non-technical audiences Skilled at digesting complex data into business language: able to summarise findings and frame them as a clear narrative, not just a report Experience working cross-functionally, partnering with non-technical stakeholders across departments Professional fluency in English (Spanish is a plus) What makes you a strong fit? Proactive by default: you spot what needs doing and raise the level of execution around you, rather than waiting for instructions Owner with entrepreneurial mindset: own your work, your results, and everything in between Able to prioritise your own workload with sound criteria, and know when to align with stakeholders versus escalate to your manager Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driven by results Understands the capabilities and limits of AI/LLMs and has experience building things with them (professionally or on your own) Track record of scoping problems, running high-quality quantitative analysis, and developing insights that drive decisions Communicates complex concepts simply and clearly; builds trust across a wide range of stakeholders Extra advantage Experience building or validating statistical/predictive models and handing them off to a Data Science team Experience in tech companies, start-ups, and/or consultancy. No prior experience in healthcare or SaaS required, but curiosity about both is critical! What to Expect from Our Hiring Process We like to keep things transparent and efficient! items.title: Senior data processing analyst
items.summary: Verianis an independent research, evidence, evaluation, and communications agency that helps governments solve public policy challenges by working with citizens and the public realm.
items.description: Verianis an independent research, evidence, evaluation, and communications agency that helps governments solve public policy challenges by working with citizens and the public realm. We provide services to government and public sector organizations, drawing on expertise in social research, policy development, and communication. The agency operates globally, with offices across Europe, Asia Pacific, and the US. About the role Senior data processing analyst · Remote (EU) · 12-month service contract, with intention to extend Why this role is different Verian runs some of the largest and most complex survey programmes in Europe - for EU institutions, national governments of the UK and EU Member States, national statistical offices, and a wide range of other national and regional public bodies. The data you process and quality-assure directly informs public policy decisions across the continent. We are looking for a senior data processing specialist for whom two things will be true at once: Your craft is at the centre. The core of the role is expert delivery: processing, weighting, quality-assuring and delivering accurate survey data to demanding deadlines, in a fast-paced environment where project teams - and ultimately clients across Europe - rely on your depth and judgement every day. You will help co-create the automation. Verian is investing heavily in automated, code-based and AI-assisted data processing, and this work is happening now, in live production. As you deliver, you will work directly with our AI and automation engineers - shaping and helping build cutting-edge solutions for your own discipline, and learning hands-on how modern tooling is applied to real, large-scale programmes. What you will do Own the data processing side of projects end to end: specifications, data management, quality assurance, documentation and final deliverables Carry out weighting, significance testing and other statistical procedures, working with methods specialists on complex survey designs Produce high-quality data tables, datasets and analytical outputs Help develop automated processing workflows in Python and/or R, including modernising existing SPSS-based processes Apply AI-assisted tools to coding, QA, validation and documentation Act as the technical contact for project directors, project managers and, where needed, clients Mentor and develop less experienced analysts as the team grows What you need from day one Proven senior-level experience in survey data processing within market, social or policy research Strong coding in Python and/or R applied to data processing, validation or automation Solid survey statistics: weighting, significance testing, confidence intervals Deep understanding of survey data structures and downstream delivery requirements Professional working proficiency in English. Knowledge of German and/or French would be an advantage What will strengthen your application (not required — much of this you will learn here) Interest in, or experience with, AI-assisted development tools - highly useful in this role SPSS and experience modernising SPSS workflows into code SQL, Databricks, Azure or other cloud data platforms Data visualisation (Power BI, R Shiny, Dash or similar) What we offer Indicative rate of €2,900–4,300 per month — the final offer will be agreed based on your specific skills and experience Full-time engagement on an initial 12-month service contract (independent contractor or affiliate arrangement), with the intention to extend Fully remote, based anywhere in the EU A place in Verian's global Data Solutions team, reporting to a global manager in London, working on one or several large assignments alongside project directors and managers across Europe A rare chance to apply and learn state-of-the-art AI and automation approaches on real, large-scale programmes The process — quick and simple One introductory call, which will also cover the technical side; potentially a small practical task; then a fast decision. The work is available now and waiting — we will come back to you immediately, so if this sounds interesting, please get in touch as soon as you can. Salary: 2,900–4,300 Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm Hello! We are GoFasti , a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe. We need an English-fluent Senior Data Scientist , based in Latin America, available to work remotely. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills. Are you the one we are looking for? Responsibilities: Develop, deploy and maintain predictive models for lifetime value (LTV), churn and retention across mobile apps and web/browser products Own the modeling roadmap for your area, from problem framing through production and ongoing monitoring Build cohort and LTV models that inform user acquisition budgets and payback decisions Build user segmentation and propensity models that support personalization and targeting Improve model accuracy over time through validation, backtesting and new data sources Design experiments and causal analyses that measure the true impact of product and marketing changes Identify early behavioral signals that predict conversion, churn and long-term value Apply LLMs and machine learning to classify unstructured text and behavioral signals into interest categories and product and brand intent Partner with data engineering to productionize models and keep their inputs reliable Build internal AI-powered analytics tools and data products Explain model results, assumptions and confidence levels clearly to stakeholders and leadership Set modeling standards, documentation and best practices for the team Mentor other analysts and data scientists and share best practices across the team Requirements: 5+ years of experience in data science, statistical modeling or machine learning, ideally with consumer app or web data Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn or similar) and advanced SQL Experience deploying models to production and monitoring them over time Solid grounding in statistics, forecasting and experimentation Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompt design or building AI-powered data tools Daily use of AI tools as a development partner, such as Claude, Claude Code or Claude Cowork Sound judgment with incomplete or noisy data; you structure the problem before reaching for a tool Strong communication skills, including turning complex analysis into clear business recommendations Fluent English and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours (remote roles) It's a plus: Experience with ad-monetized or subscription consumer apps Experience with recommendation systems, personalization or audience segmentation for ad targeting Experience with ML platforms on AWS or Google Cloud, such as SageMaker or Vertex AI Familiarity with MLOps and orchestration tools such as MLflow, Airflow or dbt Familiarity with Bayesian methods, uplift modeling or multi-armed bandits Compensation: The salary range offered for this position varies from (USD) $4,000 - $5,500 per month, depending on seniority and skillset. This position is for a full time contract, through a payroll platform. The talent will work remotely allocated at our client. Instead, reach out to the person who contacted you to coordinate a meeting. Thank you! Originally posted on Himalayas

Benchmarking-Modellen Durchführung von Portfolioanalysen, Planungen und Simulationen mithilfe der LOGEX Software-Suite Konzeption und Umsetzung von Datenarchitekturen für betriebswirtschaftliche Massendaten- und Echtzeitdatenverarbeitung Entwicklung aussagekräftiger Kennzahlen, Reports und Dashboards für Chefärzt*innen, Klinikmanagement und Geschäftsführungen Beratung von Krankenhäusern zu Themen wie Prozessoptimierung, Portfoliosteuerung und wirtschaftlichem Ressourceneinsatz Analyse komplexer Datenbestände sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen Präsentation von Projektergebnissen und strategischen Handlungsempfehlungen vor Führungskräften, Chefärzt*innen und Entscheidungsgremien Requirements Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium mit betriebswirtschaftlicher und / oder IT-Ausrichtung, (Gesundheits-/Krankenhausökonomie, Betriebswirtschaftslehre) Fachkenntnisse bzw. erste Berufserfahrung im Krankenhaus / Krankenhauscontrolling wären vorteilhaft, konkrete Kenntnisse der Kostenträgerrechnung / InEK-Kalkulation wären ideal Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse oder zumindest erste praktische Erfahrung in den Bereichen Data Warehouse und Business Intelligence Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen im Bereich SQL, Tableau oder QlikSense Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Du hast Freude daran, dich kontinuierlich mit unserer Unterstützung in neue Technologien und fachliche Themen einzuarbeiten Eine ausgereifte Affinität zur IT ist ein Pluspunkt Das bieten wir dir Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen mit spannenden Karrierechancen Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit direktem Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des Gesundheitswesens Spannende Projekte bei führenden Krankenhäusern und Gesundheitsdienstleistern Ein internationales Umfeld mit über 450 Kolleg*innen in ganz Europa Moderne Technologien und datengetriebene Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Remote-Arbeiten für eine gute Work-Life-Balance Ein engagiertes Team mit hoher fachlicher Expertise und ausgeprägtem Teamgeist Werde Teil von Tiplu - a LOGEX company. Du möchtest mit Daten einen echten Unterschied im Gesundheitswesen machen und Krankenhäuser bei wichtigen strategischen Entscheidungen unterstützen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Kontaktieren Sie uns! Sie können sich ganz einfach über den untenstehenden Button bewerben und Ihren Lebenslauf hochladen. Für weitere Informationen oder bei Fragen wenden Sie sich gerne an Wesley Schreuder unter . Wir setzen uns für ein Arbeitsumfeld ein, das Chancengleichheit, Vielfalt und Inklusion fördert. Wir sind überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft ein entscheidender Erfolgsfaktor ist. Deshalb möchten wir einen Arbeitsplatz schaffen, an dem sich alle Menschen wertgeschätzt und respektiert fühlen – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Religion oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen. Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich alle qualifizierten Bewerberinnen und Bewerber, sich bei uns zu bewerben. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. Become a Senior Data Engineer for Bloomreach! Join our newly formed Datacraft team — the team building the next-generation data platform that powers internal Databricks, the Loomi Marketing Agent with Data Insights capability for Bloomreach Marketing platform. Your engineering work will directly impact how hundreds of enterprise customers access, understand, and activate their Bloomreach data internally and with data share in Databricks and BigQuery. The base salary range for this position at the P3 / Senior Software Engineer level is CZK 1 300 000 - CZK 1 600 000. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Working in one of our Central European offices (Bratislava, Brno or Prague) or from home on a full-time basis, you'll become a core part of the Engineering team. What challenge awaits you? You will join the Datacraft team as one of its founding engineers. Datacraft is a new team in the Engagement pillar, established to tackle three interconnected domains: Data Warehouses (~60% of team domain) — making Bloomreach data first-class in customer Databricks. The strategic goal for 27 is to use Databricks to exponentially accelerate data adoption — both for customers who want their data outside Bloomreach and for Bloomreach itself to build analytics faster. Dashboards & Analytics Stack (~20%) — moving Marketing reporting and dashboarding from the proprietary stack onto Databrick. Datacraft is an AI-first team. We believe code is a commodity and expect every engineer to fluently use coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI) as a core part of their daily workflow. The ability to leverage AI tooling to accelerate development, prototyping, and problem-solving is not optional — it's foundational. We rely heavily on knowledge graphs and spec driven development. As a P3 (Senior) engineer at Bloomreach you are an independent professional — expert in at least one component, able to decompose objectives into tasks, and lead small projects end-to-end with minimal day-to-day guidance. Your job will be to: a. Build the Databricks data platform — Design data pipelines (Kafka → Flink -> GCS Iceberg → Databricks) following medallion architecture using Databricks notebooks and Spark Declarative Pipeline. Own data models and ETL mutations for ID resolution and consent semantics. Maintain orchestration (Airflow / Cloud Composer) and monitoring. b. Co-build dashboards & analytics stack — Design canonical metrics and models on Databricks, support semantic layers and BI tools (Cube, Looker Studio), ensure tight Marketing Agent (Insights skill) integration. Our tech stack Python, Go, Kafka, Databricks, Airflow, Flink (Java), GCP, Mongo, Redis, Airflow, DataProc, Spark, Apache Flink, Databricks, Kubernetes, Terraform, Grafana, Prometheus, PagerDuty, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, GitLab CI/CD, Claude Code Your success story 30 Days: Understand the Datacraft domain, complete onboarding, set up your dev environment, and get oriented on Databricks architecture and Marketing Agent. 90 Days: Ship your first pipeline, data model, or orchestration improvement to production. Join architecture discussions and the on-call rotation. 180 Days: Own a component end-to-end. Make informed trade-off decisions independently. Contribute to measurable team goals. You have the following experience and qualities: Professional experience Solid data engineering background with strong SQL and data modeling skills (star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, partitioning/clustering, etc.). Hands-on experience building production-grade data pipelines on Databricks and GCP , ideally involving Flink, Iceberg , Spark on DataProc . Experience with orchestration and workflow tools — specifically Airflow / Cloud Composer — and comfort working with DAG-based systems for scheduled and event-driven jobs. Familiarity with open table formats (Iceberg preferred, Delta Lake / Hudi acceptable) and how they interact with query engines and DWH platforms. Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); Scala/Java/Go also relevant. Good understanding of data quality, lineage, and observability (monitoring SLAs/SLOs, detecting missing/late loads, backfilling strategies). Ability to work across product and engineering teams, turning fuzzy problem statements into incremental, shippable slices. Strongly preferred Background in marketing analytics, CDPs, or BI/semantic layers (Looker, dbt, Cube). Experience with Snowflake or Databricks or BigQuery . Experience with spec driven development, knowledge graphs, agentic harnesses or AI-powered analytics Personal qualities Ownership & accountability · Sharp and Product thinking · Clear communication · Bias for reliability · Continuous improvement mindset · Comfortable remote-first in Central Europe. #LI-KP1 More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote- USA Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote- USA Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience. The Difference You Will Make: As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality. A Typical Day: Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution Your Expertise: 3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch) 3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS) Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto) Experience with Infrastructure as Code Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud Comfort working in ticket/workflow-driven environments using Jira and Confluence Experience supporting enterprise SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, Workday) and SSO/identity integration (e.g., Okta) is a plus Your Location This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. Equal Employment Opportunity: Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $136,000 — $160,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-operations-engineer-biztech

items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. About the role We're expanding our Customer Success team and looking for a technically confident Customer Success Manager to partner with our Growth customers across the UK. You'll help brands grow with Bloomreach, get the most from Loomi and the wider product suite, to help turn their goals into measurable results. What our customers achieve depends on how well their data, tracking and integrations are set up to deliver value across our product suite. You won't write integration code or build data pipelines (our consultancy services and partners do that), but you will need to understand how the platform works under the hood, read the data behind a customer's results, have an up to date understanding of the AI landscape - especially in Martech all to work out where our customers need to go next to get maximum value from their relationship with Bloomreach. You'll own a named book of customers using multiple Bloomreach solutions, working within a modern engagement model that combines automated, self-serve and product-led experiences with 1:many programmes and targeted 1:1 sessions when a customer needs them most. You'll be the face of Bloomreach for these customers: a trusted advisor, industry expert, a source of ideas, and the person who understands their setup well enough to connect them with the right resources on our side. You will work remotely from the UK or from our London office. The core of the role These are the skills every CSM in the team uses week to week. We'll teach you Bloomreach, but we need you to bring the foundations. Understand how customer data flows. Know how a customer's events, profiles and product catalogue data reaches Bloomreach (whether that be through web and mobile SDKs, APIs, imports, data warehouse connectors and our Data Hub) and understand how identity is stitched from anonymous visitor to known customer. Use that knowledge to sense-check a customer's setup and any spot gaps for technical experts to investigate before they limit results. Read usage against entitlements. Interpret health, adoption and consumption data (monthly unique visitors, profiles, events, email and SMS volumes) against what a customer has contracted, and be able to explain what this usage means for our customers - are they trending ahead/behind or over and if so, why. Triage problems properly. When something isn't working, work out whether it sits in the data, the configuration or the integration, gather the evidence, and route it to Support, consultancy or a partner with a clear, reproducible description or scope. Explain the numbers. Build and interpret reporting on campaign revenue, conversion, average order value and customer lifetime value. When our numbers and the customer's analytics disagree, dig into tracking, attribution windows and methodology until you can explain the gap and ultimately the story behind the data and insights. Know what's possible, and brief it well. Understand what the platform can do across segmentation, scenarios, channels, personalisation, recommendations and search, so you can recommend realistic use cases and write a clear brief when a Technical or Business Consultant needs to build them. Use AI as a working tool. Use Loomi and other AI tools to analyse, research and draft, with the judgement to check and validate the output, and help customers put AI-driven capabilities to work in their own programmes. Share your Knowledge. Whether it be industry insights, AI releases or use case utilisation, a CSM at Bloomreach should be keen to learn and share knowledge to their customers and colleagues alike. We will teach you Bloomreach but experience and interest in Martech, working with and experimenting with AI and agentic approaches will be key to your success. What you will do Own a named book of Growth customers. Act as each customer's designated CSM and main point of contact for adoption, value, satisfaction and the technical health of their setup. Map Bloomreach to each customer's world. Understand their goals, pain points, data and tech stack, then translate these into clear recommendations and success plans that connect Bloomreach and Loomi capabilities to the outcomes they care about. Be the ideas factory. Bring best practice, use-case inspiration and a point of view on what good looks like. Hand off hands-on configuration, implementation and campaign build to our consultancy services, partner network or Support, with a brief clear enough that work can start without a second round of questions. Deliver engagement at scale. Host and facilitate 1:many programmes such as masterclasses, new-customer mini summits, webinars and customer events, alongside workshops, technical deep dives and consulting sessions for individual customers. Read the signals. Monitor health, adoption, usage and data-quality signals across your book, spot risk and growth signals early, and share them promptly with your Account Manager counterpart. Partner with Account Management. Work closely with Account Managers and Renewal Specialists, bringing adoption, value, usage and relationship context into account and renewal conversations. You own adoption, outcomes and retention; your Account Manager owns commercial growth and executive alignment. Together you make sure every customer experiences one joined-up Bloomreach team. Champion the customer. Capture feedback for our Product teams, including technical gaps and limitations with the evidence behind them. Identify advocates and success stories, and contribute to the programmes, content and playbooks that help the whole segment succeed. What success looks like Customers' data and tracking are set up well enough to support the use cases they want to run, and gaps are spotted and resolved early. Technical issues are triaged quickly and land with the right team to resolve these issues first time. Customers understand how Bloomreach supports their goals and can see progress against them, backed by numbers they trust. Adoption across the platform is healthy and growing, including adoption of new as well well as AI and Agentic-driven capabilities. Customers engage with and value the programmes, events and resources available to them. Risk and growth signals reach the right people early, and customers are retained and satisfied. What you bring Technical foundations 2+ years in a customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, e-commerce, marketing technology or digital marketing, ideally as a CSM or Technical Account Manager, or in solutions, implementation, martech operations or agency delivery, where you sat between marketers and technical teams. Hands-on experience with at least one marketing automation, ESP or CDP platform (Bloomreach, Klaviyo, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Emarsys or similar), plus an understanding of the commerce data behind it (catalogue, cart, purchase) from platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce or Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Working knowledge of web tracking and data integration: how events and identifiers are captured, what APIs and data feeds do, and how consent affects what can be tracked. Comfortable with exploring data: Knowledge of SQL or strong spreadsheet skills to sanity-check a number, and familiarity with an analytics or BI tool such as GA4, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Amplitude or Mixpanel. A working understanding of marketing attribution (last-touch versus multi-touch, lookback windows) and customer segmentation (RFM, cohort, lifecycle). A structured approach to problem-solving: when two systems disagree, you find out why rather than explain it away. Customer and consulting skills Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills: you build trust and rapport quickly, keep relationships strong when much of the engagement is remote, digital or in group settings, and earn credibility with stakeholders from day-to-day practitioners to senior leaders. The ability to quickly understand a customer's business model, priorities and KPIs, and to map solutions to their goals and challenges. Confident presentation and facilitation skills, including explaining technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, from a single-customer workshop to a room or virtual audience. Strong organisation and prioritisation, with the judgement to know where your time will have the most impact across a varied book of customers. Good judgement on when to bring in specialists, and the collaboration skills to work smoothly with Account Management, consultancy, partners, Support and Product. Nice to have Knowledge of a templating language (Jinja, Liquid, AMPscript or Handlebars); basic HTML and CSS for email and web; a customer success platform such as Gainsight; or experience supporting a platform implementation or migration. More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote

items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Europe, Remote Hello👋I am Puneet , Co-founder and CPO at Kayzen , and I am now looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🙌 But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?😃 Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through its self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 160B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface. The Team You will work with a carefully selected, diverse and globally distributed Data Science team (like Heiko, Chen) on various machine-learning models that process terabytes of data, serving billions of ad requests and users around the globe in real-time. We are highly motivated and aligned in our quest to disrupt the multi-billion dollar ad-tech industry. We would like you to be part of our journey, as our Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d) . Responsibilities Our day-to-day work in Data Science and Machine Learning encompasses a wide range of activities, including: Enhancing Models: Continuously improving existing models by incorporating new features, fine-tuning parameters, and utilizing additional data. Algorithm Development: Collaborating with our Machine Learning Engineering team to develop and deploy scalable supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms. Data Exploration: Identifying and exploring new data sources while researching innovative ways to leverage both new and existing data effectively. Solution Research: Investigating new Machine Learning solutions to optimize every step of our value chain. A/B Testing: Regularly conducting and evaluating A/B tests to drive insights and refine our strategies. You’ll be a great fit if you resonate with the following principles of Data Science and Machine Learning: Simplicity First: We prioritize finding the best solutions to challenges rather than forcing problems to fit predetermined solutions. Impact-Driven: We leverage Machine Learning to enhance our product and drive performance for our clients, always focusing on tangible business outcomes. Collaborative Spirit: Our teams consist of analysts, engineers, and data scientists, making strong communication skills essential for success. Embrace Experimentation: We believe in the power of experimentation to innovate and refine our approach continually. Requirements Minimum 5 years of experience in developing data science products, from initial research through to production deployment. Strong coding skills with a focus on clean, reproducible, and well-tested code. Proficient in key tools and technologies including Python, Spark, Hadoop, Airflow, Docker, and SQL. Hands-on experience with algorithms for handling sparse and large datasets, including applications in prediction, clustering, and outlier detection. Experience in building neural network-based products for tasks such as classification, regression, and multi-task learning is highly valuable. Bonus skills: Knowledge of reinforcement learning and large-scale optimization problems is a significant asset. Good understanding of dashboards and SQL for developing and enhancing monitoring tools. Previous experience in Ad-Tech is a must. What do we offer? Directly working with Founders and an opportunity to drive direct impact Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Canada, Spain, the UK and many more countries. A flexible work-from-home arrangement Opportunity to relocate to our office in Berlin A 500-dollar home-office setup budget A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior AI & Cloud-Native Software (108-10SENG-01)
items.summary: This role owns the software and cloud-native architecture of AI-enabled applications and retrieval systems, from design to production.
items.description: This role owns the software and cloud-native architecture of AI-enabled applications and retrieval systems, from design to production. It combines architectural leadership with hands-on engineering: designing GenAI and RAG solutions, building cloud-native backend services, and ensuring the security, reliability, and observability required for production workloads. Requirements What you will do Design scalable, secure, and resilient architectures for AI-enabled applications, defining service boundaries, data flows, APIs, and integration patterns. Define cloud-native patterns across microservices, containers, serverless, and event-driven systems. Design and productionize GenAI and RAG solutions: model selection and routing, retrieval strategy, evaluation, guardrails, and cost/latency optimization. Build backend services in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python, and event-driven workflows with queues, workers, and webhooks. Define non-functional requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and document decisions in ADRs. Translate business use cases into technical designs, assessments, and executive summaries. Own the architecture from discovery to go-live, guiding engineers through architecture and code reviews. Implement observability and secure CI/CD pipelines. Job requirements 7+ years of software engineering experience. Proven experience owning the architecture of production distributed systems (microservices, domain-driven design, REST and asynchronous APIs). Hands-on delivery of production GenAI or LLM applications, including evaluation and AI safety controls. Experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch, or equivalent). Strong TypeScript/Node.js or Python engineering experience. Deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns: containers and Kubernetes, serverless, event-driven messaging, and resilience patterns. Strong understanding of security in cloud-native systems: identity, authorization, secrets management, and data protection. Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, and observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, or CloudWatch). Nice to have AWS: Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions, ECS/EKS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB. Conversational and contact center: WhatsApp Business API, Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, Twilio, voice bots. Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or equivalent. Customer-facing consulting experience and comfort presenting to executive stakeholders. Engagement details Part time Remote Contractor Hourly Start: ASAP Highlights AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge), GenAI / LLM, RAG & Vector Databases (pgvector, OpenSearch), TypeScript / Node.js, Python, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, Terraform / CloudFormation / CDK Originally posted on Himalayas

This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. Utilizes portfolio trends to propose policy/procedural changes within segmentation structure to produce optimal results. Excels at risk/reward trade off. Build relationships with external agencies. Participates in the rollout of company-wide pilot programs developed as a result of programmed models.
