As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding…
items.description: Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. or incongruence in clinical records. Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system). Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX). Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit. Systematically determine the existence and completeness of documentation associated with specific patient visits or encounters. Develop a data-driven framework for prioritizing facility targets for direct data acquisition, assessing impact, cost-effectiveness, and technical feasibility. Inform and guide vendor strategy around national initiatives such as TEFCA and QHIN adoption, ensuring Counterpart Health is positioned for compliant, high-quality data exchange. Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers to define data requirements, Engineers to implement reliable pipelines, and Clinical teams to validate data quality and clinical utility. Act as a critical liaison to identify and remove operational and technical bottlenecks, ensuring a predictable, scalable, and reliable clinical data flow across all customer markets. You should get in touch if you have: 2+ years of hands-on data analytics experience, with direct exposure to healthcare data interoperability Strong hands-on experience with healthcare data standards: HL7, CCDA, and ADT messages. Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large, complex datasets (claims, clinical logs, interoperability data). Background in analyzing interoperability networks (e.g., Carequality, CommonWell, eHealthExchange) or HIE integrations. Skilled at data visualization and able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong investigative mindset, i.e., you enjoy digging into the “why” behind missing data and diverging metrics. Self-directed and able to manage multiple analytical projects (vendor comparisons, visit-level reconciliation) without constant supervision. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $77,000—$100,000 USD

items.title: AWS Technical Lead / Architect
items.summary: The Role We are looking for a hands-on AWS Technical Lead to act as the architectural anchor.
items.description: The Role We are looking for a hands-on AWS Technical Lead to act as the architectural anchor. You will not just be coding; you will be the "Technical North Star". You will oversee solution design, enforce best practices, and guide the implementation of complex systems ranging from Infrastructure Setups to AI-powered solutions & Enterprise Data Warehouses. Responsibilities: Provide expert technical guidance across multiple projects. Own the end-to-end cloud architecture . You will decide when to use Lambda vs. Fargate, how to optimize Redshift/Glue, and where to implement security boundaries. While you don't need to be a Data Scientist, you must be comfortable architecting applications that consume AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock, LLMs, RAG pipelines, and Vector Databases). Conduct code reviews, set standards for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and mentor developers to ensure production-grade delivery. Translate complex technical concepts into business value for our clients, helping them understand trade-offs and risks. You will be the internal client qualifying the deliverables before it goes to deployment Must-Have Qualifications: Proven track record (5+ years) architecting and deploying solutions on AWS. You should be fluent in Serverless (Lambda, API Gateway), Data Services (S3, Glue, Redshift), and Security (IAM, VPC). Experience leading agile teams, estimating effort, and making architectural trade-offs. Practical experience or strong conceptual knowledge of integrating Machine Learning into web applications (e.g., using LLMs, APIs, or pre-trained models). Strong background in backend engineering (Node.js, Python, or similar). Excellent ability to document technical designs (TDDs) and communicate risks to non-technical stakeholders. AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional) or similar. Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points): Prior experience in Biotech, Life Sciences , or Healthcare . (Familiarity with GxP compliance or genomic data is a huge plus). Experience designing Data Lakes or Analytics pipelines (QuickSight, Power BI migrations). Perks: 100% Remote : Work from the comfort of your home or city of your choice. Cutting-Edge Projects : Work on the latest tech stack (GenAI, RAG, Serverless) rather than maintaining legacy monoliths. Impact : Your architectural decisions will directly shape the success of our clients' products. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Global Meal Coordinator
items.summary: ABOUT ECHO ECHO is a global Christian agricultural networking, training, and resourcing organization.
items.description: ABOUT ECHO ECHO is a global Christian agricultural networking, training, and resourcing organization. Our mission is to strengthen the capacity of a diverse global network to defeat hunger and improve lives through sustainable food and agroecosystem strategies. ECHO has a significant network of over 20,000 individuals and organizations built over 45 years working in more than 190 countries. These partners serve as the primary multiplier for ECHO tested options, strategies, and research. WHY JOIN ECHO At ECHO, you will join a global Christian network committed to defeating hunger and restoring hope through sustainable agriculture. Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to equipping leaders around the world with practical tools that create lasting impact. If you are passionate about faith-integrated service and sustainable solutions, you will find meaningful purpose in this role. SUMMARY: The Global Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Coordinator is part of the Global MEAL team and contributes to ECHO’s development and roll-out of a Global MEAL system to foster the growth of a learning organization. The role helps ensure timely, accurate and useful program information is collected, analyzed and communicated through ECHO’s reporting processes, with reports reviewed and approved by the appropriate directors and executives. The role will contribute to the collection of quantitative data and qualitative stories to track progress on ECHO’s Strategic Framework Logframe indicators. This role requires a curious, proactive self-starter who gets excited about supporting our organization to move beyond a compliance attitude towards reporting on what happened, to always asking more questions on why and how change did or did not happen and what that means for strategic decision-making. This is a support role with room for initiative and independent work under the direction of the Global MEAL Lead; it does not carry decision-making authority. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Growing a Learning Organization: Assist the Global MEAL Lead in improving ECHO’s global MEAL practices. Support teams at Regional Impact Centers to implement their learning agendas by contributing to their MEAL planning, tool development and activity planning. Document emerging results, lessons and stories of change for reporting and learning. Proactively participate in the Impact Learning Circles and engage in outcome harvesting and mapping exercises on a continuous basis. Facilitate regular reflection on monitoring and evaluation findings with program and regional teams. Regular Monitoring and Reporting: Support MEAL coordinators and reporting coordinators based at Regional Impact Centers with monthly reporting. Assist in managing the ECHO Kobo Toolbox account, including projects, tools and membership. Review submissions for completeness, consistency and data quality. Consolidate regional data, analyze progress against indicators, targets and annual plans and produce regular data summaries. Format and design reports with a clear layout and visual presentation that make data and stories of change easy to read and use. Support Tracking of Progress Towards Strategic Framework Logframe: Contribute to the development of both qualitative and quantitative tools. Train and assist teams in data collection towards Strategic Framework Logframe indicators, including occasional in-person trainings on site. Contribute to dashboarding and visualization of data. QUALIFICATIONS: Core Skills and Competencies: Technical MEAL Knowledge: Basic quantitative and qualitative monitoring, reporting, data analysis, and evaluation abilities. Relational Project Management: Strong emphasis on prioritizing building relationships above completing tasks with strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to flexibly manage multiple tasks independently. Communication Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders and collaborate in a cross-cultural, team-oriented environment, making complex ideas simple and attainable. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, other languages such as Thai, French, Spanish or Kiswahili are an added advantage. Data Protection and Safeguarding: Experience with data protection and safeguarding, and a commitment to upholding the dignity of communities and community members in how data, stories, and images are collected, stored, and shared. Learning attitude: A proactive self-starter with a demonstrated commitment to long-term personal growth and professional development, and to building advanced MEAL capacity and skills through this role as a step toward broader professional aspirations. Preferred Qualifications: Technical proficiency: Experience with Microsoft Sharepoint, experience with Kobo Toolbox as a data collection tool and PowerBI as a data visualization tool. Report design: Demonstrated skill in the formatting, layout, and design of reports, so that data and stories of change are clear, accurate, and engaging for varied audiences. Contextual knowledge: Experience with approaches to community-led MEAL approaches and holistic flourishing frameworks, such as the Light Wheel. Experience in the fields of food security, nutrition, agriculture, adult learning, or training is preferred. Additional Requirements: Must adhere to the ECHO Statement of Faith and possess character traits consistent with ECHO’s Core Values. REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Education: A bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., social sciences or information systems) is required. Experience: A minimum of 1 year of experience in MEAL practices in an NGO or foundation organizational setting. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS: Positions Directly Supervised: This position has no direct reports. Those Directly Supported: Regional Impact Center staff, all MEAL staff and contributors. Others to Work Closely With: Advancement, Communications, Global Support Services, Department Managers, and the directors and executives who review and approve reports. WORK ENVIRONMENT: Primarily a computer-based office or remote work environment. There are occasional times when work is conducted in an outdoor or field office (international and domestic) setting, such as during site visits and trainings, which may involve hot and humid conditions. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This position is almost exclusively computer-based and requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods and to communicate effectively in person and through virtual platforms. Occasional travel and on-site, in-person trainings may require standing or walking for periods of time. POSITION TYPE AND EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work may vary based on organizational needs. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and accommodate time zone differences. WORK LOCATION: This position may be performed remotely, in a hybrid arrangement, or at an ECHO Regional Impact Center, depending on organizational needs and position requirements. Candidates may be based in various countries, with a preference for those located in the Asia region . TRAVEL: Travel domestically and internationally may involve up to 10% of time annually. OTHER DUTIES: Undertake additional tasks as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and responsiveness to the organizational needs. items.title: Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The institution generates a great deal of information and data across campuses, programmes and systems held by functions with different definitions and different reporting rhythms. The Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will assemble it, identify what matters in it and put that in front of the people who have to decide. You are expected to find the insight inside fragmented institutional information and make it usable by the people who have to act on it. This role goes beyond producing analysis to deciding what the analysis means, what can reasonably be concluded from it, and the form in which that meaning will actually land. The role will enable the University to act on what its own information is telling it by bringing together fragmented evidence, establishing what matters and putting it in front of the right person in a form they can use. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Research, Economic Analysis and Insight (the core of the role) Produce quantitative and economic analysis underpinning material submitted to the Executive Committee and the Board including scenario work, unit economics, capacity and cost modelling, cost behaviour, and the baseline scenario against which a decision should be judged. Take fragmentary, inconsistent and incomplete inputs from several functions and produce one defensible view, with the areas of remaining uncertainty named rather than smoothed over. This is the central skill of the role. Interrogate the question behind the request. Where the question as asked will not produce a useful answer, clarify the decision that needs to be supported and propose the more useful analytical question. Maintain relevant external evidence, including comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research and precedent relevant to current analyses and decisions. Build and maintain the external evidence base: comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research, and precedent relevant to decisions in front of ALU . State assumptions explicitly, and state plainly what an analysis does not establish. Where required data does not exist, publish the gap rather than substituting a proxy without saying so. Review recurring analysis and underlying assumptions, identify material gaps or inconsistencies, and raise findings where further scrutiny is required. Communication and Decision-Ready Output Design data and insight presentations so the key finding is immediately visible rather than presenting the dataset in full. Treat chart selection, sequencing and emphasis as analytical choices. Determine the appropriate format for each piece of work, whether a written memo, one-page decision brief, chart, dashboard, model walkthrough or verbal briefing, based on the decision, audience and complexity involved. Write for senior readers with limited time: lead with the finding or decision required, support it with the relevant evidence, and state what remains unknown and what would resolve it. Adjust the level of detail, language and presentation across audiences including the Executive Committee, Board, departmental leaders and technical counterparts. Present analysis clearly and confidently, including the assumptions, limitations and implications of the work. Automation and tooling Support the development and maintenance of automated workflows for data extraction, reconciliation, monitoring and reporting, reducing recurring manual effort. Use AI-enabled tools, agents and scripted workflows to accelerate recurring analytical tasks, including drafting, summarisation, exception detection, data preparation and scheduled checks. Apply judgement to AI-generated outputs, validate results and identify where automation should not replace human review. Build and maintain escalation triggers within recurring analytical and monitoring processes so that exceptions, overdue actions or material changes generate timely alerts. Document analytical tools and workflows to a standard that allows another team member to operate, understand and modify them without reliance on the original author. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Improve analytical methodologies, templates, reporting processes and tools used by the Business Performance & Analysis function. Identify recurring requests and manual processes that can be standardised, automated or redesigned. Establish practical quality checks for recurring analysis and reporting. Share analytical methods, tools and lessons learned across the team and support the development of analytical capability. Performance Tracking and Follow-through Maintain accurate records of key decisions, actions, owners, assumptions and review dates arising from performance and planning activities. Monitor agreed actions and escalation triggers and raise overdue or off-track items appropriately through appropriate and well suited digital tools. Maintain the document repository to support continuity, transparency and effective handover. Executive and cycle coordination Coordinate engagement requirements against the University's planning, review and reporting calendar, including committee dates, planning cycles, statutory requirements and reporting deadlines. Prepare the analysis, briefing material and supporting information required for those engagements. Track actions and commitments arising from key meetings and ensure they are reflected in the appropriate working records and follow-up mechanisms. Coordinate inputs across functions to ensure materials are complete, consistent and ready for review. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 6 to 8 years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated experience producing analysis that informs decisions taken by people more senior than yourself, in a research institution, consultancy, financial institution, policy body, university, or comparable analytical function. Economic reasoning, evidenced by training or by practice. You think in terms of opportunity cost, marginal effects, incentives and counterfactuals, and you state your assumptions before your conclusions. A degree in economics or experience across consulting, policy research, financial analysis or a quantitative discipline. Demonstrated ability to turn complex analysis into concise executive communication, including decision briefs, presentations, dashboards or written recommendations. Working competence in Python or R for data analysis and evidence of having built or supported an analytical workflow that can run with limited manual intervention. Practical experience using AI-enabled tools, including large language models, agents or scripted workflows, to improve analytical productivity, automation or decision support. Demonstrated ability to take incomplete and conflicting inputs from multiple sources and produce a single defensible view. Demonstrated ability to become productive quickly in an unfamiliar subject area and build sufficient domain understanding to analyse it effectively. Experience working across functions with different data sources, priorities and perspectives is strongly preferred. Exposure to executive, Board or committee reporting is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Analytical Reasoning: Break down complex questions, identify the relevant variables and determine the analysis required to support a decision. Data Interpretation and Judgement: Analyse information critically, identify patterns and anomalies, test assumptions and assess what can reasonably be concluded. Economic and Financial Acumen: Understand opportunity cost, incentives, cost behaviour, revenue, contribution and the financial implications of decisions. Modelling and Forecasting: Build and interpret scenarios, forecasts and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making. Digital and AI Fluency: Use analytical, automation and AI-enabled tools confidently to improve speed and quality while independently validating outputs. Executive Communication: Distil complex analysis into clear findings, implications and recommendations appropriate to the audience and decision required. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Judgement: Recognise what matters, make sound calls with imperfect information and know when further analysis is warranted. Constructive Challenge: Question assumptions, identify weaknesses and raise material concerns directly and objectively. Ownership: Take responsibility for analytical quality, timeliness and usefulness from problem definition through to delivery. Collaboration: Work effectively across Finance, Data/IT, academic and professional functions while respecting ownership of underlying data and business processes. Delivery Discipline: Manage competing demands, coordinate contributors and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines. Continuous Improvement: Improve processes, tools and ways of working so that recurring work becomes more efficient, reliable and scalable. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases.
items.description: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases. We develop medicines for previously untreatable or undertreated diseases. We recognize the courage it takes for patients and their caregivers to begin their journey of advocacy to find the answers they need. Their courage inspires us to challenge convention, ask bold questions and seek answers for them. Every day, we strive for excellence through our willingness to adapt, learn, and our tenacity to overcome barriers, together. Opportunity Overview The Federated Registry Data scientist will contribute to the design, development and operation of a multi-country federated registry platform based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership Common Data Model (OMOP CDM), in collaboration with specialized vendors for Extract-Transform-Load (ETL), hosting, and federated analyses. The role will serve as a primary point of contact between Rhythm, the selected vendors, and participating registries for data-related activities. The Data Scientist will oversee the local registry data collection (mapping, transformation, quality-check) and the federated analyses specifications and outputs within a federated OMOP CDM-based environment provided and maintained by the vendors. Responsibilities & Duties Federated analyses Oversee and supervise the vendor’s technical and analytical deliverables Oversee data collection, data quality check, ETL logic and data mapping to OMOP CDM Lead preparation and review of the statistical analysis plan, cohort definitions, variable definitions, and federated query specifications supported and executed by the vendors based on research questions proposed by the Scientific Committee, the participating centers or internally Perform external research proposals’ feasibility assessment before review by the Scientific Committee Ensure analytical outputs are clear and consistent with research questions, develop report for review by the scientific committee, and support the drafting of related publications Collaboration with vendors Collaborate with the vendor on source data review, OMOP mapping, ETL logic, and data quality checks, helping to identify, prioritize, and resolve quality issues Help with data-related questions raised by the vendor and coordinate timely responses from centers when local input is required Ensure that data-related discussions remain aligned with Rhythm’s scientific objectives, project scope, timelines, and budget Collaboration with sites/registries owners Support sites in understanding project data requirements, minimum datasets, expected formats, timelines, and quality control processes Coordinate with sites and the vendor to investigate data quality issues such as missing data, inconsistent values, duplicate records, etc. Collaborate with research teams (scientific committees, internal stakeholders, participating sites) to develop insights and drive evidence generation Perform any other relevant tasks as needed to support the team and company objectives. Qualifications & Skills Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent scientific or technical discipline Strong experience with healthcare data sources, including clinical registries, electronic health records, claims databases, healthcare databases, and real-world evidence projects Strong proficiency in R and/or Python Knowledge of healthcare standards, including OMOP CDM, Fast Health Interoperability Resources (FHIR), Systemized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), etc. Knowledge of statistical methods in real-world evidence (RWE) Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with senior leadership and key stakeholders. Not accepting the status quo, working with a sense of urgency to deliver results Self-starter mentality who feels comfortable working in a fast-paced environment Cross-functional mindset focused on a seamless collaboration with internal and external partners Fluent in English This role is home office based. Rhythm operates in a hybrid-work model. Candidates applying must be willing and able travel internationally. More about Rhythm We are a dynamic and growing global team spanning more than a dozen countries. At Rhythm we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients living with rare melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) pathway diseases by rapidly advancing care and precision medicines that address the root cause. Our team is passionate about expanding access to reach more patients and developing novel therapies for other rare neuroendocrine diseases, including congenital hyperinsulinism. At Rhythm Our Core Values Are We are committed to advancing scientific understanding to improve patients’ lives We are inspired to tackle tough challenges and have the courage to ask bold questions We are eager to learn and adapt We believe collaboration and ownership are foundational for our success We value the unique contribution each individual brings to furthering our mission Inherent in our core values is the commitment to act ethically and with integrity in all we do. items.title: Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst (Europe or LATAM, Remote)
items.summary: Company Overview:Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using near-real-time insights into the latest malicious actors, relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses.
items.description: Company Overview: Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using near-real-time insights into the latest malicious actors, relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses. Founded in 2014, Intel 471 provides comprehensive intelligence and monitoring on threat actors. The company’s centralized TITAN platform enables intelligence and security professionals to access structured information, dashboards, timely alerts and intelligence reporting via web portal or API integration. Our pedigree is unmatched and we count upon a team with experience operating in the intelligence services, military, law enforcement and private threat intelligence companies in nearly every continent on earth. The Role: You own the technical depth of our vulnerability intelligence practice. When a new CVE drops, you're the person who determines what's actually true and decides what our customers should do about it. This is a team lead role where you'll set the technical standard for how we validate, assess, and communicate vulnerability risk. You'll also build and maintain the tooling that lets a small team cover the ever-growing world of vulnerability research. What You'll Do: Design, build, and deploy honeypot systems to monitor for exploitation activity. Acquire, test, and validate proof-of-concept exploits in virtual environments to confirm or refute claims about exploitability. Develop practical mitigations for cases where patching is delayed, impossible, or insufficient. These mitigations could include configuration hardening, network segmentation, ACLs, disabling features, or other controls. You'll devise techniques for detecting both attempted and successful exploitation by illuminating the artifacts defenders should hunt for. You'll write vulnerability reports that dive into the details about an exploit such as how it works, who is using it and who is being targeted. Automation is a key component of the role; you will build and maintain the systems we use to streamline vulnerability assessment and automate triage of vulnerability alerts. Required Qualifications: Every candidate must be able to: - Validate and test PoCs to verify the validity of exploitation claims. - Devise mitigation techniques beyond patching. - Devise techniques for detecting exploit activity, attempted or successful. - Write vulnerability reports such as Vulnerability Spotlights. - Identify new sources of vulnerability intelligence. - Train and mentor junior team members. Technical foundation: - Proficiency with at least one programming language (Python, Go, C/C++, or similar) sufficient to read exploit code, modify PoCs, and build tooling. - Hands-on fluency with virtual machines, containers, and re-usable lab environments for safe detonation and analysis. - Solid computer science fundamentals. - Thorough understanding of computing and internet fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication and authorization models, and how real systems are actually deployed. - Demonstrated subject-matter-expert-level depth. - A working bias toward automation. Strong candidates additionally bring: - Experience building honeypot or sensor systems to monitor real-world exploitation activity. - Experience building systems that streamline or automate PoC testing and validation. - Demonstrated ability to integrate a new intelligence source end-to-end, from evaluation and ingestion to normalization, enrichment and delivery. Also valuable: original vulnerability research or CVE credits; reverse engineering skills; detection engineering (Sigma, Snort/Suricata, YARA); SOC experience; familiarity with CVSS, CWE, EPSS, and the KEV catalog; public speaking or published writing. Benefits: Competitive compensation Remote-friendly culture Wellness programs A variety of professional development opportunities Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation Our Culture: The Intel 471 team is constantly growing and is always on the lookout for talented professionals who seek to operate on the forefront of the fight against threat actors impacting our customers and partners. Our culture of humility and quiet professionalism is a core attribute of Intel 471 and everyone within it. Our culture is collaborative, supportive and fast-paced. We're a mission-driven company. We're looking for talented, 'can-do' minded people with a passion for always doing the right thing. We believe in supporting a progressive culture that allows all our people to be themselves, enjoy exciting opportunities and grow with us. That's why our culture is founded on our core values of openness, inclusion, integrity and client focus, which set the tone for how we work together and treat each other in order to empower us all – and foster a unique team spirit. Salary: Market competitive Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Analyst, Clinical Data Effectiveness
items.summary: Headquarters: Remote - USA Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proac
items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote - USA Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. or incongruence in clinical records. Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system). Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX). Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit. Systematically determine the existence and completeness of documentation associated with specific patient visits or encounters. Develop a data-driven framework for prioritizing facility targets for direct data acquisition, assessing impact, cost-effectiveness, and technical feasibility. Inform and guide vendor strategy around national initiatives such as TEFCA and QHIN adoption, ensuring Counterpart Health is positioned for compliant, high-quality data exchange. Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers to define data requirements, Engineers to implement reliable pipelines, and Clinical teams to validate data quality and clinical utility. Act as a critical liaison to identify and remove operational and technical bottlenecks, ensuring a predictable, scalable, and reliable clinical data flow across all customer markets. You should get in touch if you have: 5+ years of hands-on data analytics experience, with direct exposure to healthcare data interoperability Strong hands-on experience with healthcare data standards: HL7, CCDA, and ADT messages. Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large, complex datasets (claims, clinical logs, interoperability data). Background in analyzing interoperability networks (e.g., Carequality, CommonWell, eHealthExchange) or HIE integrations. Skilled at data visualization and able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong investigative mindset, i.e., you enjoy digging into the “why” behind missing data and diverging metrics. Self-directed and able to manage multiple analytical projects (vendor comparisons, visit-level reconciliation) without constant supervision. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.) Commercial Data Scientist Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare. How you’ll make an impact: Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies. Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. About you: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets. Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory. Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships. Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries. Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training. Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders. Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research. Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections. Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights. The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds. We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events! Compensation The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Our total compensation package may include: Base salary Equity (where applicable) Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable) Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process. Benefits In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match Flexible paid time off and company holidays Paid parental leave Professional development and learning opportunities Wellness and mental health resources Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable) Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work. Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning. Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work. Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development. Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated. Our Hiring Process & AI Tools Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. Equal Employment Opportunity Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist

Familiarity with production quality & near real time consumer facing machine learning implementations. Strong understanding of data analysis principles and how to leverage data to inform product decisions. Entrepreneurial drive, passion about our mission, and deep empathy for our customers Industry Specific: A passion for daily fantasy sports or tangential industries with an understanding of the competitive landscape. We want to work with people who bring something to the table on and off the field / in and out of the office. items.description: We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ London | UK remote | £80,000 to £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Hear from the team About our Data Science Team: We're looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. You'll have the opportunity to super charge our user engagement in 2025 and help us to build a bank that customers truly love. At Monzo, we're building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals. Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives data scientists the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses. How we hire We are excited to be expanding and are hiring for multiple roles across our Data Science teams! Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth, or Core, we are looking for talented individuals with a versatile skill set to contribute across our squads. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future! What you’ll be working on We work in cross-functional squads where every data scientist is a member of a central data discipline and fully embedded into 1 product squad alongside engineers, designers, marketers, product managers etc. Your day-to-day Applying your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand how our users interact with our products and how those insights can inform our product strategy Guide and enable product teams to measure things that matter; initiate or help run A/B experiments to keep improving everything we do Drive together with the finance team a unified company-wide understanding of the lifetime value of our users and how different product features are impacting user profitability Liaise with engineers to keep making sure we collect the right data to produce relevant business insights You should apply if: What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you! You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, product, users and very importantly your colleagues as well You're commercially minded and can put numbers into business perspective You’re as comfortable getting hands-on as taking a step back and thinking strategically You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so You're a team player whom your colleagues can rely on You have solid grounding in SQL and preferably Python You have experience in conducting large scale A/B experiments The Interview Process: Our interview process involves three main stages: Recruiter Call Initial Call Technical Interview Final Interview including a case study and collaboration interview Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process. What’s in it for you: £80,000 to £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK ✅ We can sponsor visas This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London). ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences ➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance. #LI-NB2 #LI-Remote Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. items.description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. You will partner with GTM leaders to find high-impact problems, scope them, and ship reliable, well-governed solutions iteratively. This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere we are eligible to hire. What You Will Do: Design, build and operate AI agents, LLM integrations and automations that connect Salesforce, Gainsight, Slack, Salesloft, Clari, HubSpot, Impartner and the rest of the GTM stack – reducing manual work across Sales, CS, Marketing, Partners and ADR teams. Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions). Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management. Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation. Raise the engineering bar for the GTM Systems team: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security governance, observability and technical documentation; mentor teammates on responsible AI-assisted development. Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: 5+ years of software engineering experience (backend development, systems integration, data or analytics engineering, or automation), including at least 2 years shipping LLM or AI capabilities into production business workflows or internal tools. Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), with mature Git-based development habits: code review, automated testing, CI/CD. Hands-on command of LLM patterns – prompt engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, structured outputs, model evaluation – and of their failure modes and mitigations (validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human review, cost and latency control). Experience integrating with Salesforce (REST/Bulk/Streaming APIs, data model, platform limits; Apex or Flow a plus) and other business systems via APIs and event-driven patterns, and with a cloud platform (GCP preferred: BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM). Ability to own a problem end-to-end with minimal guidance – scope, design, deliver, operate – and to communicate clearly with engineering and business stakeholders in a remote, asynchronous environment. Nice to Haves: Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to tools and data; agent frameworks; vector databases or retrieval pipelines (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB). Exposure to AI observability and evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, or custom eval frameworks). Familiarity with orchestration platforms such as Camunda or Clay, and prior work in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations in B2B SaaS. Building lightweight interfaces for AI tools (React, Slack Block Kit, dashboards); Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architect). This role is an existing vacancy #LI-JS1 #Remote #C4 What We Have to Offer: Compensation We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth: United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00 United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00 Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00 If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview. Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) . Benefits & Perks We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. items.description: Novakid is an online English school for kids. The Visitor Squad owns the funnel from first visit to paid lesson: landing pages, registration and booking, blog, and the visitor's personal account. We track two key metrics, visitor → lead and visitor → booking, and test almost everything we ship through experiments. This is a backend-first role: about 70% backend (Python, some ) and 30% frontend (React/TypeScript). You'll own the server side of the funnel: APIs behind registration, booking and the visitor account, attribution, and server-side integrations with ad platforms. When a feature needs frontend work, you'll take it end-to-end yourself. You'll work within the squad's processes: planning, grooming, code review, sprints and releases. Key Responsibilities Design, build and maintain Python services and APIs behind the funnel: registration, booking and the visitor account Build and own server-side integrations with ad platforms (Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API and similar): event delivery, deduplication, retries and monitoring Own attribution on the backend: end-to-end visit tracking, UTM persistence, and diagnosing gaps in V2L/V2B data Keep services fast and reliable: caching, query optimization, debugging server-side rendering in our layer Investigate production incidents through Sentry and see them through to resolution Support A/B testing on the server side: feature flags, rollouts, and cleanup after experiments Ship frontend changes in React/TypeScript when a feature needs it Requirements Requirements 5+ years of production backend development in Python, including services you designed, shipped and supported in production yourself Strong backend fundamentals: API design, relational databases and SQL, caching, background jobs, and integrating third-party APIs (auth, rate limits, retries, idempotency) Production debugging experience: logs, error tracking, finding the root cause of an issue : comfortable reading and changing an Express service Working frontend skills: enough TypeScript and React to deliver a feature end-to-end. Expert level not required. An understanding of how tracking data travels from click to report, and the ability to find where it gets lost Product mindset: you work with metrics and hypotheses, not just tickets Fluent English Nice to Have Server-side conversion tracking (CAPI, Events API, server-side GTM) BigQuery: checking your own hypotheses with data CDN and edge caching (CloudFront or similar) GDPR and consent mechanisms E2E testing with Playwright or Cypress Our Tech Stack Python, , Express (SSR), TypeScript, React, , Sentry, GrowthBook, BigQuery. What we offer Fully remote work A chance to shape the future of AI-driven education A fun, dynamic team that loves building innovative products Unlimited holidays, because we trust you to deliver Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Volunteer AI Full Stack Engineer (AI-Native / Rapid Development) About this Role Position type: Volunteer (unpaid), pro bono Location: Remote / International Time commitment: 10–15 hours per week for a minimum of 3 months Experience level: 2–5 years Professional Volunteering: Professional volunteering at Solution Community is a skills-based service performed with the same reliability, accountability, and quality expected in a paid professional role. Volunteers are core contributors whose work directly supports our mission of global compassion, collaboration, and action. About Solution Community : Solution Community is an international 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, pioneering an innovative social platform dedicated to enabling actionable change. With volunteers from over 70 countries, we are a testament to the power of global collaboration. Our team members bring experience from some of the world's most successful companies, including Apple, Toyota, Google, Netflix, Walmart, Meta, and many others. Our Mission: To foster a global community of compassion, uniting individuals and organizations to solve the world's social problems. We are the bridge that connects non-profits, businesses, philanthropists, and volunteers, empowering them to create meaningful change. Our Vision: A world united by collaboration, compassion, and action — where every person can thrive. At Solution Community , we are turning that vision into reality. Position Overview: We are seeking a Volunteer AI Full Stack Engineer who builds production software the way top AI-native engineers build in 2026: primarily through AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent), not the classical write-every-line, sprint-by-sprint engineering lifecycle. This is a vibe-coding role in the best sense — you move at the speed of AI-assisted development, but you bring the engineering judgment to keep quality high. Most "vibe coders" ship fast and buggy; we need someone who ships fast and correct. You'll design, generate, review, debug, and deploy real features for our platform, working directly with our CEO (who builds the same way) and our engineering team. Key Responsibilities AI-Accelerated Development Build and ship full features — front end, back end, integrations — primarily by directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.), not manual line-by-line coding. Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy working software in days, not sprints. Apply strong engineering judgment to review, debug, and harden AI-generated code — catching the bugs, security gaps, and architectural mistakes that typical vibe-coded output has. Design clear, specific prompts and technical specs that get AI tools to production-quality output on the first or second pass. Full Stack Ownership Develop and maintain responsive web applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services end to end. Own your features from spec through deployment — no separate QA/handoff cycle to lean on. Ensure application security, performance, and reliability despite the compressed build timeline. Collaboration & Support Work directly with the CEO and engineering lead on architecture and priorities — minimal process overhead. Document what you build clearly enough that another AI-native engineer (human or agent) can pick it up without you. Mentor other volunteers on AI-assisted development practices. What We Are Looking For Required Advanced, daily, hands-on proficiency with Claude Code, Codex, or an equivalent AI coding agent — able to architect, generate, debug, and ship full applications with AI as the primary development method, not an autocomplete assistant. Solid full-stack fundamentals (front end: React, Vue, or similar; back end: Node.js, Python, or similar) — enough to review, debug, and correct AI-generated code, not necessarily to write everything by hand. Experience with RESTful APIs and SQL and/or NoSQL databases. Familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). A track record of shipping working software fast, with the discipline to test and verify it before calling it done. Preferred Experience with LLM/AI application development (OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering). Docker, Kubernetes, or other cloud-native deployment experience. Prior volunteer, nonprofit, or social-impact work. Skills Strong problem-solving and independent judgment — you catch what the AI gets wrong. Clear written communication (specs, docs, async updates). Comfortable operating with high autonomy and minimal process. Genuine interest in AI-native development and technology-driven social impact. Application requirement Include 2–3 examples of production apps or features you built primarily using an AI coding agent, with rough build time for each. This is the main filter — general dev experience without demonstrated AI-native speed will not be a fit for this role. What Success Looks Like Features shipped in days, not weeks, with bug rates comparable to (or better than) traditionally coded work. Code and architecture that the rest of the team can read, extend, and trust without a rewrite. Reliable, secure, working software in production — not demos. Growing autonomy: less spec detail needed from the CEO/lead over time as trust is established. What We Offer Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies. Meaningful impact on global causes and communities. A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 70+ countries. A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration. Flexible work with full autonomy. Opportunities for personal and professional growth. Originally posted on Himalayas

Through its data-driven AI insights, evidence-based resources, and comprehensive platform – including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, health information management, and more – Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value-based care at scale. To learn more, visit . Job Summary: The Manager of Global Central Operations ensures objectives, principles, values, mission and foundation are represented with Global partners. The position also supports Global operational activities that are focused on the achievement of company-wide operational goals. The role emphasizes Global partner engagement, relationship development, work quality, operational efficiency, long and short-term planning, and customer-oriented thinking. Through strong partnerships with Sharecare departments and global partners, the Manager of Global Central Operations drives market-leading performance quality and continuous operational excellence. Essential Job Functions: Provide support to Global partners’ leadership teams and global trainers to ensure they become SMEs. Deliver feedback and provide direction to Global partners. Ensure accountability and support of Global partners in meeting their SLAs. Communicate essential updates to internal initiatives, procedures, and policies. Support necessary documentation buildout, updates, and organization. Work closely with onshore Central Operations leadership team to ensure all workflows for global DC/QC teams align with internal SOPs, processes and procedures. Ensure adoption of and accountability of change management initiatives and ongoing oversight of implemented policies and processes for the Global team. Respond to escalated client/requester/interdepartmental issues. Support the Director of Central Operations, Director of Provider Global Operations and Senior Director of Vendor Strategy and Performance to establish SLAs, monthly production targets, OT parameters, and workforce management responsibilities. Meet regularly with Global partners and internal Global leaders to review team performance. Work with internal Central Ops leaders & Global QC/DC leadership teams to identify, analyze, and problem solve any areas of opportunity related to operational excellence and continuous improvement. Ensure Global partners have adequate access to essential applications/reporting necessary to their role and termination of access for Global contractors is executed upon departure. Support technical events that occur. Work with internal technology teams to support in the build-out and updates of necessary data/digital initiatives driven by the Director of Central Operations. Partner with internal and Global stakeholders to support automation, digital transformation and process improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, quality and business performance. Provide support to internal Central Operations team during periods of reduced capacity to ensure all managerial responsibilities are executed consistently across all Central Operations teams. Continually seek new opportunities to advance Sharecare ’s transition plan and achieve expected transition milestones and targets. Carry out responsibilities in accordance with policies and procedures, including HIPAA, state/federal regulations related to operations and labor regulations. Specific Skills/Attributes: Extremely team-oriented. Ability to work well in fast-paced, multi-tasking environment while prioritizing and meeting deadlines. Superior communication/documentation skills Outstanding customer service with strong negotiation skills. Detail oriented, with strong analytical skills and effective problem-solving skills. Ability to handle confidential materials and information in a professional manner. Consistent proactiveness. Ability to navigate ambiguous situations or pivot to meet the shifting needs of the business. Shares information transparently while maintaining a professional demeanor. Model Core competencies to all Sharecare colleagues and partners. Strong presentation skills. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required. Minimum 5 years’ Medical Records experience preferred. Minimum of 1 year management experience or 2 years lead experience preferred. Experience with management applications such as the Microsoft Suite of applications, Visio, CRM, Power BI, and Workday. CRIS certification required. Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law.
