Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility a
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our employer accounts. The Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for employer accounts introduced through Maven’s channel partnerships - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness. You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role, it’s a commercial position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen. This person will be on the front lines as a trusted advisor to our clients and a key partner to our channel partnership teams. As Client Success Manager at Maven, you will: Support the success and satisfaction of your portfolio of employer clients, helping ensure strong client retention and engagement Collaborate with channel/payer partner client executives to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio Assist in building and maintaining account plans, tracking renewal milestones, and identifying opportunities for growth. Monitor client health and engagement on an ongoing basis, flagging potential risks early and collaborating with your manager and team to develop mitigation plans. Identify potential opportunities for client expansion and collaborate with Sales to build business cases and handoffs. Partner with Sales and Renewals teams to ensure smooth account transitions and handoffs, contributing to clear narratives and data-supported recommendations. Support client enrollment and engagement initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes, such as employee utilization, satisfaction, or program adoption. Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and other client-facing presentations, sharing data insights and supporting renewal or expansion discussions. Consult clients on program optimization using Maven’s expertise, benchmark data, and program resources, ensuring measurable business impact. Maintain strong client relationships, fostering satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy, and supporting case studies or success stories where appropriate. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, analytics, marketing) to support client projects, timelines, and deliverables. Manage client inquiries, issues, and escalations, coordinating with partner teams as needed to resolve challenges. Share client insights internally to help improve products, processes, and marketing initiatives. Recommend improvements to client workflows or processes, supporting scalable solutions to enhance outcomes. What we’re looking for you to bring: 5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services within digital health, healthcare, benefits, or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and contribute to commercial outcomes. Experience working with enterprise employer clients through channel/payer partners (5,000+ employees) preferred. Proven ability to support and execute marketing or engagement strategies that drive measurable client outcomes. Passion for healthcare and supporting organizational change. Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless experience for clients, providing insights that inform product, process, or market improvements. History of contributing to client retention, renewal management, and account growth opportunities. Ability to build and maintain relationships with multiple stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance), navigating client environments effectively. Experience partnering with Sales or Renewals teams to support commercial opportunities and account growth. Strong interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met. Analytical skills and strategic thinking – able to translate data and client performance into actionable insights in collaboration with clients. Experience supporting the full lifecycle of customer success post-sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management). Comfort operating in a growing and evolving environment, adaptable to changing processes and ambiguity. Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 20%) for client meetings and participate in our NYC office when needed. Helpful experiences and skills (not required, can be learned on the job): Experience at a digital health company in health, wellness, or family health space. Experience with managing high volume of clients is preferred Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients. Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker, and Microsoft Office suite. The base salary range for this role is $106,000 - 120,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset. New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those based in NewYork, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days . This role requires active work authorization in the US. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-client-success-manager

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.description: How You'll Contribute As a Freelance Spanish Data Annotation Specialist at Docplanner , your main focus will be preparing and curating linguistically and medically oriented datasets in Spanish to power our machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) initiatives. You will work independently while maintaining clear communication with our NLP experts, ensuring the accuracy and relevance of our data for the Spanish market, and contributing directly to the quality and reliability of our AI-driven products in the medical domain. This role is ideal for candidates with a strong linguistic background in Spanish who are passionate about working in the healthcare and technology space. The ideal candidate has experience in data annotation, transcription, and text analysis, combined with a basic understanding of medical terminology and concepts. Key Responsibilities: Prepare and maintain medically oriented datasets for machine learning purposes, ensuring high-quality data annotation and consistency. Follow and provide feedback on annotation and labeling conventions, as well as perform audio transcriptions in Spanish (aligning audio with text and correcting text based on audio). Implement text patterns to detect and extract named entities in Spanish, such as names, addresses, organization names, ID numbers, and medical terms. Contribute to dictionaries and taxonomies in Spanish for use in NLP systems. Evaluate the correctness and accuracy of Spanish words, sentences, and text structures, ensuring linguistic quality and consistency. Deliver high-quality work within established deadlines and communicate proactively about project progress and challenges. What We're Looking For: Languages: Native Spanish speaker and Full Professional Level of English Linguistic Expertise: A degree or strong background in Italian linguistics, computational linguistics, or a related field. Medical Knowledge: Familiarity with Spanish medical terminology or prior experience in the healthcare domain. Data Annotation: Hands-on experience with data annotation, transcription, and labeling tools. Text Analysis: Proficiency in working with text patterns and dictionaries for NLP purposes. Attention to Detail: Exceptional ability to assess and improve data quality. Self-Management: Strong ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and consistently meet deadlines. Which skills are 'bonus points'? Previous experience in AI, machine learning, or data preparation projects. Knowledge of multiple languages or dialects beyond Spanish and English. Exposure to medical coding systems (e.g., ICD, CPT) or electronic health records (EHR). Experience working as a freelancer on similar annotation or linguistic projects.

items.description: About Dutchie Founded in 2017, Dutchie is an all-in-one technology platform powering the cannabis industry with Point of Sale , E-commerce , Payments , and Loyalty & Marketing . Through our technology, we’re helping cannabis businesses start, operate, and grow with confidence. With software that simplifies their operations, our customers can focus on what matters most—bringing the benefits of cannabis safely to consumers. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors. About This Role Join us in our pursuit to provide dispensaries and their customers the absolute best online and in store experiences. We're seeking an Account Executive to join our dynamic sales team and contribute to our position as an industry leader. In this role, you will have ownership of the entire sales process from beginning to end. We’re seeking someone who’s driven to win and embodies a consultative sales approach. You are process-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and have a concrete grasp of the SaaS industry. This is a work-from-home role based in the US (Northern California) with up to 50% travel within the states. What You'll Do… Build and nurture a strong sales pipeline. Conduct compelling online and in-person demos. Develop and execute a strategic plan for your territory to meet monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. Maintain up-to-date and accurate customer and deal information in Salesforce for precise territory management and reporting. Collaborate with various teams to ensure seamless transitions and timely launches. Embody Dutchie’s values: It's All About The Customer, “We” Not “I”, Focus On Outcomes, Get There Fast, Embrace Different Perspectives, Get Shit Done, and Be Direct, with Empathy, Utilize First Principles. Become an expert on the California Cannabis market What You Bring Exceptional Sales Background: Proven track record of consistent success in B2B sales. Strong Business Acumen: Robust understanding of business principles and the ability to align Dutchie's solutions with clients' strategic objectives. Cross-functional Collaboration: Experience working collaboratively with various teams to drive successful customer outcomes. Strategic Thinker: Ability to think strategically and identify opportunities for revenue growth. Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and can adapt to evolving market conditions. Growth Mindset: Demonstrates resilience, grit, curiosity, coachability, and emotional intelligence, fostering continuous personal and professional development. Software as a service (SaaS) industry experience required. It’s a Bonus If You… Have experience in cannabis or fintech Compensation and Benefits We are targeting an OTE of $144,000 - $188,000 based on the intended level for this role. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes: Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans to ensure you always have the best care Equity packages in the form of stock options Work-from-home office stipend ($700 to make your space as great as possible! Think new desk chair, monitor, printer, etc.) Monthly cell phone and internet stipend Parental leave paid at 100% FTO (flexible time off) in addition to company holidays At Dutchie, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Account Executive for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up. Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience Qualifications We Value: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel) Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts Nice-to-Have: CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents) Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem) Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained Language & Travel: Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed. Comp: €110K-€135K base, €220K-€270K OTE + equity Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email). Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed. Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta .ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

items.summary: At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and…
items.description: At Roofr , we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products. We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact. This position is for an existing vacancy. ***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.*** Roofr is growing our Onboarding team, and we're looking for a Spanish-speaking Onboarding Manager (contract) to own the most important window in a customer's journey: the moment they sign to the moment they're live, confident, and getting real value from Roofr. We onboard hundreds of new customers every month across multiple products. Many of them run established roofing businesses but are new to technology, which means the way you show up matters as much as what you know. This role is built for someone who thrives in high-volume environments, believes great onboarding creates the conditions for everything that comes after, and finds real satisfaction in watching a customer go from uncertain to capable. Your goal is simple: help customers feel the difference Roofr makes in their business as quickly as possible, and make sure getting there doesn't feel overwhelming. We pay attention to two things to know we're on track: how much of what a customer set out to use in Roofr they're actually working with day-to-day, and whether they'd say the onboarding experience genuinely helped them. Those signals tell us where customers are thriving and where we can do better. They're our compass. What You’ll Do: Own the full onboarding journey for net-new Roofr customers, from supporting them through Account Setup and training through to a clean handoff to their Customer Success Manager. Manage multiple concurrent onboardings in a high-volume environment, balancing dedicated 1:1 sessions with scalable, group-based training. Guide customers through Roofr in a way that’s practical, confidence-building, and tailored to their unique business workflows, goals, and level of technical experience. Drive customers to a clear graduation milestone: they're live, self-sufficient, and ready for handoff to their Customer Success Manager.. Work closely with the Account Setup Team as an onboarding consultant, ensuring Roofr is configured to reflect each customer's real needs and lay the foundation for strong adoption. Deliver engaging live training sessions and group webinars that drive real adoption, not just familiarity. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Retention, Product, and the Customer Success team to surface friction, close gaps, and ensure every handoff is clean. Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of Roofr's onboarding playbook, building something that scales, not just something that works today. Act as a trusted guide during a high-stakes window, helping customers prioritize, build good habits, and set themselves up for long-term success in Roofr. What You'll Bring to the Role: Fluent in Spanish (written and spoken) 2+ years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or enablement within an SMB, B2B, or SaaS environment Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment Strong communication and presentation skills across live calls, video meetings, email, and webinars Ability to build rapport quickly and adapt your approach based on customer goals, maturity, and engagement level Proven ability to manage customer needs while making thoughtful, outcome-driven recommendations Comfort demonstrating product value and guiding customers toward broader adoption and better business outcomes High ownership mentality with the ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities, and follow through consistently Exceptional organization, time management, and attention to detail to deliver a reliable, high-quality onboarding experience Who You Are: A true customer advocate Highly organized and results-oriented Detail-obsessed (in the best way) You know how to adapt your approach depending on who’s in front of you. You are always looking for ways to improve and scale what works Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tools quickly Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact. What we offer (US + Canada) When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: ️ Vacation/Paid Time Off: 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2! 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!) Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years Flexible time off 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada RRSP/401k match Generous Parental Leave policy Perks: We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career Home office setup stipend Internet and phone allowance Remote first culture Weekly Friday paydays! AI Notice At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you. Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users ). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too. And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️ ⚠️ Important Notice We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls. To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers . If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com . Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance! Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

items.description: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies. You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) . Key Responsibilities SEO Strategy & Optimization Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis. Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance. Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data. Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates. Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO). Paid Advertising & Lead Generation Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads . Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels. Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns. Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals. Content Marketing & Website Management Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives. Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages. Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms . Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager . Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports. Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns. Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Marketing Automation & CRM Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows. Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign . Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs. Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing. Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization . Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines. Availability during U.S. Business Hours . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting. Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results. You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together. You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance. You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements. You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams. What a Typical Day Looks Like Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability. Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance. Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results. After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses. Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation. Apply Now If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you. items.summary: About usFounded in 1996, Argos Multilingual is a global provider of technology-enabled language, AI and data solutions.
items.description: About us Founded in 1996, Argos Multilingual is a global provider of technology-enabled language, AI and data solutions. We combine human expertise, technology and AI to help organisations communicate, operate and grow across markets. We work with some of the world’s most recognised companies, from global technology leaders and e-commerce innovators to major organisations in life sciences and manufacturing. We are an international organisation with 400+ people across 42 countries. We continue to expand our capabilities in AI and data alongside our established language and localisation expertise, building on a strong foundation while embracing the opportunities created by new technology. About the role The Sourcing Specialist is responsible for identifying, attracting, qualifying, and onboarding freelance contributors to support AI data and annotation projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring the business has access to a scalable, diverse, and project-ready workforce capable of meeting evolving client and operational demands. Working closely with the Engagement Team, Project Managers, and Operations stakeholders, the Sourcing Specialist will build and maintain talent pipelines, manage candidate onboarding activities, and ensure newly sourced contributors’ transition smoothly into the active workforce community. The ideal candidate will have experience in talent sourcing, recruitment operations, crowdsourcing, or freelancer management and be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, project-driven environment. What you'll do Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development Develop and maintain qualified talent pipelines to support current and future project requirements. Source freelance contributors across multiple channels, including job boards, social media platforms, freelancer marketplaces, referrals, and sourcing databases. Build and maintain talent pipelines for a variety of AI data services, including annotation, transcription, evaluation, search relevance, content moderation, data collection, and linguistic projects. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to support project-specific hiring requirements. Identify and engage candidates with specialised skills, languages, demographics, or subject matter expertise. Monitor sourcing performance and recommend new channels to improve workforce acquisition outcomes. Support large-scale recruitment and workforce expansion initiatives. Candidate Qualification & Assessment Ensure candidates meet project requirements and quality standards before onboarding. Conduct candidate screening and qualification activities. Review applications, assess suitability, and verify eligibility requirements. Schedule assessments, qualification tests, and screening activities. Evaluate candidate skills and experience against project requirements. Coordinate with Project Managers and Operational teams regarding qualification criteria. Manage candidate progression through the sourcing and onboarding pipeline. Ensure candidates receive a positive and professional experience throughout the recruitment process. Onboarding & Workforce Preparation Support the successful onboarding of new contributors into the workforce community. Coordinate onboarding activities for newly approved contributors. Prepare onboarding documentation, contracts, and project-related requirements. Ensure all required compliance, documentation, and account creation activities are completed. Guide contributors through onboarding platforms and project readiness processes. Work closely with the Engagement Team & Project Management Team to ensure seamless handover following onboarding. Maintain onboarding trackers and ensure workforce readiness targets are achieved. Support onboarding for new projects, programme launches, and workforce ramp-ups. Workforce Operations & Administration Maintain accurate sourcing records and operational systems. Manage candidate records and maintain data accuracy across sourcing platforms. Administer and update Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and workforce databases. Maintain vendor portals and workforce management platforms. Process contracts, agreements, and documentation as required. Produce regular sourcing and pipeline reports for stakeholders. Ensure sourcing activities adhere to company policies, compliance requirements, and data protection standards. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Engagement and Project teams to ensure workforce supply aligns with project demand. Collaborate daily with the teams to understand contributor availability, workforce gaps, and retention trends. Partner with Engagement Specialists & Project Managers to ensure newly onboarded contributors remain active and connected to the community. Support reactivation initiatives by identifying opportunities to engage previous contributors before sourcing externally. Work closely with Project Managers to understand upcoming workforce requirements and project timelines. Provide workforce market insights, sourcing forecasts, and recruitment recommendations. Our mission is to develop trusted standards, tools, and market intelligence that accelerate the transition to a climate-resilient and low-carbon economy. The Resilience Product and Adoption Lead will lead on external adoption of the Climate Bonds Resilience Taxonomy (CBRT) and the resilience component of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy , as well as any new resilience products, to guide investment in climate Adaptation and Resilience (A&R). The overarching goal will be to ensure the uptake of these tools by ensuring they are fit-for-purpose, user-friendly and interoperable with the emerging approaches and decisions of a range of target stakeholders. The post will also support ad hoc technical advisory and consultancy services relating to resilience, especially in engaging financial institutions. How you'll contribute Develop and drive external uptake of resilience products Work with the cross-Climate Bonds teams to clarify a ‘product suite’ for resilience. Clarify for Climate Bonds commercial teams how to standardise a product range - leveraging the resilience taxonomy – to accelerate uptake by financial institutions. Work with other engagement teams across Climate Bonds, including but not limited to the regional teams and investor teams, seeking strategic entry and engagement with large-scale investors. Factor the thinking of regional and policy teams into evolving use cases for the CBRT (and / or resilience elements of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy). Participate in external advisory groups and events to promote the CBRT and other taxonomy products related to resilience. Ensure that CBRT development is aligned with due consideration to ‘product-market’ placem ent Cultivate relationships with financial institutions, investors, governments, and multilateral agencies who wish to adopt or incorporate the CBRT and the resilience component of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy in their operations and guidance. Based on this engagement, outline and strengthen specific use cases for the CBRT, clarifying which to invest in (and hence which not to prioritise). Do this by working with other engagement teams across Climate Bonds, including but not limited to the regional teams and investor teams. Institutionalise strong feedback loops within Climate Bonds to ensure that lessons from ‘external engagement’ with the CBRT are fed back into plans for further development of either the taxonomy or specific use cases (includes liaison with the Climate Bonds Data Team to ensure that market trends and the needs of the data customers are factored in). Direct and manage the evolution of the CBRT (as a tool / platform) to better serve user needs, as well as adapt to a world where AI is reshaping work patterns globally. items.description: Role Title: Military Operations Expert Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote About the Role micro1 is seeking current or former military professionals with firsthand operational experience to contribute to an AI development project focused on military operations, tactical decision-making, and international humanitarian law. You'll evaluate AI-generated military scenarios, identify inaccuracies, and provide expert feedback to improve AI reasoning and reliability. Scope of Work Evaluate AI-generated military scenarios for operational realism, tactical accuracy, and sound decision-making. Review military planning, combat operations, targeting, and weapons employment scenarios. Assess the application of Rules of Engagement (ROE), Law of Armed Conflict (LOAC), and operational constraints. Identify inaccuracies and provide clear, structured written feedback. Qualifications Military operational experience in areas such as infantry, Special Operations Forces, combat aviation, artillery, targeting, air defense, naval operations, or military intelligence. Strong understanding of military operations, tactical planning, and operational decision-making. Ability to assess complex scenarios and communicate findings clearly in writing. Combat deployments, operational command, weapons specialization, or military instructional experience are highly desirable. Familiarity with ROE, LOAC, or international humanitarian law is a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Bilingual Mental Health Expert
items.summary: Role Title: Bilingual Mental Health Expert Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote We are engaging bilingual mental health experts to contribute to a customer’s project focused on enhancing AI systems with nuanced expertise.
items.description: Role Title: Bilingual Mental Health Expert Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote We are engaging bilingual mental health experts to contribute to a customer’s project focused on enhancing AI systems with nuanced expertise. In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Required Skills clinical psychology bilingual communication ethical decision-making cultural sensitivity analytical evaluation case study development written and verbal communication interdisciplinary collaboration psychological assessment documentation Scope of Work Analyze and evaluate AI-generated psychological content for accuracy, relevance, and ethical standards. Develop and review data sets involving psychological case studies, assessments, and conversations for AI system training. Craft detailed written feedback and verbal insights to refine AI responses in contexts such as clinical scenarios, research vignettes, and therapeutic dialogues. Identify potential biases or inaccuracies within AI-generated outputs and propose evidence-based improvements. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate psychological concepts and frameworks into AI model training processes. Ensure adherence to cultural, linguistic, and clinical best practices for diverse user scenarios. Contribute to documentation and knowledge-sharing resources that guide ongoing AI development. Preferred Qualifications Completed Ph.D in Psychology or MD with completed psychiatry residency. Native proficiency in at least one of: French, Malay, Russian, Mandarin, Japanese, Urdu, Swahili, Bulgarian, Tagalog, Polish, Marathi, Lithuanian, Georgian, Bengali, Vietnamese, or Indonesian, plus advanced English communication skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex psychological concepts clearly in both written and verbal formats. Experience in clinical practice, research, or higher education in psychology or psychiatry. Strong analytical and evaluative skills to assess psychological data and narrative content. Awareness of cultural sensitivity and ethical considerations in global mental health contexts. Previous experience collaborating on interdisciplinary or technology-driven projects is a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Talent Pool: Financial Well-being Expert
items.summary: Are you interested in joining us as a Freelance Financial Well-being expert, but don't see a specific role currently listed on our website?
items.description: Are you interested in joining us as a Freelance Financial Well-being expert, but don't see a specific role currently listed on our website? We are always looking to connect with talented professionals, so we’ve created a Permanent Talent Pool for future opportunities. Please note, this is a general application for our Permanent Talent Pool and is not tied to a specific active job posting. We will review your application and reach out when a matching assignment becomes available. Apply now to be considered for upcoming opportunities! Who we are At OpenUp , our mission is to make mental well-being accessible to everyone. We support companies, their employees, and their families with proactive and practical mental health services. Through our platform, clients can access 1:1 check-ins, online courses, articles, videos, group sessions, mindfulness practices, and a team of committed experts. We believe that mental and physical well-being are deeply connected. With Lifestyle Experts focusing on nutrition, exercise, and sleep, we offer a truly holistic approach that helps people take ownership of their health. We’re proud to work with forward-thinking organizations and are committed to raising the bar on accessible care. OpenUp is ranked in the Top 3 on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list for 2023, 2024 & 2025 and is still growing. We are expanding our international teams and we are searching for like-minded talent. We are already helping over 2000+ (international) companies and 550K+ employees, e.g. Rituals, Deloitte, Decathlon, KPMG, and McDonalds. About the assignment To fuel our growth, we are looking for entrepreneurial, purpose-driven experts who share our vision of making health and well-being direct, approachable, and impactful. At OpenUp , we focus on prevention, therefore we guide individuals to take control of their personal finances, reduce financial stress, and create healthy money habits. Whether it’s budgeting, savings strategies, planning for financial security, or building confidence in financial decision-making – we empower people with clarity and actionable steps. Please note we offer coaching, not financial product advice. We offer planned and on-demand video consults seven days a week, ensuring people can access support when they need it most – no long waits, no barriers. In each session (usually 25 minutes), you’ll help clients set clear, achievable financial goals and guide them toward meaningful first steps. Our mission is to help people build skills and autonomy, so they feel confident to continue their journey independently. Many clients find they gain what they need in just a few focused conversations – thanks to your structured, goal-oriented support. You’ll engage with a wide variety of people, from diverse cultural backgrounds and industries, and you’ll have opportunities to grow through weekly intervision sessions and ongoing development. We work together to make well-being accessible, practical, and empowering for everyone. About you You’re passionate about helping people improve their financial health and resilience. You enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and are eager to contribute to a meaningful mission. We welcome experts who meet the following criteria: Strong English communication skills (written and spoken) and confident in delivering consultations in English. BA degree in Finance, Economics, or Business Administration. Minimum 2+ years’ experience providing 1:1 consulting, financial advisory, or coaching on personal finance, budgeting, or financial well-being. Certification in financial planning, budget coaching or WFT (at least Basis and Asset management) (completed or in progress). Nice to have: local certifications, regulated advisory licenses, or financial coaching accreditations (e.g., in the Netherlands: WFT Asset Management under the Financial Supervision Act). Tech-savvy, with a self-reliant approach to digital platforms and systems. You have a laptop/computer with Windows 11, OR MacOS Sonoma 14, AND an antivirus turned on in your device. Entrepreneurial, proactive, and open to continuous learning. A team player who thrives independently and takes ownership of personal and professional growth. A natural connector: you create a safe, supportive space for clients and act decisively to help them move forward. You live the “practice what you preach” mindset, showing integrity and reflection in how you approach both clients and colleagues. What you can expect Join us at a time of exciting growth, where your expertise and ideas are valued. Here’s what you can expect: A freelance contract for an agreed amount of hours per week. A diverse and international team with expertise in psychology, health, lifestyle medicine, and financial well-being. A culture of reflection, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Weekly check-ins, intervision sessions, and skill-building opportunities. Two dedicated training half-days each year to reflect on your practice and develop your skills further. Next steps Inspired to be part of OpenUp (in the future)? We’d love to have you in our Talent Pool so you’ll be the first to know when an exciting assignment opens up that matches your profile! Send us your application in English through our website and leave your details. We’ll reach out when we see a strong match with one of our assignments - please note this may take a couple of weeks, depending on openings. If you have questions, please visit our FAQ page or reach out directly. At OpenUp , everyone is welcome to apply regardless of age, gender, background, nationality, or any other characteristic. What matters to us is high performance, a real drive to make an impact and the ambition to become the European market leader. If you're ready to OpenUp , join us! We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to streamline parts of our recruitment process. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by humans. If you would like more information about how we use AI in the process, please contact us. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C
items.summary: Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C Duration: 13 months, anticipated from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027 Estimated level of effort: Equivalent to three (3) days per week Location and availability: This is a remote consultancy open to applicants globally, with applications particularly encouraged from consultants based in Asia and Africa.
items.description: Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C Duration: 13 months, anticipated from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027 Estimated level of effort: Equivalent to three (3) days per week Location and availability: This is a remote consultancy open to applicants globally, with applications particularly encouraged from consultants based in Asia and Africa. The Consultant must be able to coordinate across time zones and participate in agreed meetings with the Platform’s international membership. About the Global Platform: The Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C is a consortium of civil society organisations, champions, survivors, and grassroots representatives working together to accelerate the abandonment and prevention of female genital mutilation/cutting (FGM/C). Established following consultations initiated at the 2019 Women Deliver conference in Vancouver, the Global Platform brings together members across regions to exchange knowledge, strengthen collaboration, and advance collective advocacy. Its Global Call to Action to End FGM/C, launched in November 2019, calls for urgent, coordinated action to end FGM/C. The Global Platform works across intersecting movements, including those addressing sexual and gender-based violence, sexual and reproductive health and rights, and child, early, and forced marriage. Purpose of the Consultancy: The Global Platform seeks a consultant to provide coordination, governance, membership, and communications support. The assignment will help translate members’ collective commitments into an achievable programme of joint action and strengthen the Platform’s longer-term sustainability. The consultancy will focus on three priorities, in the following order: Strengthening governance and membership arrangements. Establishing consistent coordination and communications. Supporting resource mobilisation and longer-term sustainability. Advocacy activities, events, and other requests will be prioritised within the agreed workplan, level of effort, and available budget. Scope of Work and Expected Deliverables: 1. Inception and work planning In consultation with the Core Group and Equality Now , the Consultant will: Review existing governance documents, membership arrangements, communications channels, and relevant commitments. Prepare an inception workplan within the first month, setting out deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and a realistic allocation of the available consultancy time. Identify decisions, member contributions, and resources needed to complete the assignment. 2. Governance and membership The Consultant will: Facilitate consultation on, and prepare a final draft of, the Platform’s membership terms of reference, including the proposed two-tier membership model, for Core Group approval. Develop practical guidance on membership, decision-making, and the respective responsibilities of members and the Core Group. Establish an organised membership database using an agreed system, with appropriate access and information-handling arrangements. Develop a membership outreach and onboarding approach, prioritising grassroots and survivor-led organisations and organisations based in the Global Majority. Produce an accessible overview of the Platform, its purpose, and opportunities for participation. 3. Coordination and member engagement The Consultant will: Coordinate monthly Core Group meetings, including scheduling, preparation, and follow-up. Circulate agendas and relevant materials at least one (1) week before each meeting, subject to timely input from members. Circulate meeting records and an updated action tracker within five (5) working days after each meeting. Maintain a central record of agreed decisions, actions, responsibilities, and deadlines. Provide a central contact point for Platform enquiries and coordinate responses with the appropriate members. Facilitate member contributions and flag outstanding decisions or dependencies that may affect delivery. 4. Communications and shared resources The Consultant will: Develop and implement a proportionate communications schedule covering the internal listserv, public mailing list, and social media channels. Coordinate member contributions and prepare content for approval through agreed processes. Coordinate website content updates and provide agreed content and member input to the external website redesign consultant. Support the development of common messages and positioning for Core Group approval. Organise key documents and resources so that members can access and use them. 5. Strategic planning and sustainability The Consultant will: Facilitate the development of a three-year strategic workplan, including objectives, priority actions, indicative responsibilities, and resource requirements, for Core Group approval. Develop a practical tracker for commitments under the Movement-led Collective Vision on Ending FGM/C, drawing on updates provided by participating members. Map potential funding and partnership opportunities and recommend a prioritised approach to follow-up. Prepare a concise impact summary and a core set of materials to support partnership development and fundraising. Develop recommendations for sustaining the Platform’s coordination function beyond the consultancy period. The Consultant will support resource mobilisation but will not be responsible for guaranteeing funding or the performance of individual member organisations. 6. Joint advocacy and events Within the agreed workplan and available resources, the Consultant will: Provide secretariat support for the Platform’s engagement with the FGM/C Donor Working Group. Coordinate the preparation and dissemination of three shared advocacy materials during the consultancy period. Coordinate at least two webinars during the consultancy period, including agreed co-host arrangements, speaker coordination, and follow-up. Support the meaningful participation of grassroots activists and survivors in the planning and delivery of these activities. Support selected joint advocacy events were expressly included in the agreed workplan. Any additional events or travel will require prior agreement on scope, timing, funding, and any effect on other deliverables. Representation of the Platform will require an agreed mandate and approved messaging. 7. Progress reporting and handover The Consultant will: Submit a short quarterly progress report summarising completed deliverables, progress against the workplan, challenges, and decisions required. Coordinate agreed narrative inputs for donor reporting and maintain an activity expenditure tracker in collaboration with Equality Now . Financial approvals and formal donor submissions will remain with the authorised organisation. Submit a final report and handover package before the consultancy ends, including key documents, outstanding actions, and recommendations for continuity. Contracting, Coordination, and Duration Equality Now will contract and administer this independent consultancy, which is not an employee position, for 13 months, from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027, with an estimated level of effort equivalent to three (3) days per week. The Consultant will organise delivery independently, coordinating availability across time zones for agreed meetings and deadlines. Equality Now ’s designated focal point will consolidate feedback, coordinate approvals, and accept deliverables, working with the Ending Gender-based Violence team. The Global Platform’s Core Group will guide substantive priorities and approve outputs requiring collective agreement. Member requests will follow this coordination process. Performance will be assessed against agreed deliverables and milestones. Material changes to scope, timing, or level of effort require prior written agreement with Equality Now . The consultancy agreement will address confidentiality, intellectual property, information security, safeguarding, and payment. Any extension will require available funding and a separate written agreement; renewal is not guaranteed. Consultancy Fee and Payment: The total consultancy fee is USD 26,000, payable in thirteen monthly instalments of USD 2,000, subject to satisfactory delivery of the services and submission of an invoice and brief progress summary. The consultancy agreement will specify the invoicing periods and payment schedule, including the treatment of the first and final partial calendar months. Travel and other reimbursable expenses are separate from the consultancy fee and must be approved in writing before they are incurred, subject to available funding and the terms of the consultancy agreement. Consultant Qualifications and Experience: The Consultant should demonstrate: Relevant coordination experience: A track record of coordinating coalitions, networks, or multi-stakeholder initiatives, including facilitating meetings, maintaining action plans, and supporting delivery across organisations. Relevant subject knowledge: An understanding of FGM/C and its connections to gender equality, human rights, and sexual and reproductive health and rights. Inclusive facilitation and relationship-building: Experience working respectfully with diverse partners, including grassroots organisations and survivor-led movements, and enabling meaningful participation across regions and time zones. Governance and planning skills: The ability to translate consultation and collective priorities into practical governance arrangements, membership processes, and achievable strategic workplans. Strong communications skills: The ability to produce clear, accessible written materials, synthesise contributions from multiple stakeholders, and coordinate digital communications. Strong written and spoken English is required; additional languages are an advantage. Independent delivery: The ability to organise the assignment, exercise sound judgement, manage competing priorities, and deliver agreed outputs within the available time and budget. Experience supporting resource mobilisation, donor reporting, joint advocacy, or online events would be an advantage. Relevant professional, community-based, and lived experience will be valued. Applicants should demonstrate a commitment to feminist principles, safeguarding, and respectful engagement with survivors. HOW TO APPLY Please visit: and submit a resume/CV and cover letter. The applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the application period closes at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on 30 October, 2026. Due to the volume of applicants anticipated for this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, savings, health and vacation benefits, and is an Equal Opportunity employer. Equality Now employees are selected on the basis of ability without regard to race, colour, religious beliefs, sex, gender identity and expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, or sexual orientation. We welcome all kinds of diversity. Candidates are selected on the basis of ability, in accordance with all country and location-specific law Salary: $26,000 Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence SME
items.summary: Role Title: Cyber Threat Intelligence SME Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging Cyber Threat Intelligence SMEs to contribute to a leading-edge customer project focused on evaluating and mapping advanced cyber threat scenarios.
items.description: Role Title: Cyber Threat Intelligence SME Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Cyber Threat Intelligence SMEs to contribute to a leading-edge customer project focused on evaluating and mapping advanced cyber threat scenarios. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Map cyber threat intelligence (CTI) cases to established taxonomies, especially within the surveillance and privacy evaluation domains. Author boundary cases illustrating prohibited surveillance, attribution, and intrusion-adjacent requests, helping delineate permissible and impermissible actions. Evaluate and grade submitted threat responses with special attention to source reliability, analytic reasoning, stated limitations, and actionable utility. Identify and flag instances of over-refusal, ensuring legitimate threat analysis is not unnecessarily declined. Document and clarify challenging edge cases involving nation-state operations and other advanced threats. Provide concise written and verbal feedback to support the continuous improvement of AI threat assessment capabilities. Preferred Qualifications Substantial experience in cyber threat intelligence, particularly where nation-state operations intersect with advanced cyber threats. Expertise in distinguishing between legitimate defensive/analytic activities and impermissible offensive or surveillance-focused requests. Background in threat-actor attribution, APT tracking, or exposure to adversary tactics and techniques. Demonstrated proficiency in authoring clear, structured written content in English and communicating complex concepts verbally. Experience mentoring, teaching, or leading professionals in threat intelligence disciplines. Prior participation in AI system evaluation, red-teaming, or related quality assurance projects is a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas
