items.summary: About LiaHiaLiaHia supports professionals worldwide in making confident career moves through practical coaching, strong personal branding, and job-search strategy.
items.description: About LiaHia LiaHia supports professionals worldwide in making confident career moves through practical coaching, strong personal branding, and job-search strategy. We work with clients across industries and geographies, helping them clarify direction, communicate value, and land roles that fit. Role Overview As a Career Coach / Career Consultant at LiaHia , you will partner with clients internationally to accelerate their career growth and job-search outcomes. You’ll deliver high-impact coaching sessions, provide actionable guidance, and elevate client positioning through resume and LinkedIn optimization. This role is ideal for an experienced coach/consultant who blends empathy with structure, and strategy with execution. What You’ll Do Conduct 1:1 career coaching sessions (discovery, goal-setting, accountability, and progress tracking) Assess client backgrounds and translate experience into clear career narratives and target-role positioning Optimize resumes for clarity, impact, and relevance (achievement-driven bullets, role alignment, ATS-aware formatting) Optimize LinkedIn profiles (headline, about section, experience, keywords, and overall brand consistency) Coach clients on job-search strategy: targeting, networking, outreach messaging, and interview preparation Create tailored action plans with measurable milestones and timelines Provide thoughtful, timely feedback on client drafts and iterations (resume, LinkedIn, and supporting materials) Maintain high standards of confidentiality, professionalism, and client experience across cultures and time zones What We’re Looking For 5–19 years of experience in career coaching, career consulting, recruiting, talent acquisition, HR, or related fields Demonstrated success delivering career coaching sessions that lead to tangible client outcomes Strong expertise in resume writing/optimization and LinkedIn optimization for multiple industries and seniority levels Excellent communication skills: able to simplify complex feedback into clear next steps Client-first mindset with strong empathy, professionalism, and accountability Comfort working with international clients across different cultures, markets, and time zones Highly organized: able to manage multiple clients, deadlines, and iterative document reviews Nice to Have Experience coaching mid-to-senior professionals, career changers, or leadership candidates Familiarity with ATS principles, keyword strategy, and role-specific tailoring Interview coaching experience (behavioral, competency-based, and case/role-specific formats) Coaching certifications or relevant training (e.g., ICF-aligned programs) or equivalent practical experience What Success Looks Like Clients leave sessions with clarity, confidence, and a concrete plan of action Resumes and LinkedIn profiles are sharply positioned, achievement-focused, and aligned to target roles Clients demonstrate improved response rates (recruiter outreach, interview invitations) and stronger interview performance Consistent, high-quality coaching delivery and excellent client satisfaction across engagements Hours vary based on client volume and are not guaranteed. Work Location International (serving clients globally) Schedule flexibility may be needed to accommodate multiple time zones Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Customer Transformation Specialist
items.summary: Customer Transformation SpecialistLocation: LATAM · Work Model: Fully remote · Language: Spanish + English C1/C2 About KoronetKoronet is the leading vertical SaaS, B2B e-commerce, and payments software company for the over $50 Billion global B2B floral industry.
items.description: Customer Transformation Specialist Location: LATAM · Work Model: Fully remote · Language: Spanish + English C1/C2 About Koronet Koronet is the leading vertical SaaS, B2B e-commerce, and payments software company for the over $50 Billion global B2B floral industry. Our solution consists of an inventory and operations management SaaS solution and an e-commerce network that enables end-to-end transactions through the B2B supply chain. Managing many of the largest businesses in the industry, our products help keep florists’ shelves stocked, weddings brightly bloomed, and Valentine’s Day brilliant red. We are the parent company to the leading ERP, operations and e-commerce solutions in the floral industry, including Komet Sales, Axerrio and UNOSOF. The company has teams in Florida, Ecuador, Argentina, Uruguay, Netherlands and Colombia. Our global Network of partners includes hundreds of flower growers, importers, and wholesalers who collectively represent a material portion of the global flower market. Our mission is to be the unified operating floral supply chain by providing mission-critical business operations solutions powering the largest B2B e-commerce network. We are a fast-growing company backed by a leading growth equity fund, fueling our expansion across North America and Europe through both organic growth and acquisitions. Why this role exists: We help customers get more value from Koronet by changing how they work—whether that’s buying smarter, serving their own buyers better, or cutting out friction. Role Overview: We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.' Transactions at Koronet : Transactions connects how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'—we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone. What you will do: Understand how customers operate: buying, selling, inventory, and operational friction. Guide customers to get more value by suggesting practical behavior changes. Lead discovery to uncover real constraints and trade-offs rather than surface-level issues. Give honest advice on what Koronet can do, what needs a workaround, and what isn't possible yet. Treat objections as valuable feedback, not personal rejection. Drive adoption through testing, follow-through, and clear evidence of progress. Share field insights with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to improve our product and strategy. How you will work with other departments CS & Implementation: Prioritize measurable customer value over "completed tasks." Product & Support: Provide specific evidence, workflows, and outcomes to guide development. Marketing & Revenue: Use real-world feedback to improve messaging and targeting. Growth Systems: Use account data to prepare for smarter, more relevant conversations. What success looks like Increased digital buying and selling in our ecosystem The team understands exactly why actions succeed or fail and applies that learning. Customers trust us because we’re transparent and don't oversell. The wider team gets clear, early feedback that makes our product and workflows better. A few things this role isn't! A reactive ticket-queue owner or a replacement for implementation. A quota-chaser who makes promises other teams have to clean up. A project coordinator focused only on tracking activity. A silo; you are the direct link between our customers and our product team. What do we expect from you: Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B operational transformation. Fluent in English (must). Enjoy speaking with customers and feel comfortable leading difficult conversations. Listen well and communicate clearly, connecting changes to real customer incentives. Handle objections with curiosity and use them to improve future conversations. Has strong organizing skills. Team Player, who shares information and puts company goals first. Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus. What We Offer: An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization. Flexible / Remote working environment. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth. Why Join Koronet : Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere. Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success. Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities. Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience. If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY Storyblok is hiring a Salesforce Lead to own Salesforce architecture, execution, governance, data quality, integrations, and release discipline across our GTM workflows. This techno-functional owner moves from business process to system design, build coordination, release control, data quality, reporting impact, and user adoption, owning Sales Cloud and core CRM objects, Pardot / Account Engagement, DealHub CPQ integration, lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash workflows, routing, campaign and lifecycle data, permissions, integrations, and documentation. The role also leads future platform evaluation for Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs, and, if a platform is selected, leads implementation planning and execution with RevOps, Marketing Operations, Data, Finance, Legal, vendors, and external partners. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Salesforce architecture and GTM systems governance Own Salesforce platform architecture across GTM workflows, objects, fields, permissions, automations, integrations, and release control. Translate RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Data requirements into clean system design and controlled execution. Maintain governance for new fields, objects, flows, validation rules, permission sets, integrations, reporting dependencies, and documentation. Sales Cloud and core CRM ownership Own system design for leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, activities, campaigns, lifecycle stages, routing, renewals, expansions, and customer handoffs. Support lead-to-cash workflows with clear ownership, required fields, source logic, stage rules, assignment logic, and adoption checks. Monitor CRM completeness, data freshness, duplicates, routing failures, and workflow friction that creates manual workarounds. Pardot, Account Engagement, and marketing workflow support Partner with Marketing Operations on Pardot or Account Engagement, campaign data, lifecycle stages, scoring inputs, consent, routing, attribution support, and funnel reporting. Maintain the Salesforce-side architecture for marketing-to-sales handoffs, campaign member data, source fields, conversion logic, and reporting quality. Keep current marketing workflows stable while future marketing cloud and CDP options are evaluated. Future Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle, and CDP evaluation Lead the requirements, scorecard, architecture review, vendor comparison, data governance review, and implementation readiness plan for future customer data and marketing cloud decisions. Evaluate Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs against GTM use cases, data model, activation, consent, reporting, integration, cost, and operating complexity. If a platform is selected, lead implementation planning and execution with clear phases, owners, risks, testing, migration, enablement, and adoption metrics. DealHub CPQ integration, data quality, releases, and adoption Own Salesforce-side integration quality for DealHub CPQ, including quote data, approval sync, product lines, opportunity fields, order handoffs, and reporting impact. Run release management with intake, solution design, testing, regression checks, deployment, communication, documentation, and adoption tracking. Partner with Data on source-to-report logic so Salesforce, warehouse, Finance, and leadership reporting stay aligned. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6+ years in the Salesforce ecosystem, including hands-on administration and solution / architecture ownership in a GTM or Revenue Operations context. Salesforce certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder; Sales Cloud Consultant or Application Architect a plus). Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, core CRM objects, declarative automation (Flow), permissions, and release / change management across environments. Experience with Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and marketing-to-sales workflows, and with CPQ tools (DealHub or comparable) across lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash. Experience integrating Salesforce with downstream systems (data warehouse, Finance, marketing, order management) and supporting reporting and data quality. Familiarity with CDP / marketing cloud platform evaluation (e.g., Salesforce Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle Responsys) is a plus. Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES Systems thinking: translates cross-functional business requirements into clean, scalable system design and governance. Technical CRM depth: strong command of Salesforce architecture, data model, automation, permissions, and integrations. Release and change discipline: structured intake, testing, regression, deployment, documentation, and adoption tracking. Data quality and governance orientation: drives completeness, freshness, deduplication, and field control. Stakeholder management: partners effectively across RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, CS, Finance, Data, Legal, and vendors. Vendor and platform evaluation: builds requirements, scorecards, and implementation readiness plans for major platform decisions. Clear communication: explains what is being built, the decision needed, and the business outcome to technical and non-technical audiences. Bias for reliability: reduces defects, manual workarounds, and ambiguity through documentation and controlled execution. U.S. Base Salary Range: $102,900 - $140,000 At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure. MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems , the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance. AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. What You’ll Work On Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. What We’re Looking For You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content. You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't. You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007 . WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide . You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, United States; San Francisco, California, United States About Checkr Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic. We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company . About the Role Truework, recently acquired by Checkr, provides access to crucial employment, income information and asset information needed for mortgage loans, apartment rentals, background checks, and more. We are disrupting a $5B+ industry, dominated by legacy incumbents and outdated processes, with a better product and intense customer focus. Within Checkr, Truework operates independently, allowing rapid iteration while also being able to leverage the strengths and assets from our core business. Think of it like joining a startup within a startup! As a Strategic Account Executive on the Truework team, you’ll help scale our impact across large national and regional lenders, with a primary focus on acquiring new clients to Truework Verification services. As automated verification services become a more common practice for lenders in how they run their operation, you’ll lead the charge in building and executing a more repeatable playbook to drive new customers who will grow with us for years to come. By deeply understanding their unique company challenges and goals, you will pair them with solutions that will help them reach their business objectives and innovate within their organizations. This role is ideal for a proven sales professional who: has experience selling transformational solutions to customers, where you can quickly identify and pattern map where and how the Truework solution can drive impact in a customer’s operation has experience identifying and building relationships with decision makers, business and technology influencers and users, closing 6- and 7-figure pursuits who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment— ready to help close the gap between the legacy solutions and processes lending teams are leaning on and their plans and intentions to deliver competitive and streamlined processes for consumers You will be an important part of an elite, professional, and rapidly growing cross-functional team that succeeds through collaboration, grit, and learning. What you’ll do Deliver Sales Excellence: Consistently achieve pipeline and revenue targets by applying modern sales techniques and processes to efficiently manage top of funnel engagement tactics and deal strategy and close processes Think outside-the-box to cultivate awareness of the Truework vision. Plan and execute targeted campaigns for your territory working with the marketing and partner teams to scale your coverage and build pipeline Partner with and guide the efforts of our internal team to support your accounts in pre-sales activities and in the deployment to execute on agreed upon account goals, strategies and tactics for growth Leverage analytics, case studies, past performance, and market intelligence to create a territory plan and craft your own target account strategies. Manage Account Relationships: Have an understanding of the lender’s operation and an ability to identify the varying use cases where verification services can drive impact Exhibit deep and up-to-date knowledge of our product portfolio in order to communicate the benefits of new features and enhancements Show proficiency in navigating buy team personas, with intentional activities for executive bridging and champion building Exhibit Industry- & Customer-specific Business Acumen: Actively understand each customer’s strategic growth plans, technology footprint, and corresponding technology strategy, internal challenges, and competitive landscape. Review public information (e.g., new executive appointments, earnings statements, press releases) for the company and its competitors to stay updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the prospect. Be equipped to identify and discover centers of value for lenders, and conduct analysis to quantify ROI and impact of our solution on their operation Be a good teammate Represent both market trends and client needs to the Executive and the Product teams to ensure we are both serving current needs well and evolving our products and portfolio to identify future client needs Show unparalleled grit - constantly experiment, be willing to pivot, and have resiliency regardless of the obstacles faced What you bring 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience, selling transformative technology solutions Experience closing new business accounts and building pipeline using modern marketing tactics Experience selling to EVPs, CXOs and end-users (in the same sales cycle) in both individual and team sales environments Ability to navigate large organizations’ political landscape to maintain and expand relationships at all levels General knowledge in common sales practices like MEDDPICC, Command of the Message (Force Management), Challenger, Power Selling, or others Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to simplify complex topics in a friendly and approachable manner, present executive-level business cases Ability to juggle and complete multiple priorities and projects (internally and externally) in a fast-paced environment You are smart, self-motivated, organized, disciplined, inquisitive, detail-oriented, and process-oriented; you have an ownership mentality within all aspects of your work You have a growth mindset that is always learning, growing, and actively seeking feedback You have a team-first mentality—you show up for your team and expect the same in return. You enjoy planning, adjusting, executing, winning, and celebrating as a team. An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes. Pay Transparency Disclosure We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website . On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA) $298,642 — $351,343 USD Pay Transparency Disclosure One of Checkr’s core values is Transparency. To live by that value, we’ve made the decision to disclose salary ranges in all of our job postings. We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website . On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (Remote) $229,724 — $351,343 USD What We Offer A fast-paced and collaborative environment Learning and development allowance Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services Flexible PTO policy Monthly wellness stipend At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location. Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance . Applicant Privacy Policy If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process. For applicants in Massachusetts: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. *Legitimate Checkr emails will always include our official domain name after the @ symbol (e.g., name@checkr.com or name@ext.checkr.com ). About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital. About the Role Tailscale is looking for an experienced Brand Designer to help bring our brand to life across every customer touchpoint. You'll create thoughtful, high-quality creative that helps people understand our products, builds trust with technical audiences, and supports some of our most important marketing initiatives. This role reports to the Team Lead and partners closely with Brand, Growth, Web, Content, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations. You'll own projects from concept through execution, contribute to the evolution of our design systems, and help us scale creative output without sacrificing quality. We're looking for someone who cares deeply about craft, thrives in collaborative environments but is able to work autonomously while requiring minimal direction, and enjoys solving complex communication problems through thoughtful design. Key Responsibilities Own brand design projects from creative brief through final delivery with limited guidance Design high-quality creative assets across web, campaigns, events, social media, presentations, product marketing, and internal communications Apply and thoughtfully extend Tailscale's visual identity across new formats and channels Create reusable templates, design systems, and creative processes that improve consistency and efficiency Partner closely with Growth, Web, Product Marketing, Content, and Developer Relations to deliver cohesive customer experiences Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders and thoughtfully incorporate feedback Balance multiple projects while consistently delivering polished, production-ready work Contribute ideas that improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our creative work What We Are Looking For 3+ years of professional experience in brand, marketing, or visual design Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design foundations: color theory, accessibility, typography, layout, and storytelling Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud Experience designing for digital marketing, websites, campaigns, and brand systems Strong understanding of production-ready design across digital and print Excellent communication and presentation skills Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with minimal oversight Experience collaborating cross-functionally with marketers, writers, developers, and other designers Strong attention to detail with a high bar for quality and consistency Comfortable giving and receiving constructive design feedback Actively seeks opportunities to refine processes, improve project organization, and make collaboration more effective through thoughtful recommendations. Curious by nature, with a desire to learn about the technical world of networking. Nice to Have Experience designing for B2B SaaS or developer-focused products Familiarity with design systems and component libraries Motion design or animation experience Illustration or icon design experience Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and web design constraints Experience supporting experimentation, conversion optimization, or growth marketing initiatives Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments Experience art-directing or mentoring junior designers As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set. US Pay Range $117,750 — $153,000 USD What We Offer An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life. A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles). Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family! Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description. Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation. Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents). Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter. Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people. Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tailscale-brand-designer-1

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote - US Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solution
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - US Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses. We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it. As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll work with a portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers across a wide range of verticals and industries. That means the best outcomes rarely come from running a standard playbook. We need someone who finds that energizing, someone curious enough to understand how a complex organization actually operates, disciplined enough to orchestrate complex,multi-threaded sales cycles, and resourceful enough to bring the right people in at the right moment. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning an initial opportunity into a strategic relationship, navigating increasingly complex deals, and finding new ways for Airtable to create value across an organization, you’ll thrive here. We hire Corporate AEs with growth in mind: you’ll get the exposure, coaching, and increasing deal complexity you need to ramp quickly toward becoming an Enterprise Account Executive. What you'll do Turn Airtable’s large self-service user base into new business, using existing adoption and proven use cases to uncover and develop high-potential opportunities. Build relationships with leaders across functions and industries, understanding what matters to them and finding opportunities to expand Airtable’s impact as their organizations grow. Own and prioritize your book of business, developing thoughtful account plans and finding your way from an initial champion to stakeholders across the organization. Lead complex sales cycles from first conversation through close, bringing in Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and other partners at the right moments to move opportunities forward. Become a trusted advisor to prospects: understand their business objectives and bring Airtable’s flexibility to life through compelling use cases that show how the platform can solve their problems and transform the way their teams work. Who you are You bring 1-3 years of quota-carrying closing experience at a technology company You’ve successfully closed deals with mid-market and larger organizations (50-3,000 FTEs), with a track record of hitting or exceeding your sales goals. You can run a structured sales process (e.g., Force Management) with rigor and self-awareness. You know where your deals stand, what needs to happen next, and which stakeholders to bring in at the right moments to move them forward. You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You build credibility with business leaders and executives, develop the trust needed to move opportunities forward, and create alignment across g stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle. You’re an adaptable seller. You’re comfortable moving across industries, use cases, and buyer personas, and you know how to make your approach relevant to each. What we offer Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. The on-target earnings range for this role is $182,800 to $238,100 for all office and remote locations. Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out Life at Airtable . Airtable is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any characteristic protected by applicable federal and state laws, regulations and ordinances. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant . VEVRAA-Federal Contractor If you have a medical condition, disability, or religious belief/practice which inhibits your ability to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please complete our Accommodations Request Form and let us know how we may assist you. Airtable is committed to participating in the interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Airtable’s collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here . For applicants that live in or have a link to Australia, please see this Privacy Collection Statement for details regarding Airtable's collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process. Stay Safe from Job Scams: All official Airtable communication will come from an @airtable.com email address. We will never ask you to share sensitive information or purchase equipment during the hiring process. If in doubt, contact us at hr@airtable.com . Learn more about avoiding job scams here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airtable-account-executive-corporate

Working within our existing AirOps workflows, this role serves as a central point of contact between
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ The Content Coordinator manages content assets and client communication throughout the production process, keeping projects organized and moving from initial intake through final delivery. Working within our existing AirOps workflows, this role serves as a central point of contact between clients, our editor, our stock image vendor, and the Content Production Manager. This is a coordination-focused role that combines clear communication, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through. The Content Coordinator ensures that each contributor has the information and assets they need, tracks outstanding tasks and approvals, and flags issues that could affect production timelines. Key responsibilities Coordinate content projects across each stage of production, following established AirOps workflows and internal processes. Collect, organize, and maintain client briefs, source materials, drafts, images, feedback, and final deliverables. Communicate with clients to request missing information, share status updates, clarify feedback, and follow up on approvals. Coordinate handoffs between clients, the editor, the stock image vendor, and the Content Production Manager. Track project status, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding requests, keeping production records accurate and current. Consolidate client feedback into clear, actionable instructions for the editor and other production contributors. Coordinate stock image requests and delivery, ensuring that selected assets align with the content brief and client requirements. Check that required assets, revisions, and approvals are complete before moving content to the next production stage. Flag delays, unclear requests, missing materials, or scope changes to the Content Production Manager. Prepare and organize final content assets for delivery, ensuring that files are clearly labeled and the correct versions are shared. Identify recurring coordination issues and suggest practical improvements to documentation, communication, and workflow execution. Qualifications and skills Experience in content coordination, marketing operations, project coordination, or a similar client-facing support role. Strong written communication skills and the ability to provide clear, professional updates to clients and internal contributors. Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and follow-ups. Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing content versions, feedback, and production assets. Comfort working within established workflows and learning tools such as AirOps. Ability to distinguish routine coordination needs from issues that require escalation. A proactive, dependable approach to keeping projects moving and closing communication gaps. Experience working with B2B SaaS clients. What success looks like Content projects move through production with timely handoffs and clearly documented next steps. Clients receive consistent updates and understand what is needed from them. Editors and vendors receive complete materials and actionable instructions. Content assets, feedback, and approvals remain organized and easy to locate. The Content Production Manager has reliable visibility into progress, blockers, and upcoming deadlines. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-content-coordinator-u-s-based-remote-contractor

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Wyoming, United States URL: http://orchard.co About Orchard 'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract. We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands. This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time. The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires. About the role What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed. You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet. This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell. Requirements You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native. You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change. You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive. You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell. Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies. You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one. Benefits £65,000 - £95,000 base + commission Unlimited PTO 6% pension contribution Travel budget for meetings, US trips included Remote first, with a London desk when you want one To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-founding-head-of-sales

items.title: Democratizing Foreign Policy Research Intern at Quincy Institute
items.summary: The Institute is seeking a research intern for our Democratizing Foreign Policy program, where the intern will work on the issues of Pentagon spending, money in politics, and the ways in which foreign governments and Pentagon contractors seek to influence U.S. foreign policy. Candidates should have an interest in these issues as well as strong rese
items.description: The Institute is seeking a research intern for our Democratizing Foreign Policy program, where the intern will work on the issues of Pentagon spending, money in politics, and the ways in which foreign governments and Pentagon contractors seek to influence U.S. foreign policy. Candidates should have an interest in these issues as well as strong research and writing skills. Responsibilities Research and writing of op-eds and articles as needed Research on U.S. policies relating to arms transfers, including consequences of U.S. sales and statistical research on major arms suppliers Research on foreign governments and Pentagon contractors lobbying for arms sales, U.S. military bases abroad, and, generally, the militarization of U.S. foreign policy Research on U.S. national security strategy and force posture with an eye towards crafting alternative approaches Conduct primary research on Pentagon contractors and the economic impacts of Pentagon spending–including investigating tradeoffs with other forms of government spending–for reports and policy briefs Investigate the influence of the military industrial complex on U.S. foreign policy Requirements Ability to work independently and take initiative Ability to work with and interpret primary documents Basic skills in data collection, database management, and basic statistical analysis Exemplary attention to detail and excellent writing skills (a record of published writing is preferred) Demonstrate a keen interest in the restraint-oriented approach of the Quincy Institute and thrive in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment General administrative work for the Quincy Institute, as needed The candidate must be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program in political science, international relations, regional studies, or a related field, or be a recent graduate in these areas Proficient in basic technical skills, including Google Suite. Advanced understanding of data analysis and using generative AI for research are a plus $18.40 - $18.40 an hour Interns will be able to work remotely or from the Quincy Institute’s Washington, DC office. The pay for this position is $18.40 per hour and is for an average of 19 hours per week. The initial term of the internship is three months but can be extended based on performance. Closing Date The application closes on November 15, 2026 (11:59 pm). To be considered, applicants should submit a cover letter, resume, and a writing sample (preferably a non-academic writing sample). Start Date Interns hired for this position will begin work in mid-January 2027 About The Quincy Institute (QI) Internship Program provides an opportunity for undergraduate, graduate students, and recent graduates from diverse backgrounds to engage in career exploration and development. The mission of QI’s Internship Program is to provide students and recent graduates a meaningful and practical work experience related to the student’s field of study or career interest. Interns will have the opportunity to attend internal meetings, attend external as well as QI events online or in-person.

items.title: Marketing Project Manager (Volunteer)
items.summary: About this Role: Marketing Project Manager (Volunteer) Location: Remote Commitment: Part-time (volunteer, pro bono role) Contribution Requirements: Minimum 10 hours per week; minimum 3–6 months.
items.description: About this Role: Marketing Project Manager (Volunteer) Location: Remote Commitment: Part-time (volunteer, pro bono role) Contribution Requirements: Minimum 10 hours per week; minimum 3–6 months. Professional Volunteering: Skills-based service performed with the same reliability, accountability, and quality expected in a paid professional role. Volunteers are core contributors whose work directly supports our mission of global compassion, collaboration, and action. About Solution Community : is an international 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, pioneering an innovative social platform dedicated to enabling actionable change. With volunteers from 70+ countries, we demonstrate the power of global collaboration. Our team members bring experiences from some of the world's most successful companies, including Apple, Toyota, Google, Netflix, Walmart, Meta, and many others, creating a rich tapestry of knowledge and passion. Our Mission: To foster a global community of compassion, uniting individuals and organizations to solve the world's social problems. We bridge non-profits, businesses, philanthropists, and volunteers, empowering them to create meaningful change for current and future generations. Our Vision: Imagine a world where every person has the opportunity to thrive — a world united by collaboration, compassion, and action. At Solution Community , we are turning that vision into reality, driving transformative change that reshapes the future. Summary of Role: As our Marketing Project Manager, you will serve as the Growth Team's strategic backbone, bridging analytics, content strategy, and project execution to drive measurable marketing outcomes. You will lead the planning, coordination, and performance tracking of marketing initiatives, ensuring campaigns are data-informed, strategically aligned, and delivered on time. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategic analysis and hands-on project management. Responsibilities Define project scopes, timelines, milestones, and deliverables for marketing campaigns and initiatives across all channels. Serve as a strategic guide and decision-maker in content strategy, ensuring all content aligns with organizational goals and audience insights. Design and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure campaign performance, engagement metrics, and ROI across platforms. Collaborate with the social media, design, paid ads, and brand outreach teams to ensure alignment, remove blockers, and maintain delivery cadence. Translate data into actionable insights, identifying opportunities to optimize, grow audiences, and improve content performance. Oversee end-to-end execution of marketing projects from ideation through launch and post-campaign analysis. Build and refine marketing workflows, templates, and operational systems that scale with team growth. Provide regular updates, status reports, and strategic recommendations to the Head of Growth and leadership. Qualifications - You are a good fit if: You bring experience in marketing strategy, analytics, or project management with a proven ability to translate vision into measurable outcomes. You are data-driven and comfortable building dashboards, interpreting campaign metrics, and making evidence-based decisions. You have experience coordinating multiple workstreams, managing timelines, and driving cross-functional teams toward shared goals. Understanding of content ecosystems, audience segmentation, and how strategic content drives engagement and growth. You excel at presenting insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are passionate about social impact and motivated to contribute your skills to a purpose-driven, global organization. You are familiar with project management tools, analytics platforms (Google Analytics, social media insights), and content planning tools. What We Offer Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies Meaningful impact on global causes and communities A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 70+ countries A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration Flexible work life with full autonomy Opportunities for personal and professional growth A formal recommendation upon successful completion of your volunteer term. A formal recommendation upon successful completion of your volunteer term. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Operations Manager (m/w/d) E-Commerce Agentur · Remote
items.summary: Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen?
items.description: Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen? Du denkst in zusammenhängenden System, steuerst komplexe Organisationen und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Konzepte nicht auf Folien bleiben, sondern im Tagesgeschäft gelebt werden? Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE trägst du umfassende Verantwortung für Strukturen, Systeme und Teams. Das erwartet dich bei uns Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In deinem täglichen Handeln führst du die Organisation durch Phasen von Wachstum und Veränderung. Entwickelst Strukturen, Systeme und Abteilungen weiter und stellst sicher, dass EVOLVE als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner reibungslos funktioniert - anstatt in Silos zu arbeiten. Um eine zukunftsträchtige Agentur zu gestalten, nutzt du KI und Automationen gezielt als Wachstumshebel. Du definierst die operative System- und Automationsarchitektur und sorgst dafür, dass Technologie messbar zur Skalierung, Qualitätssicherung und Entlastung der Teams beiträgt. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann. Über EVOLVE Digital EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse. EVOLVE Digital bietet dir ein Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team aus 20+ erfahrenen Spezialisten. Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen. Deine Aufgaben im Überblick Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran. Denn die besten Prozesse bringen nichts, wenn niemand nachhält, ob sie greifen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe. Was das im Alltag heißt: Du übersetzt die Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar. Du sorgst dafür, dass das EVOLVE OS als ganzheitliches System und Kern unserer Dienstleistung funktioniert und sich fortlaufend weiterentwickelt Du steuerst die operativen Abläufe vor allem innerhalb der Agentur und bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen über Onboarding. Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten, wo sie benötigt und sinnvoll sind. Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Für die Umsetzung stellen wir dir ein Team zur Verfügung. Du betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag: Reminder, Check-ins, Dashboards. Ziele, die niemand nachhält, bleiben. Du kennst dich mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana aus und verstehst in den Grundzügen Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n. Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt. Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, da wir 100 % remote arbeiten. Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Team Leads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen. Sicherer Umgang mit Google-Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen. Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. items.description: Job Title Project Monitoring Officer Location Global Position Type Paid - Regular Job Description The Project Monitoring Officer plays a critical role in supporting SIL's expanding Resource Development strategy by ensuring the effective coordination, monitoring, and reporting of projects that support organizational and staff fundraising efforts. As SIL continues to grow its network of donors, grantors, and funding partners, this position serves as a central hub for collecting and managing project information, facilitating collaboration across departments, and ensuring that project proposals and reports meet the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and donor compliance. This globally focused role is responsible for overseeing the systematic collection, analysis, tracking, and reporting of project data to support grant management, fundraising initiatives, and strategic decision-making. The Project Monitoring Officer works closely with project leaders, fundraisers, and organizational stakeholders to develop compelling proposals, monitor project progress, measure outcomes, and provide timely reporting that strengthens donor relationships and demonstrates impact. Additionally, the position serves as a key liaison between SIL and ETEN Alliance, fostering strong partnership engagement, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring alignment of shared goals and reporting requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, relationship-oriented, and motivated by supporting successful fundraising outcomes that enable SIL to advance its mission and expand its global impact. Responsibilities Project Intake, Proposal Development, and Stakeholder Coordination Serve as the primary point of contact for Areas, SCOs, and project leaders regarding project intake, proposal development, and reporting requirements. Manage project intake processes to ensure submitted projects have appropriate leadership endorsement, align with organizational priorities, demonstrate funding potential, and support measurable outcomes. Review and strengthen project concept notes, project descriptions, impact statements, and budgets to meet donor and funding partner expectations. Coordinate with project leaders and stakeholders to gather information necessary for proposal development and donor communications. Facilitate ongoing communication regarding project expectations, reporting requirements, accountability measures, and funding opportunities. Collaborate with internal departments to collect project stories, impact narratives, testimonials, and related content for donor reports, annual reports, websites, email campaigns, and stewardship communications. Project Registry and Reporting Management Maintain a comprehensive project registry and filing system that serves as the central repository for project information, proposals, reports, donor requirements, and related documentation. Manage project tracking systems, including funding coordination, proposal status, reporting schedules, and project documentation. Maintain reporting calendars and proactively communicate reporting deadlines to project leaders and funding recipients. Coordinate the collection, review, and submission of financial and narrative reports in accordance with donor agreements and organizational requirements. Support the development, formatting, editing, and distribution of project proposals and progress reports using approved organizational templates and standards. Ensure project files remain current, organized, and accessible to authorized stakeholders. Track donor requirements, reporting obligations, giving page support needs, and process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness. Funding Administration Support Coordinate project-related donation processing activities with gift administration and finance teams. Support accurate allocation of project funding, indirect cost recovery, and funding transfers. Maintain project funding records and update project tracking systems accordingly. Communicate project awards, funding decisions, reporting expectations, and compliance requirements to project recipients. Monitor project financial activity to support accurate reporting and donor accountability. Alliance Partnership Management Serve as a primary liaison between related partners. Maintain regular communication and engagement processes that support strong partner relationships and coordinated action. Represent SIL priorities, constraints, and outcomes in partnership discussions while ensuring partner expectations are clearly communicated internally. Establish and maintain systems to track funded activities, grant commitments, deliverables, and reporting obligations. Curate, validate, manage, and analyze project and operational data associated with funded activities. Generate reports, dashboards, and data insights to support grant reporting, organizational learning, performance evaluation, and strategic decision-making. Facilitate proposal development, grant reporting, project implementation tracking, and compliance monitoring across multiple departments and partner organizations. Ensure partnership commitments, deliverables, and reporting requirements are completed accurately and on schedule. Skills and Abilities Strong project coordination and project management capabilities while managing multiple priorities Excellent organizational, planning, and deadline-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and departments. Proficiency in preparing, editing, formatting, and reviewing proposals, reports, and project documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Competence in data collection, tracking, reporting, and analysis. Demonstrated initiative, follow-through, and commitment to continuous improvement. Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Nonprofit Management or related field preferred Travel Requirements Occasional domestic and international travel may be required, including attendance at approved in-person meetings, training events, and partner engagements. Weekly Hours 40 Originally posted on Himalayas
