items.description: At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. We're looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success to act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to our customers, blending strong relationship management with a deep understanding of ClickUp’s platform and capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of customer success, solution strategy, and technical enablement, supporting long-term growth, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success at ClickUp lead with a customer-first mindset, developing success plans, guiding onboarding and adoption, and ensuring stakeholders see continuous value throughout their lifecycle. While you’ll support technical initiatives like process optimization, workflow design, and AI enablement, you’ll also own the overall health, engagement, and strategic direction of your accounts. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Support to align efforts and ensure each customer’s success story is long-term, scalable, and impactful. Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success at ClickUp are responsible for delivering measurable value and driving meaningful business outcomes across their customer portfolio by focusing on: Customer Enablement & Onboarding: Guiding new teams through implementation, onboarding, and training to ensure a smooth start and foundational success. Account Health & Engagement: Proactively managing user adoption, stakeholder alignment, and account health to promote long-term success, retention, and growth opportunities. Process Optimization & Solution Design: Collaborating with customers to identify critical business processes, map them to scalable solutions, and drive efficiency through ongoing refinement and performance insights. Innovation Adoption & Workflow Automation: Empowering customers to leverage emerging features and technologies, including AI and automation, to enhance productivity, streamline operations, and deliver real-world impact. Core Responsibilities Senior Technical Account Manager - Customer Success at ClickUp act as the strategic and technical owner of the customer relationship, ensuring every customer achieves measurable success through ClickUp product and AI feature set. New Customer Onboarding Lead or support the end-to-end onboarding and implementation of ClickUp, from discovery and solution design to training and go-live support. Translate functional and technical requirements into scalable ClickUp solutions, including workflows, templates, hierarchies, and automations. Guide customers through foundational setup, integration, and enablement, while promoting best-practices and system governance and change management. Account Health Management Monitor seat utilization, adoption trends, and Champion/Stakeholder engagement. Build and execute adoption plans and account reviews to maintain or improve health. Identify risks early and build recovery plans in partnership with the account team. Deliver ongoing change management and enablement, ensuring customers continue to evolve and mature with the platform. Workflow Mapping (IER Framework) Conduct Intake → Execution → Reporting (IER) cycles for key workflows. Lead discovery sessions to map current-state vs. future-state processes. Recommend optimizations and create workflow templates to scale across teams. AI Enablement & Agent Deployment Drive adoption of ClickUp AI and build custom workflow Agents tied to customer use cases. Partner with customers to define and deliver new AI automations that align with business KPIs. Provide technical training and consultation on AI and automation best practices, including prompt design, agent architecture, and scaling use cases across teams. items.description: About FastSpring : FastSpring is how AI, SaaS, gaming, software, and digital product companies sell online in more places around the world. We handle all payment needs from checkout to taxes so you can go farther faster. Founded in 2005, we are a privately owned company headquartered in Santa Barbara with offices in Amsterdam, Austin, Belfast, Dublin, Halifax, and Singapore. Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations Department: Payment Operations | Location: Remote — United States | Reports To: Director of Trust and Safety Position Overview: The Payment Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day health of FastSpring's payment ecosystem for our network of 2,500+ sellers, with a focus on chargeback management, KPI tracking, and issue resolution across multiple processors and regions. Working closely with senior team members, this role helps manage chargebacks, monitor payment performance, and investigate anomalies while supporting cross-functional efforts to reduce risk and improve the seller experience. It is an entry-to-early career role with room to grow into payments, risk, and fraud. Responsibilities & Goals: Assist with the end-to-end chargeback process, including preparing and submitting representments. Monitor chargeback volumes, win rates, and related KPIs using existing reports and tools. Coordinate with sellers and internal teams to collect supporting documentation for dispute responses. Monitor payment processor dashboards and alerts to identify potential issues or disruptions. Support Tier I–II payment-related inquiries from sellers and internal teams. Investigate routine issues involving settlements, refunds, disputes, or processor behavior. Help document and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for chargebacks and payment operations. Experience & Qualifications: 1+ years of experience in payments operations, chargebacks, customer support operations, finance operations, or a related role. Basic understanding of card payments and the chargeback/dispute lifecycle. Exposure to chargeback processing, payment processors, or merchant-of-record environments is a plus. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow documented processes. Strong organizational and communication skills. Interest in learning more about risk, fraud, and payment optimization. We welcome candidates from a range of backgrounds and experiences who bring fresh perspective to payment operations challenges. Technology & Systems: Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and spreadsheets. Familiarity with payment processor dashboards or dispute management tools is a plus. Comfortable working across multiple platforms and systems in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment. Consistent with FastSpring's values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. The base pay range below represents a good faith estimate of the low and high end base pay range for the listed position. This role may be eligible for the corporate bonus plan (or, if a sales role, a commission plan as defined in the sales incentive plan document). In addition, FastSpring provides a variety of benefits to employees. Estimated Base Pay Range $63,000—$63,000 USD About the Company: FastSpring is an EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY/AFFIRMATIVE ACTION employer. Candidates are considered for employment with FastSpring without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military status, veteran status (specifically status as a disabled veteran, special disabled veteran, Vietnam Era veteran, recently separated veteran, armed forces service medal veteran, or other protected veteran) or other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local law. These tools are designed to support efficiency and consistency within the hiring process. AI systems are not used as the sole determinant of hiring outcomes, and all employment decisions are made by qualified human reviewers. items.description: Job Title: Business Developer (Digital Marketing) Job Type: Full time, Remote Job description HUP Network is a fast growing performance advertising startup. Our core advantage is deep knowledge and experience in all sectors of the digital advertising landscape and adtech. We are looking for a Business Development Manager to help grow our network’s commercial opportunities by identifying, approaching, and developing relationships with new partners across the performance marketing ecosystem. This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone with existing experience in business development, sales, partnerships, affiliate marketing, performance marketing, adtech, or digital advertising - someone who can build pipeline, open conversations, qualify opportunities, and move priorities forward without constant supervision. If you are commercially sharp, proactive, confident in outreach and negotiation, and able to understand how performance marketing partnerships create revenue, this role offers the perfect environment to grow and thrive. Tasks Business Development & Pipeline Building Identify and research new potential business opportunities for HUP Network. Build and manage a pipeline of advertisers, agencies, publishers, affiliates, networks, traffic partners, and other relevant commercial partners. Conduct outreach via email, LinkedIn, industry contacts, conferences, and other relevant channels. Open conversations with decision-makers and qualify commercial potential. Present our network’s value proposition clearly and professionally. Set up and lead discovery calls with potential partners. Commercial Negotiation & Deal Development Understand partner needs, traffic potential, offer requirements, commercial models, and performance expectations. Negotiate commercial terms such as CPA, CPL, revenue share, payouts, caps, payment terms, and traffic expectations. Identify whether a potential partner or deal is commercially viable for HUP Network. Coordinate with internal teams before committing to commercial terms or operational requirements. Move opportunities from first contact to signed agreement or qualified handover. Market Research & Opportunity Mapping Research relevant verticals, markets, competitors, traffic sources, partner types, and commercial trends. Identify more geos, and partnership opportunities that could support Adhoq’s growth. Track market changes and provide insights on partner demand, pricing, competition, and performance trends. Build and maintain target lists for outreach and conference preparation. Internal Coordination Work closely with internal teams to assess offer potential, traffic fit, tracking needs, and operational feasibility. Build trustworthy, professional relationships with both internal stakeholders and external partners. Communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and provide reliable support to ensure smooth collaboration. Ensure new opportunities are properly documented before onboarding or handover. Share relevant market feedback, partner objections, and commercial insights with management. Support smooth onboarding of new partners once commercial terms are agreed. Requirements Must-Have Previous experience in business development, sales, partnerships, affiliate marketing, performance marketing, adtech, digital advertising, or a closely related commercial role. Strong understanding of commercial relationship building and B2B outreach. Ability to identify, approach, and qualify new partners independently. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Confident in pitching, follow-ups, objection handling, and negotiation. Commercial mindset with the ability to assess revenue potential, partner quality, and business fit. Highly organized and disciplined with strong CRM and follow-up habits. Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Proactive, hands-on, and comfortable taking ownership without constant supervision. Nice-to-Have Experience in affiliate marketing, lead generation, advertising networks, affiliate networks, or performance marketing companies. Existing network of advertisers, publishers, affiliates, agencies, networks, or traffic partners. Familiarity with CPA, CPL, RevShare, payout models, caps, tracking links, postbacks, pixels, and campaign performance metrics. Experience with verticals such as Dating, Nutra, iGaming, Sweepstakes, Finance, Lead Gen, or similar. Experience preparing for and attending industry conferences. Experience working with tracking tools, dashboards, and reporting. Benefits Competitive salary based on experience and seniority. Performance-based bonus opportunities. Remote, full-time role in a fast-growing performance marketing company. Ownership, responsibility, and room to grow based on results. Please provide your CV in English. We're excited to get to know you better and hopefully welcome you aboard soon! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

items.title: Business Operations Manager
items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Mid-Market Sales Leader - EMEA at Bitwarden
items.summary: Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and pa
items.description: Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com. We are looking for a Leader to lead the EMEA small to medium and Mid market team and is based remotely in the UK. The Role This role leads the EMEA Small to medium and MidMarket business team and is accountable for new logo acquisition and expansion revenue across the region. The expectations are high: a team that generates its own pipeline across multiple countries, deals that are qualified with discipline, forecasts that hold, and Account Executives who improve every quarter. This is not an oversight role. The leader in this seat works deals alongside their team, sets the standard for outbound execution in each market, and uses data to drive performance. It is a first-line leader role who has already delivered results in EMEA and wants to operate at the pace and scale of a fast-growing company. Responsibilities Deal leadership Engage directly in the team’s most important opportunities: discovery, executive alignment, mutual close plans, commercial structure, procurement, legal, DPA, and security review. Set the standard for value-based selling: quantifying the customer’s business pain, building the business case, and tying Bitwarden to risk reduction and compliance outcomes that drive European buying decisions (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001). Diagnose and unblock stalled deals, and use them to raise the skill level of the entire team. Coach disciplined excellence and field skills to find, transition and close deals efficiently. Work tirelessly in the detail of each customer requirement, enabled by experience and strategic effort, placing Bitwarden in the best position possible to win deals and transfer this knowledge to the team. Drive accountability through metrics, motivation, method and effective communication techniques. Be accountable, methodical, pragmatic and foster by example lead from the front. Outbound pipeline generation Build and mature a repeatable cold outbound motion with AEs and partnered SDRs, localized by market: territory and account prioritization, ICP and persona targeting, multi-threaded sequencing, and messaging adapted for country and language. Set activity and pipeline-generation standards, inspect them weekly, and hold every AE accountable for self-sourced pipeline. Align and drive our message with Marketing, Sales Development, and Channel on programs, including partner-sourced plays, that produce qualified pipeline at a predictable rate. MEDDPICC and value-based execution Run MEDDPICC as the team’s operating system across qualification, deal reviews, forecast calls, and win/loss analysis, with value-based selling defining how the team earns and proves each element. Inspect every material opportunity for quantified Metrics, a validated Economic Buyer, a tested Champion, clear Decision Criteria and Process, a mapped Paper Process (including works council, procurement, and data-protection steps), and an honest read on Competition. Deliver an accurate weekly forecast built on deal evidence and maintain CRM data the business can rely on. Data-driven coaching Own the team’s KPIs (pipeline generation, coverage, stage conversion, win rate, cycle length, average deal size, and activity-to-outcome ratios) by rep and by market, and act on what they show. Identify where each AE is losing ground and build targeted coaching plans to close the gap. Run a disciplined operating cadence across time zones: weekly 1:1s, pipeline and deal reviews, forecast calls, and call reviews. Team building Recruit, hire, onboard, and ramp high-caliber Account Executives across EMEA markets, and develop them toward promotion. Build a culture of accountability, competitiveness, and continuous improvement across countries and cultures. Work across Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing, to deliver revenue as one team. Requirements 3–5 years of first-line sales leadership in EMEA, ideally leading AEs selling security SaaS (identity, access, credential, endpoint, or adjacent categories). A proven, documented track record of quota attainment as a leader, and as an individual contributor before that. Deep working fluency in MEDDPICC and value-based selling, applied together to qualify, inspect, forecast, and coach. A track record of building and maturing a cold outbound pipeline across more than one EMEA market, with the ability to explain exactly how it was done and what it produced. Strong analytical skills, including fluency with Hubspot & industry tooling for reporting, dashboards, and spreadsheets, and a record of using KPIs to direct coaching and improve AE performance. A hands-on approach to leadership, with direct, regular involvement in live deals. Player-coach, building own pipeline coaching the team through example, including closing and processing, customer excellence. Strong intellect, a fast learning curve, and the drive to perform in a high-growth environment with demanding targets. Strong command of EMEA buying dynamics, procurement processes, regulatory drivers, and channel/partner models. Fluent business English. (Additional languages are beneficial considering the role supports all of EMEA e.g., German, French, Dutch, etc.) A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organisations. Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

items.summary: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable.
items.description: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years. Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions. If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first). For our Listing department, we are looking for a Taxonomy/Catalogue Expert who will own the structure, quality, and scalability of refurbed 's product catalogue — the category tree, attributes, and data models that search, filters, listings, pricing (SRP), and compliance are all built on. WHO YOU ARE Experienced with product taxonomy/classification in e-commerce or marketplace environments A strong data modeler and structured thinker, comfortable defining schemas rather than just filling them in Proficient in SQL and spreadsheet/BI tools (Looker or equivalent) for auditing Catalogue quality at scale Familiar with SEO and search/filter mechanics as they relate to attributes and category structure Experienced with (or has an aptitude for) automation/scripting to run taxonomy audits and bulk changes A strong cross-functional communicator who can drive alignment without direct authority over sellers or other teams; WHAT YOU'LL DO Own the global category tree structure: product/instance relationships, subcategories, and category dependencies across markets — and run periodic taxonomy audits Design the attribute schema for each category: (allowed values, mandatory vs. optional, units) and own attribute governance and naming conventions Lead deduplication and normalization initiatives across: the catalog, and define/monitor data-quality KPIs for the taxonomy Lead taxonomy design for new category and market expansion: benchmarking against industry standards, and strong vertical players Detail-oriented but able to zoom out to system-level: ("does this scale") thinking Own and maintain: the Category Tree SOP, Filter SOP, and Attribute Governance documentation Act as the taxonomy point of contact for: Category Management, Selection Squad, Catalyst Squad, Compliance, Marketing, and Customer Service WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US: Our Culture and Values: Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so! We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company. You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future! No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference! Personal & Professional Development: You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you. We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health. We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments. Flexibility: We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊 We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize. You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops …and much more! See for further insights! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: What is PerfectServe ? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! The Customer Success Advisor (CSA) owns the day-to-day relationship with a portfolio of PerfectServe customers, with a focus on Lightning Bolt Scheduling. This role builds trusted customer relationships, helps teams get more value from the product, and improves adoption, workflows, and overall satisfaction. The CSA works closely with customers and internal PerfectServe teams to resolve issues, support optimization efforts, strengthen retention, and identify opportunities where additional PerfectServe solutions may help customers meet their goals. Responsibilities Serve as a strong advocate for customers and end users, representing their needs within the PerfectServe organization Build trusted day-to-day relationships with customer stakeholders, including executive sponsors, department and service line leaders, and key practice administrators. Partner with customers to ensure they are fully leveraging Lightning Bolt Scheduling to achieve desired business outcomes Develop strong product and workflow expertise, including a clear understanding of scheduling processes and how Lightning Bolt Scheduling can help customers improve them. Use Salesforce, Zendesk, Pendo, and Looker to monitor utilization, adoption trends, service request data, and account health; identify risks, resolve recurring issues, and improve customer satisfaction and retention. Lead process improvement and optimization initiatives that drive measurable value for customers Own and resolve escalated service issues, coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely and effective outcomes Collaborate with Account Executives and Technical Consultants to establish and execute customer account plans. Support renewal readiness and account health by coordinating with Account Executives or Sr. Contract Specialists as appropriate; for select lower-tier accounts, manage renewal paperwork and related Salesforce opportunity updates. Lead customer retention and save efforts when needed, keeping renewal risks visible and coordinating next steps based on account tier and customer needs. Use virtual engagement, scalable outreach, and in-app messaging to keep lower-ARR accounts informed, engaged, and connected to product value. Partner with internal teams across PerfectServe to coordinate customer-facing work and keep customer commitments moving forward. Maintain accurate customer documentation, meeting notes, and key account intelligence in Salesforce and Confluence. Travel to client sites as needed to support onboarding, training, adoption, and optimization initiatives Success Factors Strong technical aptitude and the ability to apply Lightning Bolt Scheduling to solve complex customer challenges A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to anticipate customer needs and act decisively A consultative approach to customer engagement, focused on guiding customers toward best-practice solutions Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in high-pressure environments Proven ability to build and sustain strong professional relationships Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills Excellent written, verbal, and documentation skills Commercial judgment to recognize renewal risk, support tier-appropriate renewal activity, connect customer needs to growth opportunities, and partner effectively with Account Executives or Sr. Contract Specialists. Customer-focused ownership, follow-through, and professionalism when supporting complex or sensitive account needs. Essential Qualifications 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, or a related customer-facing role. 2+ years of experience in supporting SaaS products; healthcare software experience strongly preferred Experience with scheduling workflows, clinical operations, or healthcare operations preferred. Experience using CRM, support ticketing, analytics, or customer engagement tools such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Looker, Pendo, or similar platforms preferred. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Available to travel up to 25% Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $70,000 USD plus incentives per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

items.title: Vice President, Public Relations (Health)
items.summary: WHO WE ARE The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years.
items.description: WHO WE ARE The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month. Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result. Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment. We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us. THE ROLE We are seeking an accomplished and strategic leader to join the team as a Vice President, Health. This role requires a seasoned professional with deep expertise in the healthcare industries, outstanding communication skills, and a proven track record in client management and team leadership. As the Vice President, you will spearhead PR initiatives for our clients, lead thought leadership, drive business growth, and deliver impactful results that enhance their reputation and visibility in the market. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Leadership: Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for the health and lifestyle industries, guiding team members to achieve excellence and drive results. Client Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with healthcare clients, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring delivery of high-quality PR services. Strategy Development: Develop comprehensive PR strategies tailored to each client's objectives and target audience, leveraging industry knowledge and market insights. Campaign Execution: Oversee the implementation of PR campaigns, including media relations, thought leadership initiatives, crisis communications, and executive visibility programs. Team Management: Lead, mentor, and empower a team of PR professionals specializing in health and lifestyle services, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment. Media Relations: Build and maintain relationships with key health and lifestyle contacts, securing impactful placements in top-tier outlets and healthcare publications. Thought Leadership: Position clients as industry thought leaders through strategic content development, speaking opportunities, and participation in relevant industry events and conferences. Crisis Communications: Develop and implement crisis communication plans to safeguard clients' reputation and mitigate reputational risks in the event of crises or negative publicity. Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for optimization and continuous improvement. WHAT YOU'LL OWN IN YEAR ONE Own the practice's account management rhythm with structured weekly business reviews, account health scoring, and proactive risk identification across the existing client book Bring practice-level retention into the top quartile of the firm through tight service delivery, fast time-to-value on new accounts, and structured save-the-account interventions where necessary Develop and execute 5+ recurring expansion plays within the existing client base, building toward 1.5–2% monthly MRR expansion as a sustained rate Lead and develop the existing healthcare team, direct senior coaching, selective recruiting, and accountability for delivery quality Build a productized healthcare service offering that leverages the Interviewed platform: competitive intelligence, regulatory media monitoring, KOL targeting, payer narrative tracking Win new healthcare clients in partnership with our new business team, with focus on biotech, pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, digital health, and consumer wellness Represent the practice externally, industry events, healthcare-specific publications, thought leadership in the healthcare communications space QUALIFICATIONS Minimum of 15 years of experience in public relations, with a focus on the healthcare and lifestyle industries. Proven track record of successfully managing PR campaigns for healthcare clients, with measurable results in media placements and client satisfaction. Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team to achieve excellence. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and communicate complex healthcare and lifestyle concepts effectively. Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the healthcare industry. Extensive network of media contacts and industry connections within the healthcare and lifestyle sectors Results-oriented with a passion for delivering high-quality work and exceeding client expectations. WHO YOU ARE 15+ years in healthcare communications or healthcare PR, with senior leadership experience leading teams and owning practice-level outcomes Demonstrated specialty depth in at least three of: FDA and regulatory communications, biotech and pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, payer relations, clinical trial communications, digital health, healthcare policy A documented track record of measurable client retention and expansion you can describe in numbers Comfortable carrying gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, and expansion as primary KPIs, not just media impressions and placements Strong network of healthcare media contacts across business, trade, clinical, and consumer publications Strategic operator, equally fluent in client strategy, team development, and operational rigor Comfortable with AI-driven workflows and a data-disciplined approach to earned media WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE 🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth. 🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being. 💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing further to 3% in 2027 . 🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love. 👶 Paid Parental Leave - We support growing families with paid parental leave, giving new parents dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence. 📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing strategic integrated marketing and communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people like you grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with meaningful real impact. 🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and one additional document we genuinely want to read: a one-page write-up of your most significant healthcare client retention or expansion outcome. Tell us what the situation was, what you did, and the numbers you moved. The write-up will be weighted more heavily than the resume. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure. We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our product and engineering teams build the platform that powers both. Hydrosat is hiring a Director of International BD & Sales to bost growth, identify and develop strategic opportunities, and strengthen our position across international government markets. This is a senior, hands-on role combining channel leadership, business development, and market intelligence. You will own Hydrosat ’s international partner ecosystem, shape market-entry strategies, and identify relevant government programs before they reach formal procurement. Working closely with the VP Global, Government Programs, you will represent Hydrosat with senior customers and partners, make recommendations on where the company should invest its resources, and coordinate early-stage opportunities into qualified captures. Responsibilities Channel Strategy and Management Audit, improve and execute Hydrosat ’s international channel strategy. Identify, recruit, negotiate with, and onboard resellers and strategic partners. Establish reseller agreements for satellite data, IrriWatch, and other relevant Hydrosat solutions. Manage partner pipelines and hold resellers accountable against clear activity, pipeline, and revenue targets. Provide partners with the use cases, marketing materials, pricing guidance, training, and commercial support needed to generate and maximize revenue. Structure the global reseller network through partner tiers and performance reviews Grow partner-generated pipeline and revenue while addressing underperforming relationships. International Strategy and Market Development Develop market-entry strategies for priority countries and regions. Map government landscapes, including end users, buyers, budget owners, procurement processes, funding sources, and existing capabilities. Identify and engage relevant local partners, institutional stakeholders, and decision-makers. Produce actionable country and market strategies for leadership decision-making. Represent Hydrosat in selected customer, partner, and institutional engagements. Opportunity Intelligence and Early Capture Establish a systematic approach to monitoring relevant RFIs, tenders, funding programs, and institutional initiatives worldwide. Track national and international procurement platforms. Qualify opportunities based on strategic fit, funding, customer access, competitive position, timing, and probability of success. Develop preliminary capture strategies and make clear go/no-go recommendations. Position Hydrosat with key stakeholders before formal procurements are released. Advance qualified opportunities into structured captures Contribute to the development and adoption of Hydrosat ’s value proposition across government markets. Maintain accurate partner, market, and opportunity intelligence in CRM. Requirements At least eight years of experience in international business development, partnerships, channel management, market strategy, or capture. Demonstrated success building commercial partnerships and developing complex government or institutional opportunities. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to operate independently across multiple markets. Confidence engaging senior government, institutional, and industry stakeholders. A proactive, resourceful personality with strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail. Ability to turn fragmented market information into clear strategies, priorities, and actions. Excellent written and spoken English. French, Spanish, Portugeuse, or another European language is a strong plus. Experience in Earth observation, space, geospatial intelligence, government markets, water management, agriculture, climate technology, or deep tech is preferred. Willingness to travel internationally. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Freelancing Engagement: Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist (m/f/d)
items.summary: the opportunity We are looking for a Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist on Smart Sensors & Edge AI to investigate, structure and document the market requirements for next-generation smart sensor applications powered by our Analog Edge AI low-power ASIC.
items.description: the opportunity We are looking for a Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist on Smart Sensors & Edge AI to investigate, structure and document the market requirements for next-generation smart sensor applications powered by our Analog Edge AI low-power ASIC. You bring a solid engineering background that enables you to understand our technology at a deep technical level and translate what you learn into precise, measurable requirements. You combine strong analytical and writing skills with a genuine understanding of technology markets. In this role, you translate market needs, customer problems and application requirements into a structured MRD that guides GEMESYS’s strategy, product, technology and business development activities. You work closely with our management, engineers and business developers to answer critical questions such as: Which smart sensor markets have the strongest need for local or edge AI, meaning on-device learning, inference, event or anomaly detection, or data compression? What problems are customers currently unable to solve efficiently? What sensor capabilities, AI functions and performance levels are required? Which applications benefit most from on-device learning and inference? What are the requirements around power consumption, latency and bandwidth? Which technical requirements are driven by customers, and which by competitors or industry standards? Which product requirements should GEMESYS prioritize for its Edge AI technology? The goal is an MRD that engineering can design against: every requirement quantified, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. your role Market & Application Research Build a deep understanding of our analog AI hardware, its capabilities and limitations, together with our team. Research the global smart sensor and Edge AI landscape and identify relevant market segments, applications and customer groups. Analyze emerging applications for intelligent and autonomous sensors. Investigate industry trends, technology adoption and customer requirements. Identify high-value use cases where local or edge AI processing provides tangible benefits. Identify opportunities where GEMESYS’s Analog Edge AI architecture creates differentiated value, also beyond sensors. Research competing technologies and alternative solutions, with the support of our engineers. Customer & Stakeholder Requirements Identify and structure customer pain points and unmet needs. Translate qualitative customer requirements into measurable product requirements. Define functional and non-functional requirements for smart sensor systems. Classify these requirements into categories, so that the engineering teams can make trade-offs. Source and conduct customer, expert and partner interviews through your own network, and run the market validation independently. Share your findings with management, and join selected customer and investor meetings where they add value. Market Requirements Document You own the development of a comprehensive MRD, including: Market overview, segmentation and competitive landscape Target applications and use cases Customer personas and stakeholders, where relevant Customer pain points and unmet needs Market and technology trends and their future projections Alternative technology approaches Market and product specification requirements for our Analog Edge AI ASIC: power, energy modes, bandwidth, area, process nodes, target ASP and further parameters, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases Product opportunity areas Recommendations for product and technology development Regulatory and industry considerations Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with GEMESYS’s technical teams to understand the capabilities and limitations of the underlying analog AI hardware. Lead our in-house market analysis team and resources efficiently, so that they support your work and build their own skill set. Translate technical capabilities into customer and application value propositions. Facilitate discussions between technical, commercial and management stakeholders. Challenge our existing assumptions with customer and market evidence. Ensure that product requirements are traceable to actual market needs. Guide future product roadmap decisions. Deliverables You are responsible for producing a professional MRD. Every requirement specified in it is prioritized for each segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. what you bring Experience in technical marketing, product marketing or application engineering for semiconductors, sensors or embedded systems. Solid understanding of sensor signal chains, low-power electronics and embedded AI, deep enough to discuss architecture trade-offs with chip designers. Extensive experience developing Market Requirements Documents, Product Requirements Documents, market studies or comparable strategic or technical documentation. An established network in smart sensors, Edge AI or semiconductors that gives you direct access to potential customers, domain experts and industry partners, without relying on GEMESYS contacts. Proven ability to independently source, schedule and conduct customer and expert interviews, and to run market validation end to end. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear market and customer requirements. Experience researching technology markets and competitive landscapes. Excellent strategic, analytical and structured thinking skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Ability to independently conduct research, identify information gaps and develop well-supported conclusions. Domain experience Must have (at least one of the following) Smart sensors Edge AI / TinyML Embedded AI Good to have Analog computing Neuromorphic computing Memristive technology Nice to have Automotive sensing Autonomous systems Wearables or medical devices Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Smartland Energy is looking for a strong communicator who can take complicated information and make it clear and easy to understand. This could be a great fit for someone with experience in journalism, public relations, communications, or a similar field. You’ll help Smartland Energy communicate with the communities where we work. Our projects include data centers and energy infrastructure, and local residents may have questions about things like water, electricity, land use, construction, and how a project could affect their community. Your job is to help us answer those questions clearly, accurately, and respectfully. What you'll do Write FAQs, emails, website updates, social media posts, fact sheets, and other community materials Research topics and work with our team to make sure information is accurate Help respond to questions and concerns from local residents Turn technical information into language that is easy for the public to understand Help prepare communications for community meetings and public outreach Coordinate announcements across email, social media, websites, and print Keep our messaging clear and consistent Track basic results such as email opens, meeting attendance, questions, and community feedback Keep confidential company information private What we're looking for Background in journalism, PR, communications, English, Mass Communication, Development Communication, Humanities, or a related field Excellent written English Ability to research a topic before writing about it Ability to explain complicated subjects in simple, natural language Good judgment when communicating information that may still be changing or uncertain Comfortable communicating with people who may be concerned, frustrated, or skeptical Able to work independently and communicate closely with management Organized and dependable Nice to have Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required: Energy or utilities Infrastructure or construction Government or community relations NGO or public-interest communications Crisis communications US or international clients Managing communications across several channels Loc: International Salary: $560 bi-weekly Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: University Admissions Tutor & Advisor Location: Remote Employment type: Part-time, flexible and assignment-based Compensation: $25 per hour. About Brainlyne Brainlyne supports students and families with international university applications and educational opportunities. We are building a team of tutors and advisors to support students through online group classes and individual guidance. Our work covers university orientation, admissions preparation, and application support across different tracks, including the US, UK, Europe, and other destinations. Areas we are hiring for Depending on your background and preferences, you may support one or more of the following: SAT and test preparation English and academic writing Essay brainstorming and feedback University orientation and admissions systems US, UK, and European application guidance University research and school-list building Activities, CVs, and personal profile development Interview and financial-aid preparation You do not need to cover every area. Assignments will be matched to your academic background, experience, strengths, and preferred areas of support. Responsibilities Online group classes Lead engaging online sessions for groups of students Teach topics such as SAT preparation, English, writing, and general university preparation Explain university admissions systems, timelines, and requirements Support students with practical exercises and clear next steps Individual student support Review each student’s personal Brainlyne folder and current progress Follow an individual plan based on the student’s goals, destination, and stage of preparation Support university lists, applications, essays, activities, CVs, interviews, and deadlines Give constructive written and verbal feedback Help students complete their own work without writing applications or essays for them Track progress, update notes, and communicate important concerns to the Brainlyne team Requirements Currently enrolled as a junior or senior, or an alumnus or recent graduate of a leading university Demonstrated experience in tutoring, teaching, mentoring, admissions advising, essay editing, writing support, or a related area Strong knowledge of at least one relevant subject or admissions track Strong written and spoken English Excellent communication, organization, and follow-up skills Comfortable teaching online and working with students independently Reliable, patient, and able to provide thoughtful feedback Candidates may come from universities such as Princeton, Harvard, Oxford, NYU, or other comparable institutions. However, university background alone is not enough. We are especially interested in candidates with practical experience supporting students. Important expectations Tutors and advisors must maintain professional boundaries. They should not write applications or essays on behalf of students, or guarantee admission, scholarships, visas, or test scores. This is a flexible, assignment-based role. Compensation is based on approved hours completed and documented, including group classes, individual sessions, preparation, and feedback. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for a hands-on, AI-native marketer who wants to take ownership of marketing and help shape how we do it. AI is a core part of how we work. We’re looking for someone who already uses AI agents, automation, integrations, and structured workflows to get real marketing work done – and can show us what they’ve achieved with them. This is also a technical role . We’ve built our own analytics, newsletter, and marketing automation systems, so you should be comfortable working with technical tools, setting up a local development environment, and using tools like Claude to help you navigate technical tasks. You won’t be joining an established marketing team or following a fixed playbook. You’ll have the freedom to talk to our clients, understand our business, find the strongest opportunities, and decide what marketing should focus on next. What You’ll Work On Several areas currently need an owner: SEO / GEO / AEO Content and collaborations with partners, authors, and bloggers Marketing to existing customers, including retention and expansion Paid advertising Client analytics Other marketing opportunities you identify You’ll work hands-on, from identifying an opportunity through execution, measurement, and improvement. Your First Weeks We don’t expect you to arrive with all the answers. We want you to understand the business first and then decide what should be done. You’ll: Learn our products, industry, competitors, and ecosystem. Speak directly with customers to understand their needs and how they see our products. Look at our data, existing activities, and opportunities. Identify where marketing can have the biggest impact. Build a concrete plan for the areas you propose to own and explain why. What We’re Looking For You already use AI agents, automation, and advanced AI workflows in your everyday work and can show us concrete results. You’re hands-on and comfortable with the technical side of marketing. You’re curious and take time to understand customers and the business before proposing solutions. You can work across different areas of marketing and turn ideas into action. You understand how marketing connects to business results. You have experience marketing technical products, ideally software, SaaS, WordPress, or similar. You work independently and can move things forward without detailed instructions. You’re comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change and not everything is defined in advance. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide. You’ll have real ownership and the freedom to help build our marketing approach, work directly with our CEO and product teams, experiment with AI, and turn your ideas into real marketing initiatives. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you’re excited about building marketing with AI, getting hands-on, and having the freedom to shape what comes next, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-marketing-1

items.description: Design Headquarters: Hurst, TX URL: http://bbemarketing.com/ We’re looking for a creative, curious designer who can turn entertainment and sports industry data into compelling social content. You’ll come up with ideas, identify relevant news, create graphics, write captions, and check the information before it’s published. Our audience includes entertainment and sports professionals. We need someone who understands what would make these people stop, read, share, or join the conversation. What You’ll Do Generate original content ideas. Find interesting angles in our data and industry developments, including infographics, comparisons, agency breakdowns, rankings, and recurring series. Bring ideas proactively and experiment with new formats. Create the graphics yourself. Design clear, engaging infographics, carousels, and news graphics that communicate information effectively and look polished on social media. Choose the right news stories. Review incoming industry news and decide which stories matter to our audience, why they matter, and how we should present them. Write the copy. Create headlines, on-graphic text, hooks, and captions in clear, confident English suited to an industry-professional audience. Review researchers’ work. Check the data and supporting sources provided by our research team. Verify names, agency relationships, dates, totals, percentages, and other details. Flag inconsistencies and work with researchers to resolve them. Own the final quality check. Make sure the graphic and caption match the verified data, the headline is supported, and the finished post is accurate and easy to understand. Manage the content calendar. Balance planned content with timely responses to relevant industry news. Learn from performance. Review what resonates with our audience and use those insights to improve future content. What We’re Looking For A strong graphic design portfolio, especially infographics, editorial graphics, social media carousels, or other information-focused content. The ability to take a post from initial idea through design, caption writing, and final review. Strong creative and editorial judgment. You can look at a dataset or news story, identify an interesting angle, and explain why our audience would care. Excellent written English, including the ability to make complex information clear and concise. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with spreadsheets, checking percentages, and reviewing sources. Proficiency in the design tools needed to produce polished graphics and organized, editable files. Initiative and curiosity. You regularly bring forward ideas, explore possibilities, and improve concepts through feedback. Strong organization, reliable communication, and the ability to manage deadlines independently. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bbe-marketing-inc-senior-graphic-designer

This is a high-ownership role where you’ll contribute to cutting-edge projects, explore new animation technologies, and help shape Superside’s creative motion capabilities.

items.title: Creative Director / Associate Creative Director
items.summary: Superside is seeking visionary Creative Directors/Associate Creative Directors to guide a globally distributed team across branding, ad and social creative, presentations, print, and landing pages. In this high-impact role, you’ll shape the future of AI-enhanced creativity by integrating generative tools into our design workflows, elevating both quality and efficiency. You’ll lead by example as both a maker and a mentor, balancing hands-on creative work with strategic guidance. Collaborating with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, you’ll inspire cross-functional teams, develop human-centered creative strategies, and help build a scalable design practice rooted in experimentation, feedback, and continuous improvement.

items.title: Lead Creative
items.summary: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative with a passion for AI to shape creative excellence across branding, landing pages, ads, social, print, and presentations. You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.
